name: OddCycleBound.odd_of_short
statement: lemma odd_of_short {m : ℕ} (hm : m = 3 ∨ m = 5 ∨ m = 7) : Odd m ∧ 3 ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  rcases hm with rfl | rfl | rfl
  exacts [⟨⟨1, rfl⟩, le_rfl⟩, ⟨⟨2, rfl⟩, by norm_num⟩, ⟨⟨3, rfl⟩, by norm_num⟩]

name: OddCycleBound.neckSum_ge_baseline_short
statement:
lemma neckSum_ge_baseline_short {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hm : m = 3 ∨ m = 5 ∨ m = 7)
    (hp : 1 / 2 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) :
    edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1) ≤
      DenseRegion.neckSum W μ m
proof:
:=
  DenseRegion.neckSum_ge_baseline_of_multiKernel_nonneg hW (odd_of_short hm).1
    (odd_of_short hm).2 fun _ hr L hlen _ =>
      multiKernel_nonneg_short hm hr.1 hr.2 (by linarith [edgeDensity_le_one hW]) (by linarith)
        L hlen

name: OddCycleBound.commonality_short
statement:
theorem commonality_short {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hm : m = 3 ∨ m = 5 ∨ m = 7)
    (hp : 1 / 2 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) :
    cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m + (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ m +
        (pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1) - (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1))
proof:
:=
  DenseRegion.commonality_of_neckSum_ge hW (odd_of_short hm).1 (odd_of_short hm).2
    (neckSum_ge_baseline_short hW hm hp)

name: OddCycleBound.cycle_bound_short
statement:
theorem cycle_bound_short {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hm : m = 3 ∨ m = 5 ∨ m = 7)
    (hp : 1 / 2 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) :
    cycleDensity μ W m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:=
  DenseRegion.cycle_bound_of_neckSum hW (odd_of_short hm).1 (odd_of_short hm).2
    (neckSum_ge_baseline_short hW hm hp)

name: OddCycleBound.cycle_bound_short_all
statement:
theorem cycle_bound_short_all {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hm : m = 3 ∨ m = 5 ∨ m = 7) :
    cycleDensity μ W m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : 1 / 2 ≤ edgeDensity W μ
  · exact cycle_bound_short hW hm hp
  · have hnonneg : 0 ≤ cycleDensity μ W m := trace_compPow_nonneg hW (m - 1)
    have := rhs_nonpos_of_le_half hW (m := m) (by have := (odd_of_short hm).2; omega)
      (by linarith)
    linarith

name: OddCycleBound.uniformFin_univ
statement: lemma uniformFin_univ {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) : uniformFin k Set.univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniformFin, Measure.smul_apply, ← Finset.coe_univ, Measure.count_apply_finset,
    Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul]
  exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel (by exact_mod_cast hk) (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top k)

name: OddCycleBound.integral_uniformFin
statement:
lemma integral_uniformFin (k : ℕ) (f : Fin k → ℝ) :
    ∫ x, f x ∂(uniformFin k) = (1 / k : ℝ) * ∑ x, f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_fintype Integrable.of_finite, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  simp only [measureReal_def, uniformFin, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.count_singleton,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_natCast, one_div]

name: OddCycleBound.isGraphon_completePartite
statement:
lemma isGraphon_completePartite (k : ℕ) : IsGraphon (completePartite k) (uniformFin k) where
  meas
proof:
:= measurable_of_finite _
  nonneg i j := by unfold completePartite; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  le_one i j := by unfold completePartite; split_ifs <;> norm_num
  symm i j := by unfold completePartite; simp only [eq_comm]

name: OddCycleBound.sum_completePartite_mul
statement:
private lemma sum_completePartite_mul {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (f : Fin k → ℝ) :
    ∑ z, completePartite k i z * f z = (∑ z, f z) - f i
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ z, completePartite k i z * f z = f z - if i = z then f z else 0 := fun z => by
    unfold completePartite; split_ifs <;> ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun z _ => h z, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
    if_pos (Finset.mem_univ i)]

name: OddCycleBound.degree_completePartite
statement:
lemma degree_completePartite {k : ℕ} (i : Fin k) :
    degree (completePartite k) (uniformFin k) i = (k - 1 : ℝ) / k
proof:
:= by
  rw [degree, integral_uniformFin]
  have := sum_completePartite_mul i (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  simp only [mul_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] at this
  rw [this]; ring

name: OddCycleBound.edgeDensity_completePartite
statement:
lemma edgeDensity_completePartite {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    edgeDensity (completePartite k) (uniformFin k) = 1 - 1 / k
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeDensity, mean, integral_uniformFin]
  simp only [degree_completePartite, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
    nsmul_eq_mul]
  have hk' : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  field_simp

name: OddCycleBound.compPow_completePartite
statement:
lemma compPow_completePartite {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (i j : Fin k) :
    compPow (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) n i j =
      ((k - 1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) - (-1) ^ (n + 1)) / (k : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) +
        if i = j then (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) / (k : ℝ) ^ n else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk
  induction n generalizing i j with
  | zero =>
      show completePartite k i j = _
      unfold completePartite
      split_ifs <;> field_simp <;> ring
  | succ n ih =>
      show ∫ z, completePartite k i z * compPow (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) n z j
          ∂(uniformFin k) = _
      rw [integral_uniformFin]
      simp only [ih]
      rw [sum_completePartite_mul i]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
        nsmul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', if_pos (Finset.mem_univ j)]
      split_ifs <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: OddCycleBound.cycleDensity_completePartite
statement:
theorem cycleDensity_completePartite {k m : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) m =
      ((k - 1 : ℝ) / k) ^ m + (k - 1 : ℝ) * (-1 / (k : ℝ)) ^ m
proof:
:= by
  have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hk' : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hk0
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [cycleDensity, trace, integral_uniformFin, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  simp only [compPow_completePartite hk0, if_true, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [div_pow, div_pow]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.cycleDensity_completePartite_odd
statement:
theorem cycleDensity_completePartite_odd {k m : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hm : Odd m) :
    cycleDensity (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) m =
      (1 - 1 / (k : ℝ)) ^ m - (1 - 1 / (k : ℝ)) * (1 - (1 - 1 / (k : ℝ))) ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := by rcases hm with ⟨t, rfl⟩; omega
  have hk' : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show k ≠ 0 by omega)
  rw [cycleDensity_completePartite hk hm1]
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hm
  rw [show 2 * t + 1 - 1 = 2 * t by omega]
  rw [show (-1 / (k : ℝ)) ^ (2 * t + 1) = -(1 / (k : ℝ)) ^ (2 * t + 1) by
      rw [neg_div, Odd.neg_pow ⟨t, rfl⟩]]
  rw [show (1 : ℝ) - (1 - 1 / k) = 1 / k by ring, show (1 : ℝ) - 1 / k = (k - 1) / k by
      field_simp]
  rw [pow_succ (1 / (k : ℝ)) (2 * t)]
  field_simp
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.completePartite_minimises
statement:
theorem completePartite_minimises {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω}
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {W : Ω → Ω → ℝ} {k m : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (hm : Odd m)
    (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hp : edgeDensity W μ = 1 - 1 / k) :
    cycleDensity (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) m ≤ cycleDensity μ W m
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k 3 with hk3 | hk3
  · obtain rfl : k = 2 := by omega
    have h0 : cycleDensity (uniformFin 2) (completePartite 2) m = 0 := by
      rw [cycleDensity_completePartite (by norm_num) (by omega)]
      obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hm
      rw [show (-1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (2 * t + 1) = -(1 / ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) ^ (2 * t + 1) by
        rw [neg_div, Odd.neg_pow ⟨t, rfl⟩]]
      norm_num
    rw [h0]
    exact trace_compPow_nonneg hW (m - 1)
  · have hk' : (3 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk3
    have hp23 : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ := by
      rw [hp]
      have : 1 / (k : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3 := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) hk'
      linarith
    rw [cycleDensity_completePartite_odd (by omega) hm, ← hp]
    exact DenseRegion.dense_region_cycle_bound_unconditional hW hp23 hm hm3

name: OddCycleBound.good_one
statement: lemma good_one : Good (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  ⟨stronglyMeasurable_const, ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun _ => by norm_num⟩⟩

name: OddCycleBound.good_smul
statement: lemma good_smul (c : ℝ) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) : Good (c • f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hf.bdd
  refine ⟨hf.meas.const_smul c, ⟨|c| * C, mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hC0, fun x => ?_⟩⟩
  rw [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC x) (abs_nonneg _)

name: OddCycleBound.good_add
statement: lemma good_add {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) (hg : Good g) : Good (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Cf, hCf0, hCf⟩ := hf.bdd
  obtain ⟨Cg, hCg0, hCg⟩ := hg.bdd
  refine ⟨hf.meas.add hg.meas, ⟨Cf + Cg, by linarith, fun x => ?_⟩⟩
  rw [Pi.add_apply]
  exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by linarith [hCf x, hCg x])

name: OddCycleBound.integrable_Uf
statement:
lemma integrable_Uf (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) (x : Ω) :
    Integrable (fun y => U x y * f y) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hmx : Measurable (fun y => U x y) := hU.meas.comp measurable_prodMk_left
  exact (Good.mul ⟨hmx.stronglyMeasurable, ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun y => by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hU.nonneg x y)]; exact hU.le_one x y⟩⟩ hf).integrable

name: OddCycleBound.kernelOp_one
statement: lemma kernelOp_one (_hU : IsGraphon U μ) : kernelOp U μ (fun _ => 1) = degree U μ
proof:
:= by
  funext x; simp [kernelOp, degree]

name: OddCycleBound.degree_eq
statement: lemma degree_eq (x : Ω) : degree U μ x = edgeDensity U μ + degCentered U μ x
proof: := by simp [degCentered]

name: OddCycleBound.compressIter_zero
statement: lemma compressIter_zero : compressIter U μ 0 = degCentered U μ
proof: := rfl

name: OddCycleBound.degree_eq'
statement: lemma degree_eq' (x : Ω) : degree U μ x = edgeDensity U μ + compressIter U μ 0 x
proof: := by rw [degree_eq, compressIter_zero]

name: OddCycleBound.kernelOp_add'
statement:
lemma kernelOp_add' (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) (hg : Good g) (x : Ω) :
    kernelOp U μ (f + g) x = kernelOp U μ f x + kernelOp U μ g x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kernelOp, Pi.add_apply]
  rw [← integral_add (integrable_Uf hU hf x) (integrable_Uf hU hg x)]
  exact integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => by ring)

name: OddCycleBound.kernelOp_smul'
statement: lemma kernelOp_smul' (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) (x : Ω) : kernelOp U μ (c • f) x = c * kernelOp U μ f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kernelOp, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  exact integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => by ring)

name: OddCycleBound.mean_kernelOp_compressIter
statement:
lemma mean_kernelOp_compressIter (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (k : ℕ) :
    mean μ (kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k)) = specMoment U μ k
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : mean μ (kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k)) = ∫ x, kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k) x * 1 ∂μ := by simp [mean]
  rw [h1, kernelOp_symm hU (good_compressIter hU k) good_one, kernelOp_one hU]
  have hcongr : ∀ x, compressIter U μ k x * degree U μ x
      = edgeDensity U μ * compressIter U μ k x + degCentered U μ x * compressIter U μ k x := fun x => by rw [degree_eq]; ring
  rw [integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ hcongr),
    integral_add ((good_compressIter hU k).integrable.const_mul _) ((good_degCentered hU).mul (good_compressIter hU k)).integrable,
    integral_const_mul]
  have : ∫ x, compressIter U μ k x ∂μ = 0 := mean_compressIter hU k
  rw [this, mul_zero, zero_add]
  rfl

name: OddCycleBound.kernelOp_compressIter
statement:
lemma kernelOp_compressIter (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (k : ℕ) :
    kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k) = fun x => specMoment U μ k + compressIter U μ (k + 1) x
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  have hdef : compressIter U μ (k + 1) x = kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k) x - mean μ (kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k)) := by
    simp only [compressIter, compress]
  rw [mean_kernelOp_compressIter hU k] at hdef
  linarith [hdef]

name: OddCycleBound.kernelOp_compressIter'
statement:
lemma kernelOp_compressIter' (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (k : ℕ) (x : Ω) :
    kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k) x = specMoment U μ k + compressIter U μ (k + 1) x
proof: := congrFun (kernelOp_compressIter hU k) x

name: OddCycleBound.mean_one
statement: lemma mean_one : mean μ (fun _ : Ω => (1:ℝ)) = 1
proof: := mean_const 1

name: OddCycleBound.mean_smul
statement: lemma mean_smul (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) : mean μ (c • f) = c * mean μ f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; rw [integral_const_mul]

name: OddCycleBound.mean_add
statement:
lemma mean_add {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) (hg : Good g) :
    mean μ (f + g) = mean μ f + mean μ g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mean, Pi.add_apply]; exact integral_add hf.integrable hg.integrable

name: OddCycleBound.good_pathIter
statement: lemma good_pathIter (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : ∀ n, Good (pathIter U μ n)
proof:
| 0 => good_one
  | (n + 1) => good_kernelOp hU (good_pathIter hU n)

name: OddCycleBound.compl_eq_onesKernel_sub
statement: lemma compl_eq_onesKernel_sub (x y : Ω) : compl U x y = onesKernel x y - U x y
proof: := by simp [compl, onesKernel]

name: OddCycleBound.goodK_compl
statement: lemma goodK_compl (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : GoodK (compl U)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨measurable_const.sub hU.meas, ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun x y => ?_⟩⟩
  rw [compl, abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith [hU.nonneg x y, hU.le_one x y]

name: OddCycleBound.compl_symm
statement: lemma compl_symm (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (x y : Ω) : compl U x y = compl U y x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compl, hU.symm x y]

name: OddCycleBound.compPow_comm_U
statement:
lemma compPow_comm_U (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : ∀ n,
    comp μ (compPow μ U n) U = comp μ U (compPow μ U n)
proof:
:= by
  have hGU : GoodK U := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      show comp μ (comp μ U (compPow μ U k)) U = comp μ U (comp μ U (compPow μ U k))
      rw [comp_assoc hGU (goodK_compPow hGU k) hGU, ih]

name: OddCycleBound.comp_compPow_U
statement:
lemma comp_compPow_U (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (n : ℕ) :
    comp μ (compPow μ U n) U = compPow μ U (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [compPow_comm_U hU]; rfl

name: OddCycleBound.trace_comp_rowBroadcast
statement:
lemma trace_comp_rowBroadcast (f : Ω → ℝ) (R : Ω → Ω → ℝ) :
    trace μ (comp μ (fun x _ => f x) R) = ∫ x, f x * (∫ z, R z x ∂μ) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  show ∫ x, comp μ (fun x _ => f x) R x x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x * (∫ z, R z x ∂μ) ∂μ
  refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  show (∫ z, f x * R z x ∂μ) = f x * ∫ z, R z x ∂μ
  rw [integral_const_mul]

name: OddCycleBound.abs_sub_le''
statement: private lemma abs_sub_le'' (a b : ℝ) : |a - b| ≤ |a| + |b|
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact (abs_add_le a (-b)).trans (le_of_eq (by rw [abs_neg]))

name: OddCycleBound.good_complIter
statement: lemma good_complIter (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : ∀ n, Good (complIter U μ n)
proof:
| 0 => good_one
  | (n + 1) => by
      obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := (good_kernelOp hU (good_complIter hU n)).bdd
      refine ⟨stronglyMeasurable_const.sub (good_kernelOp hU (good_complIter hU n)).meas,
        ⟨|mean μ (complIter U μ n)| + C, by positivity, fun x => ?_⟩⟩
      show |mean μ (complIter U μ n) - kernelOp U μ (complIter U μ n) x| ≤ |mean μ (complIter U μ n)| + C
      exact (abs_sub_le'' _ _).trans (by linarith [hC x])

name: OddCycleBound.abs_compl_le_one
statement: private lemma abs_compl_le_one (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (x z : Ω) : |compl U x z| ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [compl, abs_le]; constructor <;> nlinarith [hU.nonneg x z, hU.le_one x z]

name: OddCycleBound.rowsum_complPow
statement:
lemma rowsum_complPow (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : ∀ n,
    (fun x => ∫ y, compPow μ (compl U) n x y ∂μ) = complIter U μ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hGW : GoodK (compl U) := goodK_compl hU
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      funext x
      show ∫ y, compl U x y ∂μ = mean μ (complIter U μ 0) - kernelOp U μ (complIter U μ 0) x
      rw [show complIter U μ 0 = (fun _ => (1:ℝ)) from rfl, mean_const, kernelOp_one hU]
      simp only [compl]
      rw [integral_sub (integrable_const 1) ((goodK_of_isGraphon hU).integrable_row x)]
      have h2 : ∫ y, U x y ∂μ = degree U μ x := rfl
      rw [h2]; simp
  | succ k ih =>
      funext x
      show ∫ y, comp μ (compl U) (compPow μ (compl U) k) x y ∂μ
          = mean μ (complIter U μ (k + 1)) - kernelOp U μ (complIter U μ (k + 1)) x
      obtain ⟨Ck, _, hCk⟩ := (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGW k).bdd
      have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun y z => compl U x z * compPow μ (compl U) k z y) (μ.prod μ) := by
        have hSM : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry fun y z => compl U x z * compPow μ (compl U) k z y) := by
          have h1 : Measurable (fun p : Ω × Ω => compl U x p.2) :=
            hGW.meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_snd)
          have h2 : Measurable (fun p : Ω × Ω => compPow μ (compl U) k p.2 p.1) :=
            (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGW k).meas.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst)
          exact (h1.mul h2).stronglyMeasurable
        refine (integrable_const (1 * Ck)).mono' hSM.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ ?_)
        rintro ⟨y, z⟩
        simp only [Function.uncurry, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (abs_compl_le_one hU x z) (hCk z y) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)
      calc ∫ y, comp μ (compl U) (compPow μ (compl U) k) x y ∂μ
          = ∫ y, ∫ z, compl U x z * compPow μ (compl U) k z y ∂μ ∂μ := by simp only [comp]
        _ = ∫ z, ∫ y, compl U x z * compPow μ (compl U) k z y ∂μ ∂μ := integral_integral_swap hint
        _ = ∫ z, compl U x z * (∫ y, compPow μ (compl U) k z y ∂μ) ∂μ := by
              refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_)
              show ∫ y, compl U x z * compPow μ (compl U) k z y ∂μ = compl U x z * ∫ y, compPow μ (compl U) k z y ∂μ
              rw [integral_const_mul]
        _ = ∫ z, compl U x z * complIter U μ (k + 1) z ∂μ := by
              refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_)
              have ihz : ∫ y, compPow μ (compl U) k z y ∂μ = complIter U μ (k + 1) z := congrFun ih z
              show compl U x z * (∫ y, compPow μ (compl U) k z y ∂μ) = compl U x z * complIter U μ (k + 1) z
              rw [ihz]
        _ = mean μ (complIter U μ (k + 1)) - kernelOp U μ (complIter U μ (k + 1)) x := by
              simp only [compl, sub_mul, one_mul]
              rw [integral_sub (good_complIter hU (k + 1)).integrable
                (integrable_Uf hU (good_complIter hU (k + 1)) x)]
              rfl

name: OddCycleBound.comp_symm_swap
statement:
lemma comp_symm_swap {K L : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hsK : ∀ x y, K x y = K y x)
    (hsL : ∀ x y, L x y = L y x) (x y : Ω) : comp μ K L y x = comp μ L K x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [comp]
  refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_)
  show K y z * L z x = L x z * K z y
  rw [hsK y z, hsL z x]; ring

name: OddCycleBound.compPow_comm
statement:
lemma compPow_comm {K : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hK : GoodK K) : ∀ n,
    comp μ (compPow μ K n) K = comp μ K (compPow μ K n)
proof:
| 0 => rfl
  | (n + 1) => by
      show comp μ (comp μ K (compPow μ K n)) K = comp μ K (comp μ K (compPow μ K n))
      rw [comp_assoc hK (goodK_compPow hK n) hK, compPow_comm hK n]

name: OddCycleBound.compPow_symm
statement:
lemma compPow_symm {K : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hK : GoodK K) (hsymm : ∀ x y, K x y = K y x) :
    ∀ (n) (x y : Ω), compPow μ K n x y = compPow μ K n y x
proof:
| 0, x, y => hsymm x y
  | (n + 1), x, y => by
      have ih : ∀ a b, compPow μ K n a b = compPow μ K n b a := fun a b => compPow_symm hK hsymm n a b
      show comp μ K (compPow μ K n) x y = comp μ K (compPow μ K n) y x
      rw [comp_symm_swap hsymm ih x y, compPow_comm hK n]

name: OddCycleBound.comp_compPow_compl
statement:
lemma comp_compPow_compl (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (a : ℕ) :
    comp μ (compPow μ U a) (compl U) = fun x y => pathIter U μ (a + 1) x - compPow μ U (a + 1) x y
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  have e : comp μ (compPow μ U a) (compl U)
      = fun x y => comp μ (compPow μ U a) onesKernel x y - comp μ (compPow μ U a) U x y := by
    rw [show (compl U) = (fun x y => onesKernel x y - U x y) from by funext x y; rw [compl_eq_onesKernel_sub]]
    exact comp_sub_right (goodK_compPow hGU a) goodK_onesKernel hGU
  rw [e, comp_compPow_U hU, comp_onesKernel_right]
  funext x y
  show (∫ z, compPow μ U a x z ∂μ) - compPow μ U (a + 1) x y
      = pathIter U μ (a + 1) x - compPow μ U (a + 1) x y
  rw [congrFun (rowsum_compPow hU a) x]

name: OddCycleBound.colsum_compPow_compl
statement:
lemma colsum_compPow_compl (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (b : ℕ) :
    (fun x => ∫ z, compPow μ (compl U) b z x ∂μ) = complIter U μ (b + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun x => ∫ z, compPow μ (compl U) b z x ∂μ)
      = (fun x => ∫ z, compPow μ (compl U) b x z ∂μ) := by
    funext x
    exact integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun z =>
      compPow_symm (goodK_compl hU) (compl_symm hU) b z x)
  rw [h, rowsum_complPow hU b]

name: OddCycleBound.mixedTrace_succ
statement:
lemma mixedTrace_succ (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (a b : ℕ) :
    mixedTrace U μ a (b + 1)
      = pairing μ (pathIter U μ (a + 1)) (complIter U μ (b + 1)) - mixedTrace U μ (a + 1) b
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  have hGW := goodK_compl hU
  have hrow : GoodK (fun _x _y => pathIter U μ (a + 1) _x) :=
    goodK_rowBroadcast (good_pathIter hU (a + 1))
  show trace μ (comp μ (compPow μ U a) (compPow μ (compl U) (b + 1))) = _
  rw [show compPow μ (compl U) (b + 1) = comp μ (compl U) (compPow μ (compl U) b) from rfl,
    ← comp_assoc (goodK_compPow hGU a) hGW (goodK_compPow hGW b), comp_compPow_compl hU a,
    comp_sub_left hrow (goodK_compPow hGU (a + 1)) (goodK_compPow hGW b),
    trace_sub (goodK_comp hrow (goodK_compPow hGW b)) (goodK_comp (goodK_compPow hGU (a + 1)) (goodK_compPow hGW b)),
    trace_comp_rowBroadcast]
  show (∫ x, pathIter U μ (a + 1) x * (∫ z, compPow μ (compl U) b z x ∂μ) ∂μ) - mixedTrace U μ (a + 1) b
      = pairing μ (pathIter U μ (a + 1)) (complIter U μ (b + 1)) - mixedTrace U μ (a + 1) b
  congr 1
  show (∫ x, pathIter U μ (a + 1) x * (∫ z, compPow μ (compl U) b z x ∂μ) ∂μ)
      = ∫ x, pathIter U μ (a + 1) x * complIter U μ (b + 1) x ∂μ
  refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  show pathIter U μ (a + 1) x * (∫ z, compPow μ (compl U) b z x ∂μ)
      = pathIter U μ (a + 1) x * complIter U μ (b + 1) x
  rw [congrFun (colsum_compPow_compl hU b) x]

name: OddCycleBound.mixedTrace_zero
statement:
lemma mixedTrace_zero (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (a : ℕ) :
    mixedTrace U μ a 0 = pathDensity U μ (a + 1) - trace μ (compPow μ U (a + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  show trace μ (comp μ (compPow μ U a) (compl U)) = _
  rw [show (compl U) = (fun x y => onesKernel x y - U x y) from by funext x y; rw [compl_eq_onesKernel_sub],
    comp_sub_right (goodK_compPow hGU a) goodK_onesKernel hGU,
    trace_sub (goodK_comp (goodK_compPow hGU a) goodK_onesKernel) (goodK_comp (goodK_compPow hGU a) hGU),
    trace_comp_onesKernel_right, doubleMean_compPow hU a, comp_compPow_U hU]

name: OddCycleBound.comp_compl_left
statement:
lemma comp_compl_left (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {L : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hL : GoodK L) :
    comp μ (compl U) L = fun x y => comp μ onesKernel L x y - comp μ U L x y
proof:
:= by
  have hWeq : compl U = fun x y => onesKernel x y - U x y := by funext x y; rw [compl_eq_onesKernel_sub]
  rw [hWeq]; exact comp_sub_left goodK_onesKernel (goodK_of_isGraphon hU) hL

name: OddCycleBound.complTrace_peel
statement:
lemma complTrace_peel (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (m : ℕ) :
    trace μ (compPow μ (compl U) (m + 1)) = doubleMean μ (compPow μ (compl U) m) - mixedTrace U μ 0 m
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  have hGW := goodK_compl hU
  show trace μ (comp μ (compl U) (compPow μ (compl U) m)) = _
  rw [comp_compl_left hU (goodK_compPow hGW m),
    trace_sub (goodK_comp goodK_onesKernel (goodK_compPow hGW m)) (goodK_comp hGU (goodK_compPow hGW m)),
    trace_comp_onesKernel (goodK_compPow hGW m)]
  rfl

name: OddCycleBound.doubleMean_complPow
statement:
lemma doubleMean_complPow (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (n : ℕ) :
    doubleMean μ (compPow μ (compl U) n) = mean μ (complIter U μ (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [doubleMean, show (fun x => ∫ y, compPow μ (compl U) n x y ∂μ) = complIter U μ (n + 1) from rowsum_complPow hU n]
  rfl

name: OddCycleBound.kernelOp_selfadj
statement:
lemma kernelOp_selfadj (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {f g : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) (hg : Good g) :
    ∫ x, kernelOp U μ f x * g x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x * kernelOp U μ g x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  obtain ⟨Cf, _, hCf⟩ := hf.bdd
  obtain ⟨Cg, _, hCg⟩ := hg.bdd
  have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun x y => U x y * f y * g x) (μ.prod μ) := by
    have hSM : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry fun x y => U x y * f y * g x) :=
      ((hGU.meas).mul (hf.meas.measurable.comp measurable_snd)).mul
        (hg.meas.measurable.comp measurable_fst) |>.stronglyMeasurable
    refine (integrable_const (1 * Cf * Cg)).mono' hSM.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ ?_)
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    simp only [Function.uncurry, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul ?_ (hCf y) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)) (hCg x) (abs_nonneg _)
      (by positivity)
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hU.nonneg x y)]; exact hU.le_one x y
  calc ∫ x, kernelOp U μ f x * g x ∂μ
      = ∫ x, ∫ y, U x y * f y * g x ∂μ ∂μ := by
        refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
        show kernelOp U μ f x * g x = ∫ y, U x y * f y * g x ∂μ
        rw [kernelOp, integral_mul_const]
    _ = ∫ y, ∫ x, U x y * f y * g x ∂μ ∂μ := integral_integral_swap hint
    _ = ∫ y, f y * kernelOp U μ g y ∂μ := by
        refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
        show (∫ x, U x y * f y * g x ∂μ) = f y * kernelOp U μ g y
        rw [kernelOp, ← integral_const_mul]
        refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
        show U x y * f y * g x = f y * (U y x * g x)
        rw [hU.symm x y]; ring

name: OddCycleBound.pathIter_one
statement: lemma pathIter_one (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : pathIter U μ 1 = degree U μ
proof:
:= by
  show kernelOp U μ (fun _ => 1) = degree U μ; exact kernelOp_one hU

name: OddCycleBound.mean_kernelOp_eq
statement:
lemma mean_kernelOp_eq (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) :
    mean μ (kernelOp U μ f) = pairing μ (pathIter U μ 1) f
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : mean μ (kernelOp U μ f) = ∫ x, kernelOp U μ f x * 1 ∂μ := by simp [mean]
  rw [h1, kernelOp_selfadj hU hf good_one]
  simp only [pairing, pathIter_one hU]
  refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  show f x * kernelOp U μ (fun _ => 1) x = degree U μ x * f x
  rw [kernelOp_one hU]; ring

name: OddCycleBound.pairing_pathIter_zero
statement: lemma pairing_pathIter_zero (v : Ω → ℝ) : pairing μ (pathIter U μ 0) v = mean μ v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pairing, pathIter, one_mul, mean]

name: OddCycleBound.mixedTrace_telescope
statement:
lemma mixedTrace_telescope (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : ∀ (b a : ℕ),
    mixedTrace U μ a b
      = (∑ i ∈ Finset.range b,
          (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * pairing μ (pathIter U μ (a + 1 + i)) (complIter U μ (b - i)))
        + (-1 : ℝ) ^ b * mixedTrace U μ (a + b) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro b
  induction b with
  | zero => intro a; simp
  | succ b ih =>
      intro a
      have hsum : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range b,
          (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i + 1) * pairing μ (pathIter U μ (a + 1 + (i + 1))) (complIter U μ (b + 1 - (i + 1)))
            = -((-1 : ℝ) ^ i * pairing μ (pathIter U μ (a + 1 + 1 + i)) (complIter U μ (b - i))) := by
        intro i _
        have e1 : a + 1 + (i + 1) = a + 1 + 1 + i := by omega
        have e2 : b + 1 - (i + 1) = b - i := Nat.succ_sub_succ b i
        rw [e1, e2, pow_succ]; ring
      rw [mixedTrace_succ hU a b, ih (a + 1),
        Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun i =>
          (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * pairing μ (pathIter U μ (a + 1 + i)) (complIter U μ (b + 1 - i))) b,
        Finset.sum_congr rfl hsum, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      have eb : a + 1 + b = a + (b + 1) := by omega
      rw [eb, pow_succ]
      simp only [pow_zero, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.add_zero]
      ring

name: OddCycleBound.complTrace_necklace
statement:
lemma complTrace_necklace (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (n : ℕ) :
    trace μ (compPow μ (compl U) (n + 1))
      = (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * pairing μ (pathIter U μ j) (complIter U μ (n + 1 - j)))
        + (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (pathDensity U μ (n + 1) - trace μ (compPow μ U (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [complTrace_peel hU n, doubleMean_complPow hU n, mixedTrace_telescope hU n 0]
  simp only [Nat.zero_add]
  rw [mixedTrace_zero hU n,
    Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun j =>
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * pairing μ (pathIter U μ j) (complIter U μ (n + 1 - j))) n,
    pairing_pathIter_zero]
  have hsum : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i + 1) * pairing μ (pathIter U μ (i + 1)) (complIter U μ (n + 1 - (i + 1)))
        = -((-1 : ℝ) ^ i * pairing μ (pathIter U μ (1 + i)) (complIter U μ (n - i))) := by
    intro i _
    have e1 : (1 : ℕ) + i = i + 1 := by omega
    have e2 : n + 1 - (i + 1) = n - i := Nat.succ_sub_succ n i
    rw [e1, e2, pow_succ]; ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hsum, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, pow_succ]
  simp only [Nat.sub_zero]
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.edgeDensity_nonneg
statement: lemma edgeDensity_nonneg (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : 0 ≤ edgeDensity U μ
proof:
:=
  integral_nonneg fun x => integral_nonneg fun y => hU.nonneg x y

name: OddCycleBound.edgeDensity_le_one
statement: lemma edgeDensity_le_one (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : edgeDensity U μ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeDensity, mean]
  calc ∫ x, degree U μ x ∂μ ≤ ∫ _x, (1:ℝ) ∂μ := by
        refine integral_mono ((goodK_of_isGraphon hU).colsum_integrable.congr
          (ae_of_all _ fun x => by rw [degree]; exact integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => hU.symm y x)))
          (integrable_const 1) (fun x => ?_)
        rw [degree]
        calc ∫ y, U x y ∂μ ≤ ∫ _y, (1:ℝ) ∂μ :=
              integral_mono ((goodK_of_isGraphon hU).integrable_row x) (integrable_const 1)
                (fun y => hU.le_one x y)
          _ = 1 := by simp
    _ = 1 := by simp

name: OddCycleBound.isGraphon_compl
statement:
lemma isGraphon_compl (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : IsGraphon (compl U) μ where
  meas
proof:
:= by
    have h : Function.uncurry (compl U) = fun p : Ω × Ω => 1 - U p.1 p.2 := rfl
    rw [h]; exact measurable_const.sub hU.meas
  nonneg := fun x y => by rw [compl]; linarith [hU.le_one x y]
  le_one := fun x y => by rw [compl]; linarith [hU.nonneg x y]
  symm := fun x y => by rw [compl, compl, hU.symm x y]

name: OddCycleBound.abs_sub_le'
statement: private lemma abs_sub_le' (a b : ℝ) : |a - b| ≤ |a| + |b|
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]; exact (abs_add_le a (-b)).trans (le_of_eq (by rw [abs_neg]))

name: OddCycleBound.Good.integrable
statement: lemma Good.integrable {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) : Integrable f μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := hf.bdd
  refine (integrable_const C).mono' hf.meas.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ ?_)
  intro x; simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using hC x

name: OddCycleBound.Good.mul
statement: lemma Good.mul {f k : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) (hk : Good k) : Good (fun x => f x * k x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Cf, hCf0, hCf⟩ := hf.bdd
  obtain ⟨Ck, hCk0, hCk⟩ := hk.bdd
  refine ⟨hf.meas.mul hk.meas, ⟨Cf * Ck, mul_nonneg hCf0 hCk0, fun x => ?_⟩⟩
  rw [abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul (hCf x) (hCk x) (abs_nonneg _) hCf0

name: OddCycleBound.mean_const
statement: lemma mean_const (c : ℝ) : mean μ (fun _ => c) = c
proof: := by simp [mean]

name: OddCycleBound.good_kernelOp
statement: lemma good_kernelOp (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) : Good (kernelOp U μ f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hf.bdd
  refine ⟨?_, ⟨C, hC0, fun x => ?_⟩⟩
  · have hSM : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : Ω × Ω => U p.1 p.2 * f p.2) :=
      (hU.meas.stronglyMeasurable).mul (hf.meas.comp_measurable measurable_snd)
    exact hSM.integral_prod_right'
  · have hmx : Measurable (fun y => U x y) := hU.meas.comp measurable_prodMk_left
    have hint : Integrable (fun y => U x y * f y) μ :=
      (Good.mul ⟨hmx.stronglyMeasurable, ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun y => by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (hU.nonneg x y)]; exact hU.le_one x y⟩⟩ hf).integrable
    calc |kernelOp U μ f x| ≤ ∫ y, |U x y * f y| ∂μ := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
      _ ≤ ∫ _y, C ∂μ := by
          refine integral_mono hint.abs (integrable_const C) (fun y => ?_)
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hU.nonneg x y)]
          calc U x y * |f y| ≤ 1 * |f y| :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hU.le_one x y) (abs_nonneg _)
            _ = |f y| := one_mul _
            _ ≤ C := hC y
      _ = C := by simp

name: OddCycleBound.good_degree
statement: lemma good_degree (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : Good (degree U μ)
proof:
:= by
  have h : degree U μ = kernelOp U μ (fun _ => 1) := by funext x; simp [degree, kernelOp]
  rw [h]; exact good_kernelOp hU ⟨stronglyMeasurable_const, ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun _ => by norm_num⟩⟩

name: OddCycleBound.good_degCentered
statement: lemma good_degCentered (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : Good (degCentered U μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := (good_degree hU).bdd
  refine ⟨(good_degree hU).meas.sub stronglyMeasurable_const,
    ⟨C + |edgeDensity U μ|, add_nonneg hC0 (abs_nonneg _), fun x => ?_⟩⟩
  exact (abs_sub_le' _ _).trans (by linarith [hC x])

name: OddCycleBound.good_compress
statement: lemma good_compress (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) : Good (compress U μ f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := (good_kernelOp hU hf).bdd
  refine ⟨(good_kernelOp hU hf).meas.sub stronglyMeasurable_const,
    ⟨C + |mean μ (kernelOp U μ f)|, add_nonneg hC0 (abs_nonneg _), fun x => ?_⟩⟩
  exact (abs_sub_le' _ _).trans (by linarith [hC x])

name: OddCycleBound.good_compressIter
statement: lemma good_compressIter (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : ∀ k, Good (compressIter U μ k)
proof:
| 0 => good_degCentered hU
  | (k + 1) => good_compress hU (good_compressIter hU k)

name: OddCycleBound.mean_compressIter
statement: lemma mean_compressIter (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : ∀ k, mean μ (compressIter U μ k) = 0
proof:
| 0 => by
      show ∫ x, degCentered U μ x ∂μ = 0
      simp only [degCentered]
      rw [integral_sub (good_degree hU).integrable (integrable_const _)]
      show mean μ (degree U μ) - mean μ (fun _ => edgeDensity U μ) = 0
      rw [mean_const, edgeDensity]; ring
  | (k + 1) => by
      show ∫ x, compress U μ (compressIter U μ k) x ∂μ = 0
      simp only [compress]
      rw [integral_sub (good_kernelOp hU (good_compressIter hU k)).integrable (integrable_const _)]
      show mean μ (kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k)) - mean μ (fun _ => mean μ (kernelOp U μ (compressIter U μ k))) = 0
      rw [mean_const]; ring

name: OddCycleBound.kernelOp_symm
statement:
lemma kernelOp_symm (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {f k : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) (hk : Good k) :
    ∫ x, kernelOp U μ f x * k x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x * kernelOp U μ k x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Cf, hCf0, hCf⟩ := hf.bdd
  obtain ⟨Ck, hCk0, hCk⟩ := hk.bdd
  have hSM : StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry fun x y => U x y * f y * k x) := by
    have h1 : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : Ω × Ω => U p.1 p.2) := hU.meas.stronglyMeasurable
    have h2 : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : Ω × Ω => f p.2) := hf.meas.comp_measurable measurable_snd
    have h3 : StronglyMeasurable (fun p : Ω × Ω => k p.1) := hk.meas.comp_measurable measurable_fst
    exact (h1.mul h2).mul h3
  have hInt : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun x y => U x y * f y * k x) (μ.prod μ) := by
    refine (integrable_const (1 * Cf * Ck)).mono' hSM.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ ?_)
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    simp only [Function.uncurry, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hU.nonneg x y)]
    refine mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul (hU.le_one x y) (hCf y) (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num)) (hCk x)
      (abs_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg zero_le_one hCf0)
  have hL : ∀ x, kernelOp U μ f x * k x = ∫ y, U x y * f y * k x ∂μ := fun x => by
    rw [kernelOp, integral_mul_const]
  have hR : ∀ y, f y * kernelOp U μ k y = ∫ x, U x y * f y * k x ∂μ := fun y => by
    rw [kernelOp, ← integral_const_mul]
    refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    show f y * (U y x * k x) = U x y * f y * k x
    rw [hU.symm y x]; ring
  calc ∫ x, kernelOp U μ f x * k x ∂μ
      = ∫ x, ∫ y, U x y * f y * k x ∂μ ∂μ := by simp_rw [hL]
    _ = ∫ y, ∫ x, U x y * f y * k x ∂μ ∂μ := integral_integral_swap hInt
    _ = ∫ y, f y * kernelOp U μ k y ∂μ := by simp_rw [hR]

name: OddCycleBound.compress_symm
statement:
lemma compress_symm (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {f k : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) (hk : Good k)
    (hf0 : mean μ f = 0) (hk0 : mean μ k = 0) :
    ∫ x, compress U μ f x * k x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x * compress U μ k x ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : ∫ x, compress U μ f x * k x ∂μ = ∫ x, kernelOp U μ f x * k x ∂μ := by
    have h1 : Integrable (fun x => kernelOp U μ f x * k x) μ := ((good_kernelOp hU hf).mul hk).integrable
    have h2 : Integrable (fun x => mean μ (kernelOp U μ f) * k x) μ := hk.integrable.const_mul _
    calc ∫ x, compress U μ f x * k x ∂μ
        = ∫ x, (kernelOp U μ f x * k x - mean μ (kernelOp U μ f) * k x) ∂μ := by
            refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_); simp only [compress]; ring
      _ = (∫ x, kernelOp U μ f x * k x ∂μ) - mean μ (kernelOp U μ f) * ∫ x, k x ∂μ := by
            rw [integral_sub h1 h2, integral_const_mul]
      _ = ∫ x, kernelOp U μ f x * k x ∂μ := by
            have hk0' : ∫ x, k x ∂μ = 0 := hk0
            rw [hk0']; ring
  have e2 : ∫ x, f x * compress U μ k x ∂μ = ∫ x, f x * kernelOp U μ k x ∂μ := by
    have h1 : Integrable (fun x => f x * kernelOp U μ k x) μ := (hf.mul (good_kernelOp hU hk)).integrable
    have h2 : Integrable (fun x => f x * mean μ (kernelOp U μ k)) μ := hf.integrable.mul_const _
    calc ∫ x, f x * compress U μ k x ∂μ
        = ∫ x, (f x * kernelOp U μ k x - f x * mean μ (kernelOp U μ k)) ∂μ := by
            refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_); simp only [compress]; ring
      _ = (∫ x, f x * kernelOp U μ k x ∂μ) - (∫ x, f x ∂μ) * mean μ (kernelOp U μ k) := by
            rw [integral_sub h1 h2, integral_mul_const]
      _ = ∫ x, f x * kernelOp U μ k x ∂μ := by
            have hf0' : ∫ x, f x ∂μ = 0 := hf0
            rw [hf0']; ring
  rw [e1, e2, kernelOp_symm hU hf hk]

name: OddCycleBound.moment
statement:
lemma moment (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : ∀ (j i : ℕ),
    ∫ x, compressIter U μ i x * compressIter U μ j x ∂μ = specMoment U μ (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
      intro i
      rw [Nat.add_zero]
      show ∫ x, compressIter U μ i x * degCentered U μ x ∂μ = ∫ x, degCentered U μ x * compressIter U μ i x ∂μ
      refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
      ring
  | succ n ih =>
      intro i
      have key : ∫ x, compressIter U μ i x * compressIter U μ (n + 1) x ∂μ
          = ∫ x, compressIter U μ (i + 1) x * compressIter U μ n x ∂μ := by
        show ∫ x, compressIter U μ i x * compress U μ (compressIter U μ n) x ∂μ
            = ∫ x, compress U μ (compressIter U μ i) x * compressIter U μ n x ∂μ
        exact (compress_symm hU (good_compressIter hU i) (good_compressIter hU n) (mean_compressIter hU i) (mean_compressIter hU n)).symm
      rw [key, ih (i + 1)]
      congr 1; omega

name: OddCycleBound.dense_cycle_bound
statement:
theorem dense_cycle_bound {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ)
    (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:=
  DenseRegion.dense_region_cycle_bound_unconditional hW hp hm hm3

name: OddCycleBound.dense_region_main_theorem
statement:
theorem dense_region_main_theorem {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ)
    (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:=
  dense_cycle_bound hW hp hm hm3

name: OddCycleBound.strengthened_commonality_bound
statement:
theorem strengthened_commonality_bound {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ)
    (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m + (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ m +
        (pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1) - (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1))
proof:
:=
  DenseRegion.dense_region_commonality_bound hW hp hm hm3

name: OddCycleBound.strengthened_commonality_bound_short
statement:
theorem strengthened_commonality_bound_short {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ)
    (hm : m = 3 ∨ m = 5 ∨ m = 7) (hp : 1 / 2 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) :
    cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m + (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ m +
        (pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1) - (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1))
proof:
:=
  commonality_short hW hm hp

name: OddCycleBound.commonality_gap_ge_degree_variance
statement:
theorem commonality_gap_ge_degree_variance {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ)
    (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m - pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1)
        - (edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)) ≥
      (m - 1 : ℝ) * (∫ x, (degree W μ x - edgeDensity W μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ ((m - 1) / 2)
proof:
:=
  DenseRegion.commonality_gap_ge_degree_variance hW hp hm hm3

name: OddCycleBound.commonality_eq_iff_regular
statement:
theorem commonality_eq_iff_regular {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ)
    (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m - pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1)
        - (edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)) = 0 ↔
      ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree W μ x = edgeDensity W μ
proof:
:=
  DenseRegion.commonality_eq_iff_regular hW hp hm hm3

name: OddCycleBound.intermediate_cycle_bound
statement:
theorem intermediate_cycle_bound {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hm : Odd m) (hm11 : 11 ≤ m)
    (hp : edgeDensity W μ < 2 / 3) :
    cycleDensity μ W m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp2 : edgeDensity W μ ≤ 1 / 2
  · have hnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ cycleDensity μ W m := trace_compPow_nonneg hW (m - 1)
    linarith [rhs_nonpos_of_le_half hW (by omega : 1 ≤ m) hp2]
  ·
    have hp1 : (1 : ℝ) / 2 < edgeDensity W μ := not_le.mp hp2
    have hm9 : 9 ≤ m := by omega
    exact IntermediateRegion.intermediateRegion_odd_cycle_bound hW hm hm9 hp1 hp

name: OddCycleBound.small_cycle_bound
statement:
theorem small_cycle_bound {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hm9 : m ≤ 9) :
    cycleDensity μ W m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hm
  have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
  have hk4 : k ≤ 4 := by omega
  interval_cases k
  · exact cycle_bound_short_all hW (Or.inl rfl)
  · exact cycle_bound_short_all hW (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
  · exact cycle_bound_short_all hW (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
  ·
    show cycleDensity μ W 9 ≥ edgeDensity W μ ^ 9 - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ 8
    by_cases hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ
    ·
      exact dense_cycle_bound hW hp ⟨4, rfl⟩ (by norm_num)
    · by_cases hp2 : edgeDensity W μ ≤ 1 / 2
      ·
        have hnonneg : 0 ≤ cycleDensity μ W 9 := trace_compPow_nonneg hW 8
        have hrhs := rhs_nonpos_of_le_half hW (m := 9) (by norm_num) hp2
        norm_num at hrhs
        linarith
      ·
        exact IntermediateRegion.intermediateRegion_odd_cycle_bound hW ⟨4, by norm_num⟩
          (by norm_num) (not_le.mp hp2) (not_le.mp hp)

name: OddCycleBound.odd_cycle_bound
statement:
theorem odd_cycle_bound {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm9 : m ≤ 9
  · exact small_cycle_bound hW hm hm3 hm9
  · have hm11 : 11 ≤ m := by rcases hm with ⟨k, rfl⟩; omega
    by_cases hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ
    · exact dense_cycle_bound hW hp hm hm3
    · exact intermediate_cycle_bound hW hm hm11 (not_le.mp hp)

name: OddCycleBound.main_results
statement:
theorem main_results :
    
    (∀ {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        (W : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (m : ℕ), IsGraphon W μ → 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ → Odd m → 3 ≤ m →
        cycleDensity μ W m ≥
          edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)) ∧
    
    (∀ {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        (W : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (m : ℕ), IsGraphon W μ → 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ → Odd m → 3 ≤ m →
        cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m ≥
          edgeDensity W μ ^ m + (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ m +
            (pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1) - (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1))) ∧
    
    (∀ {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        (W : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (m : ℕ), IsGraphon W μ → (m = 3 ∨ m = 5 ∨ m = 7) →
        1 / 2 ≤ edgeDensity W μ →
        cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m ≥
          edgeDensity W μ ^ m + (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ m +
            (pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1) - (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1))) ∧
    
    (∀ k m : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 ≤ m →
        cycleDensity (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) m =
          ((k - 1 : ℝ) / k) ^ m + (k - 1 : ℝ) * (-1 / (k : ℝ)) ^ m) ∧
    
    (∀ {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        (W : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (k m : ℕ), 2 ≤ k → Odd m → 3 ≤ m → IsGraphon W μ →
        edgeDensity W μ = 1 - 1 / k →
        cycleDensity (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) m ≤ cycleDensity μ W m) ∧
    
    (∀ {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        (W : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (m : ℕ), Odd m → 3 ≤ m → IsGraphon W μ →
        2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ → edgeDensity W μ < 1 →
        cycleDensity μ W m =
          edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1) →
        ∃ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k ∧ edgeDensity W μ = 1 - 1 / k ∧
          ∃ φ : Ω → Fin k, Measurable φ ∧ Measure.map φ μ = uniformFin k ∧
            ∀ᵐ x ∂(μ.prod μ), W x.1 x.2 = completePartite k (φ x.1) (φ x.2)) ∧
    
    (∀ {Ω : Type u} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
        (W : Ω → Ω → ℝ) (m : ℕ), IsGraphon W μ → 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ → Odd m → 3 ≤ m →
        (cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m - pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1)
            - (edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)) ≥
          (m - 1 : ℝ) * (∫ x, (degree W μ x - edgeDensity W μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ ((m - 1) / 2)) ∧
        (cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m - pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1)
            - (edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)) = 0 ↔
          ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree W μ x = edgeDensity W μ))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ _ _ hW hp hm hm3 => dense_region_main_theorem hW hp hm hm3,
    fun _ _ _ _ hW hp hm hm3 => strengthened_commonality_bound hW hp hm hm3,
    fun _ _ _ _ hW hm hp => strengthened_commonality_bound_short hW hm hp,
    fun _ _ hk hm => cycleDensity_completePartite hk hm,
    fun _ _ _ _ _ hk hm hm3 hW hp => completePartite_minimises hk hm hm3 hW hp,
    fun _ _ _ _ hm hm3 hW hp hp1 heq => completePartite_unique hm hm3 hW hp hp1 heq,
    fun _ _ _ _ hW hp hm hm3 =>
      ⟨commonality_gap_ge_degree_variance hW hp hm hm3, commonality_eq_iff_regular hW hp hm hm3⟩⟩

name: OddCycleBound.goodK_onesKernel
statement: lemma goodK_onesKernel : GoodK (onesKernel (Ω := Ω))
proof:
:=
  ⟨measurable_const, ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun _ _ => by simp [onesKernel]⟩⟩

name: OddCycleBound.goodK_of_isGraphon
statement: lemma goodK_of_isGraphon {U : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hU : IsGraphon U μ) : GoodK U
proof:
:=
  ⟨hU.meas, ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun x y => by

name: OddCycleBound.simpleFunc_eq_finset_sum_range_indicator
statement:
lemma simpleFunc_eq_finset_sum_range_indicator
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] (S : SimpleFunc α ℝ) :
    (fun x => S x) =
      fun x =>
        (SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
          c * ((S ⁻¹' {c}).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  classical
  have hxmem : S x ∈ SimpleFunc.range S := S.mem_range_self x
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (S x)]
  · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem]
  · intro c _hc hne
    have hxnot : x ∉ S ⁻¹' {c} := by
      intro hx
      exact hne (by simpa using hx.symm)
    simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxnot]
  · intro hnot
    exact (hnot hxmem).elim

name: OddCycleBound.abs_indicator_one_sub_indicator_one_le_indicator_symmDiff
statement:
lemma abs_indicator_one_sub_indicator_one_le_indicator_symmDiff
    {α : Type*} (A B : Set α) (x : α) :
proof:
|A.indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x -
        B.indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x| ≤
      (A ∆ B).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
  classical
  by_cases hA : x ∈ A <;> by_cases hB : x ∈ B
  · have hx : x ∉ A ∆ B := by
      simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hA, hB]
    simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem, hA, hB, hx]
  · have hx : x ∈ A ∆ B := by
      simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hA, hB]
    simp [Set.indicator_of_mem, Set.indicator_of_notMem, hA, hB, hx]
  · have hx : x ∈ A ∆ B := by
      simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hA, hB]
    simp [Set.indicator_of_mem, Set.indicator_of_notMem, hA, hB, hx]
  · have hx : x ∉ A ∆ B := by
      simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hA, hB]
    simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem, hA, hB, hx]

name: OddCycleBound.abs_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le
statement:
lemma abs_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le
    {α ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (A B : ι → Set α) (x : α) :
proof:
|(s.sum fun i => c i *
          (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) -
        (s.sum fun i => c i *
          (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)| ≤
      s.sum fun i => |c i| *
        ((A i ∆ B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) := by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs
    (fun i =>
      c i * (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x -
        c i * (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) s).trans ?_
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
  intro i hi
  calc
    |c i * (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x -
        c i * (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x|
        = |c i| *
            |(A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x -
              (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x| := by
          rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul]
    _ ≤ |c i| *
          ((A i ∆ B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (abs_indicator_one_sub_indicator_one_le_indicator_symmDiff
              (A i) (B i) x)
            (abs_nonneg _)

name: OddCycleBound.sq_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le_badSet
statement:
lemma sq_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le_badSet
    {α ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (A B : ι → Set α) (x : α) :
    ((s.sum fun i => c i *
          (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) -
        (s.sum fun i => c i *
          (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)) ^ 2 ≤
      (s.sum fun i => |c i|) ^ 2 *
        ({y : α | ∃ i ∈ s, y ∈ A i ∆ B i}.indicator
          (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : ℝ :=
    (s.sum fun i => c i *
      (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) -
      (s.sum fun i => c i *
        (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)
  let C : ℝ := s.sum fun i => |c i|
  let Bad : Set α := {y : α | ∃ i ∈ s, y ∈ A i ∆ B i}
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => abs_nonneg (c i)
  by_cases hxBad : x ∈ Bad
  · have habsD : |D| ≤ C := by
      dsimp [D, C]
      calc
        |(s.sum fun i => c i *
              (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) -
            (s.sum fun i => c i *
              (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)|
            ≤ s.sum fun i => |c i| *
                ((A i ∆ B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) :=
              abs_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le s c A B x
        _ ≤ s.sum fun i => |c i| := by
              refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
              intro i hi
              have hind :
                  ((A i ∆ B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) ≤ 1 := by
                by_cases hx : x ∈ A i ∆ B i
                · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
                · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
              simpa [mul_one] using
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hind (abs_nonneg (c i))
    have hsq : D ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by
      rw [← sq_abs D]
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg D, hC0, habsD]
    simpa [D, C, Bad, Set.indicator_of_mem hxBad] using hsq
  · have hterm :
        ∀ i ∈ s,
          (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x =
            (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x := by
      intro i hi
      have hnot : x ∉ A i ∆ B i := by
        intro hx
        exact hxBad ⟨i, hi, hx⟩
      by_cases hA : x ∈ A i <;> by_cases hB : x ∈ B i
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem, hA, hB]
      · have hx : x ∈ A i ∆ B i := by
          simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hA, hB]
        exact (hnot hx).elim
      · have hx : x ∈ A i ∆ B i := by
          simp [Set.mem_symmDiff, hA, hB]
        exact (hnot hx).elim
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem, hA, hB]
    have hsum :
        (s.sum fun i => c i *
            (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) =
          (s.sum fun i => c i *
            (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) := by
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro i hi
      rw [hterm i hi]
    simp [Bad, hsum, Set.indicator_of_notMem hxBad]

name: OddCycleBound.integral_sq_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le_badSet
statement:
lemma integral_sq_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le_badSet
    {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (A B : ι → Set α)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, MeasurableSet (A i))
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, MeasurableSet (B i)) :
    ∫ x : α,
        ((s.sum fun i => c i *
              (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) -
            (s.sum fun i => c i *
              (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)) ^ 2 ∂ν
      ≤ (s.sum fun i => |c i|) ^ 2 *
        ν.real {x : α | ∃ i ∈ s, x ∈ A i ∆ B i}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Bad : Set α := {x : α | ∃ i ∈ s, x ∈ A i ∆ B i}
  let C : ℝ := s.sum fun i => |c i|
  let f : α → ℝ := fun x =>
    ((s.sum fun i => c i *
          (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) -
        (s.sum fun i => c i *
          (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)) ^ 2
  let g : α → ℝ := fun x =>
    C ^ 2 * Bad.indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x
  have hBad : MeasurableSet Bad := by
    have hBad' : MeasurableSet (⋃ i ∈ s, A i ∆ B i) := by
      refine Finset.measurableSet_biUnion s ?_
      intro i hi
      rw [Set.symmDiff_def]
      exact ((hA i hi).diff (hB i hi)).union ((hB i hi).diff (hA i hi))
    convert hBad' using 1
    ext x
    simp [Bad]
  have hf_nonneg : 0 ≤ᵐ[ν] f := by
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => sq_nonneg _
  have hg_int : Integrable g ν := by
    have hg_eq : g = Bad.indicator (fun _ : α => C ^ 2) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Bad
      · simp [g, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      · simp [g, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
    rw [hg_eq]
    exact (integrable_const (C ^ 2)).indicator hBad
  have hfg : f ≤ᵐ[ν] g := by
    exact ae_of_all _ fun x => by
      dsimp [f, g, C, Bad]
      exact sq_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le_badSet s c A B x
  have hmono : ∫ x, f x ∂ν ≤ ∫ x, g x ∂ν :=
    integral_mono_of_nonneg hf_nonneg hg_int hfg
  have hg_eq : (∫ x, g x ∂ν) =
      C ^ 2 * ν.real Bad := by
    have hg_fun : g = Bad.indicator (fun _ : α => C ^ 2) := by
      funext x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Bad
      · simp [g, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
      · simp [g, Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]
    rw [hg_fun, integral_indicator_const (C ^ 2) hBad]
    simp [mul_comm]
  rw [hg_eq] at hmono
  simpa [f, C, Bad] using hmono

name: OddCycleBound.integral_sq_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le_sum_symmDiff
statement:
lemma integral_sq_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le_sum_symmDiff
    {α ι : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℝ)
    (A B : ι → Set α)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, MeasurableSet (A i))
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, MeasurableSet (B i)) :
    ∫ x : α,
        ((s.sum fun i => c i *
              (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) -
            (s.sum fun i => c i *
              (B i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)) ^ 2 ∂ν
      ≤ (s.sum fun i => |c i|) ^ 2 *
        (s.sum fun i => ν.real (A i ∆ B i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Bad : Set α := {x : α | ∃ i ∈ s, x ∈ A i ∆ B i}
  have hbase :=
    integral_sq_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le_badSet
      (ν := ν) s c A B hA hB
  have hmeasure : ν.real Bad ≤ s.sum fun i => ν.real (A i ∆ B i) := by
    have h :=
      measureReal_biUnion_finset_le (μ := ν) s
        (fun i => A i ∆ B i)
    have hBad_eq : Bad = ⋃ i ∈ s, A i ∆ B i := by
      ext x
      simp [Bad]
    rw [hBad_eq]
    exact h
  exact hbase.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmeasure
      (sq_nonneg (s.sum fun i => |c i|)))

name: OddCycleBound.integral_sq_simpleFunc_sub_levelSet_replacements_le_sum_symmDiff
statement:
lemma integral_sq_simpleFunc_sub_levelSet_replacements_le_sum_symmDiff
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (S : SimpleFunc α ℝ) (T : ℝ → Set α)
    (hT : ∀ c ∈ SimpleFunc.range S, MeasurableSet (T c)) :
    ∫ x : α,
        (S x -
          ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
            c * (T c).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)) ^ 2 ∂ν
      ≤ ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c => |c|) ^ 2 *
        ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
          ν.real ((S ⁻¹' {c}) ∆ T c))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hbase :=
    integral_sq_finset_weighted_indicator_sum_sub_le_sum_symmDiff
      (ν := ν) (SimpleFunc.range S) (fun c : ℝ => c)
      (fun c : ℝ => S ⁻¹' {c}) T
      (fun c _hc => S.measurableSet_fiber c) hT
  have hS_point : ∀ x : α,
      S x =
        (SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
          c * ((S ⁻¹' {c}).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) := by
    intro x
    exact congrFun (simpleFunc_eq_finset_sum_range_indicator S) x
  simpa [hS_point] using hbase

name: OddCycleBound.integral_sq_simpleFunc_sub_levelSet_replacements_le_uniform_symmDiff
statement:
lemma integral_sq_simpleFunc_sub_levelSet_replacements_le_uniform_symmDiff
    {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α] {ν : Measure α} [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (S : SimpleFunc α ℝ) (T : ℝ → Set α)
    (hT : ∀ c ∈ SimpleFunc.range S, MeasurableSet (T c))
    {η : ℝ}
    (hη : ∀ c ∈ SimpleFunc.range S, ν.real ((S ⁻¹' {c}) ∆ T c) ≤ η) :
    ∫ x : α,
        (S x -
          ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
            c * (T c).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)) ^ 2 ∂ν
      ≤ ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c => |c|) ^ 2 *
        ((SimpleFunc.range S).card * η)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hbase :=
    integral_sq_simpleFunc_sub_levelSet_replacements_le_sum_symmDiff
      (ν := ν) S T hT
  have hsum :
      (SimpleFunc.range S).sum
          (fun c => ν.real ((S ⁻¹' {c}) ∆ T c))
        ≤ (SimpleFunc.range S).sum (fun _c => η) :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum hη
  calc
    ∫ x : α,
        (S x -
          ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
            c * (T c).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x)) ^ 2 ∂ν
        ≤ ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c => |c|) ^ 2 *
          ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
            ν.real ((S ⁻¹' {c}) ∆ T c)) := hbase
    _ ≤ ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c => |c|) ^ 2 *
        ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun _c => η) := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum
            (sq_nonneg ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c => |c|))
    _ = ((SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c => |c|) ^ 2 *
        ((SimpleFunc.range S).card * η) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]

name: OddCycleBound.indicator_biUnion_finset_one_eq_sum_indicator
statement:
lemma indicator_biUnion_finset_one_eq_sum_indicator
    {α ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (A : ι → Set α)
    (hdisj : (s : Set ι).PairwiseDisjoint A) (x : α) :
    ((s.sup A).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x) =
      s.sum fun i => (A i).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : ∃ i ∈ s, x ∈ A i
  · rcases hx with ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩
    have hleft : x ∈ s.sup A := by
      rw [Finset.sup_set_eq_biUnion]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.2
        ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨hi, hxi⟩⟩
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hleft]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hxi]
    · intro j hj hji
      have hxj : x ∉ A j := by
        intro hxj
        have hd : Disjoint (A i) (A j) := hdisj hi hj hji.symm
        exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp hd hxi hxj)
      simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxj]
    · intro hnot
      exact (hnot hi).elim
  · have hleft_sup : x ∉ s.sup A := by
      rw [Finset.sup_set_eq_biUnion]
      intro hxmem
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxmem with ⟨i, hxi'⟩
      rcases Set.mem_iUnion.1 hxi' with ⟨hi, hxi⟩
      exact hx ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hleft_sup]
    symm
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero ?_
    intro i hi
    have hxi : x ∉ A i := by
      intro hmem
      exact hx ⟨i, hi, hmem⟩
    simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hxi]

name: OddCycleBound.finpartition_sup_indicator_one_eq_sum_parts_indicator
statement:
lemma finpartition_sup_indicator_one_eq_sum_parts_indicator
    {α : Type*} {s : Set α} (P : Finpartition s) (x : α) :
    (P.parts.sup id).indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x =
      P.parts.sum fun p => p.indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact indicator_biUnion_finset_one_eq_sum_indicator
    P.parts (fun p : Set α => p) P.disjoint x

name: OddCycleBound.good_indicator_one
statement:
lemma good_indicator_one {s : Set Ω} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    Good (s.indicator fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨stronglyMeasurable_const.indicator hs, 1, zero_le_one, fun x => ?_⟩
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s
  · simp [Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
  · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hx]

name: OddCycleBound.goodK_separable
statement:
lemma goodK_separable {a b : Ω → ℝ} (ha : Good a) (hb : Good b) :
    GoodK (fun x y => a x * b y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Ca, hCa0, hCa⟩ := ha.bdd
  obtain ⟨Cb, hCb0, hCb⟩ := hb.bdd
  refine ⟨?_, Ca * Cb, mul_nonneg hCa0 hCb0, fun x y => ?_⟩
  · exact ((ha.meas.comp_measurable measurable_fst).mul
      (hb.meas.comp_measurable measurable_snd)).measurable
  · rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hCa x) (hCb y) (abs_nonneg _) hCa0

name: OddCycleBound.indicator_prod_one_eq_mul_indicator_one
statement:
lemma indicator_prod_one_eq_mul_indicator_one
    {α β : Type*} (s : Set α) (t : Set β) (x : α) (y : β) :
    (s ×ˢ t).indicator (fun _ : α × β => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y) =
      s.indicator (fun _ : α => (1 : ℝ)) x *
        t.indicator (fun _ : β => (1 : ℝ)) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> by_cases hy : y ∈ t
  · have hxy : (x, y) ∈ s ×ˢ t := ⟨hx, hy⟩
    simp [Set.indicator_of_mem, hx, hy, hxy]
  · have hxy : (x, y) ∉ s ×ˢ t := by
      intro hmem
      exact hy hmem.2
    simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem, hx, hy, hxy]
  · have hxy : (x, y) ∉ s ×ˢ t := by
      intro hmem
      exact hx hmem.1
    simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem, hx, hy, hxy]
  · have hxy : (x, y) ∉ s ×ˢ t := by
      intro hmem
      exact hx hmem.1
    simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem, hx, hy, hxy]

name: OddCycleBound.goodK_zero
statement: lemma goodK_zero : GoodK (fun _x _y : Ω => (0 : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  ⟨measurable_const, 0, le_rfl, fun _ _ => by simp⟩

name: OddCycleBound.goodK_add
statement:
lemma goodK_add {K L : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hK : GoodK K) (hL : GoodK L) :
    GoodK (fun x y => K x y + L x y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨CK, hCK0, hCK⟩ := hK.bdd
  obtain ⟨CL, hCL0, hCL⟩ := hL.bdd
  refine ⟨hK.meas.add hL.meas, CK + CL, add_nonneg hCK0 hCL0, fun x y => ?_⟩
  exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (hCK x y) (hCL x y))

name: OddCycleBound.goodK_finset_sum
statement:
lemma goodK_finset_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (K : ι → Ω → Ω → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ i ∈ s, GoodK (K i)) :
    GoodK (fun x y => ∑ i ∈ s, K i x y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  revert hK
  refine Finset.induction_on s ?base ?step
  · intro _hK
    simpa using (goodK_zero (Ω := Ω))
  · intro a s ha ih hK
    have hKa : GoodK (K a) := hK a (by simp)
    have hsum : GoodK (fun x y => ∑ i ∈ s, K i x y) := by
      exact ih fun i hi => hK i (by simp [hi])
    simpa [Finset.sum_insert ha] using goodK_add hKa hsum

name: OddCycleBound.goodK_finset_weighted_rectIndicator_sum
statement:
lemma goodK_finset_weighted_rectIndicator_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (c : ι → ℝ) (A B : ι → Set Ω)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ s, MeasurableSet (A i))
    (hB : ∀ i ∈ s, MeasurableSet (B i)) :
    GoodK (fun x y =>
      ∑ i ∈ s,
        c i *
          ((A i).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) x *
            (B i).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y))
proof:
:= by
  refine goodK_finset_sum s
    (fun i x y =>
      c i *
        ((A i).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) x *
          (B i).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y)) ?_
  intro i hi
  simpa [mul_assoc] using
    goodK_separable
      (good_smul (c i) (good_indicator_one (Ω := Ω) (hA i hi)))
      (good_indicator_one (Ω := Ω) (hB i hi))

name: OddCycleBound.finset_weighted_rectIndicator_sum_eq_separable_sum
statement:
lemma finset_weighted_rectIndicator_sum_eq_separable_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι)
    (c : ι → ℝ) (A B : ι → Set Ω) :
    (fun x y =>
      ∑ i ∈ s,
        c i *
          ((A i).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) x *
            (B i).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y))
      =
    fun x y =>
      ∑ i ∈ s,
        (c i • (A i).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) : Ω → ℝ) x *
          (B i).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y
proof:
:= by
  funext x y
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
  intro i hi
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: OddCycleBound.measurableRectangles.mem
proof:
:=
  ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩

name: OddCycleBound.measurableRectangles.left_meas
statement:
lemma measurableRectangles.left_meas
    {R : Set (Ω × Ω)} (hR : R ∈ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    MeasurableSet (measurableRectangles.left (Ω := Ω) hR)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec hR).1

name: OddCycleBound.measurableRectangles.right_meas
statement:
lemma measurableRectangles.right_meas
    {R : Set (Ω × Ω)} (hR : R ∈ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    MeasurableSet (measurableRectangles.right (Ω := Ω) hR)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec hR).2).1

name: OddCycleBound.measurableRectangles.prod_eq
statement:
lemma measurableRectangles.prod_eq
    {R : Set (Ω × Ω)} (hR : R ∈ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    measurableRectangles.left (Ω := Ω) hR ×ˢ
      measurableRectangles.right (Ω := Ω) hR = R

:=

name: OddCycleBound.measurableSet_of_mem_measurableRectangles
statement:
lemma measurableSet_of_mem_measurableRectangles
    {R : Set (Ω × Ω)} (hR : R ∈ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    MeasurableSet R
proof:
:= by
  rcases hR with ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩
  exact hs.prod ht

name: OddCycleBound.measurableSet_finpartition_sup_of_measurableRectangles
statement:
lemma measurableSet_finpartition_sup_of_measurableRectangles
    {t : Set (Ω × Ω)} (P : Finpartition t)
    (hP : ↑P.parts ⊆ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    MeasurableSet (P.parts.sup id)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sup_set_eq_biUnion]
  exact MeasurableSet.biUnion P.parts.finite_toSet.countable
    fun R hR => measurableSet_of_mem_measurableRectangles (Ω := Ω) (hP hR)

name: OddCycleBound.measurableRectangles_empty
statement:
lemma measurableRectangles_empty :
    (∅ : Set (Ω × Ω)) ∈ measurableRectangles Ω
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    (measurableRectangles.mem (Ω := Ω)
      (s := (∅ : Set Ω)) (t := (∅ : Set Ω))
      MeasurableSet.empty MeasurableSet.empty)

name: OddCycleBound.measurableRectangles_univ
statement:
lemma measurableRectangles_univ :
    (Set.univ : Set (Ω × Ω)) ∈ measurableRectangles Ω
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Set.univ_prod_univ] using
    (measurableRectangles.mem (Ω := Ω)
      (s := (Set.univ : Set Ω)) (t := (Set.univ : Set Ω))
      MeasurableSet.univ MeasurableSet.univ)

name: OddCycleBound.measurableRectangles_inter_mem
statement:
lemma measurableRectangles_inter_mem
    {A B : Set (Ω × Ω)}
    (hA : A ∈ measurableRectangles Ω) (hB : B ∈ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    A ∩ B ∈ measurableRectangles Ω
proof:
:= by
  rcases hA with ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩
  simpa [Set.prod_inter_prod] using
    (measurableRectangles.mem (Ω := Ω)
      (s := s ∩ u) (t := t ∩ v)
      (hs.inter hu) (ht.inter hv))

name: OddCycleBound.measurableRectangles_sdiff_eq_sUnion
statement:
lemma measurableRectangles_sdiff_eq_sUnion
    {A B : Set (Ω × Ω)}
    (hA : A ∈ measurableRectangles Ω) (hB : B ∈ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    ∃ I : Finset (Set (Ω × Ω)),
      ↑I ⊆ measurableRectangles Ω ∧
        (I : Set (Set (Ω × Ω))).PairwiseDisjoint id ∧
          A \ B = ⋃₀ (I : Set (Set (Ω × Ω)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases hA with ⟨s, hs, t, ht, rfl⟩
  rcases hB with ⟨u, hu, v, hv, rfl⟩
  let R₀ : Set (Ω × Ω) := (s \ u) ×ˢ t
  let R₁ : Set (Ω × Ω) := (s ∩ u) ×ˢ (t \ v)
  refine ⟨{R₀, R₁}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro R hR
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hR
    rcases hR with rfl | rfl
    · exact measurableRectangles.mem (Ω := Ω) (hs.diff hu) ht
    · exact measurableRectangles.mem (Ω := Ω) (hs.inter hu) (ht.diff hv)
  · rw [Set.PairwiseDisjoint, Set.Pairwise]
    intro a ha b hb hne
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha hb
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl
    · exact (hne rfl).elim
    · change Disjoint R₀ R₁
      rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      ext x
      simp [R₀, R₁]
      tauto
    · change Disjoint R₁ R₀
      rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      ext x
      simp [R₀, R₁]
      tauto
    · exact (hne rfl).elim
  · rw [Set.prod_sdiff_prod]
    ext x
    simp [R₀, R₁]
    tauto

name: OddCycleBound.isSetSemiring_measurableRectangles
statement:
theorem isSetSemiring_measurableRectangles :
    IsSetSemiring (measurableRectangles Ω) where
  empty_mem
proof:
:= measurableRectangles_empty (Ω := Ω)
  inter_mem := fun _ hs _ ht => measurableRectangles_inter_mem hs ht
  sdiff_eq_sUnion' := fun _ hs _ ht => measurableRectangles_sdiff_eq_sUnion hs ht

name: OddCycleBound.generateFrom_measurableRectangles
statement:
lemma generateFrom_measurableRectangles :
    MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (measurableRectangles Ω) =
      (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace (Ω × Ω))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [measurableRectangles] using
    (generateFrom_prod (α := Ω) (β := Ω))

name: OddCycleBound.exists_prod_measure_symmDiff_lt_supClosure_measurableRectangles
statement:
lemma exists_prod_measure_symmDiff_lt_supClosure_measurableRectangles
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {s : Set (Ω × Ω)} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ t ∈ supClosure (measurableRectangles Ω),
      μ.prod μ (t ∆ s) < ε
proof:
:= by
  have hcover :
      ∃ D : Set (Set (Ω × Ω)),
        D.Countable ∧ D ⊆ measurableRectangles Ω ∧
          μ.prod μ (⋃₀ D)ᶜ = 0 := by
    refine ⟨{Set.univ}, Set.countable_singleton _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      simpa using ht ▸ measurableRectangles_univ (Ω := Ω)
    · simp
  exact
    exists_measure_symmDiff_lt_of_generateFrom_isSetSemiring
      (μ := μ.prod μ)
      (mα := inferInstance)
      isSetSemiring_measurableRectangles hcover
      (by rw [eq_comm, generateFrom_measurableRectangles]) hs hε

name: OddCycleBound.exists_finpartition_measurableRectangles_symmDiff_lt
statement:
lemma exists_finpartition_measurableRectangles_symmDiff_lt
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {s : Set (Ω × Ω)} (hs : MeasurableSet s)
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ t, ∃ P : Finpartition t,
      ↑P.parts ⊆ measurableRectangles Ω ∧ μ.prod μ (t ∆ s) < ε
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_prod_measure_symmDiff_lt_supClosure_measurableRectangles
      (Ω := Ω) μ hs hε with ⟨t, ht, hμt⟩
  rcases (isSetSemiring_measurableRectangles (Ω := Ω)).mem_supClosure_iff.mp ht with
    ⟨P, hP⟩
  exact ⟨t, P, hP, hμt⟩

name: OddCycleBound.exists_rectIndicator_sum_eq_finpartition_sup
statement:
lemma exists_rectIndicator_sum_eq_finpartition_sup
    {t : Set (Ω × Ω)} (P : Finpartition t)
    (hP : ↑P.parts ⊆ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    ∃ A B : Set (Ω × Ω) → Set Ω,
      (∀ R ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet (A R)) ∧
      (∀ R ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet (B R)) ∧
      (fun x y =>
          (P.parts.sup id).indicator
            (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y))
        =
        fun x y =>
          P.parts.sum fun R =>
            (A R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) x *
              (B R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A : Set (Ω × Ω) → Set Ω := fun R =>
    if hR : R ∈ measurableRectangles Ω then
      measurableRectangles.left (Ω := Ω) hR
    else ∅
  let B : Set (Ω × Ω) → Set Ω := fun R =>
    if hR : R ∈ measurableRectangles Ω then
      measurableRectangles.right (Ω := Ω) hR
    else ∅
  refine ⟨A, B, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro R hR
    have hrect : R ∈ measurableRectangles Ω := hP hR
    simp [A, hrect, measurableRectangles.left_meas]
  · intro R hR
    have hrect : R ∈ measurableRectangles Ω := hP hR
    simp [B, hrect, measurableRectangles.right_meas]
  · funext x y
    rw [finpartition_sup_indicator_one_eq_sum_parts_indicator P (x, y)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
    intro R hR
    have hrect : R ∈ measurableRectangles Ω := hP hR
    have hprod := measurableRectangles.prod_eq (Ω := Ω) hrect
    calc
      R.indicator (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y)
          =
        (measurableRectangles.left (Ω := Ω) hrect ×ˢ
          measurableRectangles.right (Ω := Ω) hrect).indicator
            (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y) := by
            rw [hprod]
      _ =
          (measurableRectangles.left (Ω := Ω) hrect).indicator
              (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) x *
            (measurableRectangles.right (Ω := Ω) hrect).indicator
              (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y := by
            exact indicator_prod_one_eq_mul_indicator_one
              (measurableRectangles.left (Ω := Ω) hrect)
              (measurableRectangles.right (Ω := Ω) hrect) x y
      _ =
          (A R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) x *
            (B R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y := by
            simp [A, B, hrect]

name: OddCycleBound.exists_finpartition_sup_rectIndicator_finiteRank_data
statement:
lemma exists_finpartition_sup_rectIndicator_finiteRank_data
    {t : Set (Ω × Ω)} (P : Finpartition t)
    (hP : ↑P.parts ⊆ measurableRectangles Ω) (c : ℝ) :
    ∃ A B : Set (Ω × Ω) → Set Ω,
      (∀ R ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet (A R)) ∧
      (∀ R ∈ P.parts, MeasurableSet (B R)) ∧
      GoodK
        (fun x y =>
          c * (P.parts.sup id).indicator
            (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y)) ∧
      (∀ x y,
        |c * (P.parts.sup id).indicator
            (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y)| ≤ |c|) ∧
      (∀ x y,
        c * (P.parts.sup id).indicator
            (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y) =
          P.parts.sum fun R =>
            (c • (A R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) : Ω → ℝ) x *
              (B R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y) ∧
      (∀ R ∈ P.parts,
        Good (c • (A R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) : Ω → ℝ)) ∧
      (∀ R ∈ P.parts,
        Good ((B R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) : Ω → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases exists_rectIndicator_sum_eq_finpartition_sup
      (Ω := Ω) P hP with ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hsum⟩
  refine ⟨A, B, hA, hB, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hKsum :
        GoodK
          (fun x y =>
            P.parts.sum fun R =>
              c * ((A R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) x *
                (B R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y)) :=
      goodK_finset_weighted_rectIndicator_sum
        (Ω := Ω) P.parts (fun _ : Set (Ω × Ω) => c) A B hA hB
    convert hKsum using 2
    funext y
    rw [congrFun (congrFun hsum _) y, Finset.mul_sum]
  · intro x y
    have hind :
        |(P.parts.sup id).indicator
            (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y)| ≤ 1 := by
      by_cases hxy : ∃ R ∈ P.parts, (x, y) ∈ R
      · simp [Set.indicator, hxy]
      · simp [Set.indicator, hxy]
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg c) hind
  · intro x y
    calc
      c * (P.parts.sup id).indicator
          (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y)
          =
        c *
          (P.parts.sum fun R =>
            (A R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) x *
              (B R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y) := by
            rw [congrFun (congrFun hsum x) y]
      _ =
          P.parts.sum fun R =>
            c * ((A R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) x *
              (B R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y) := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      _ =
          P.parts.sum fun R =>
            (c • (A R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) : Ω → ℝ) x *
              (B R).indicator (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y := by
            exact congrFun
              (congrFun
                (finset_weighted_rectIndicator_sum_eq_separable_sum
                  (Ω := Ω) P.parts (fun _ : Set (Ω × Ω) => c) A B) x) y
  · intro R hR
    exact good_smul c (good_indicator_one (Ω := Ω) (hA R hR))
  · intro R hR
    exact good_indicator_one (Ω := Ω) (hB R hR)

name: OddCycleBound.goodK_simpleFunc_rectangular_replacement
statement:
lemma goodK_simpleFunc_rectangular_replacement
    (S : SimpleFunc (Ω × Ω) ℝ)
    (T : ℝ → Set (Ω × Ω))
    (P : ∀ c, c ∈ SimpleFunc.range S → Finpartition (T c))
    (hP : ∀ c (hc : c ∈ SimpleFunc.range S),
      ↑(P c hc).parts ⊆ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    GoodK
      (fun x y =>
        (SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
          c * (T c).indicator (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine goodK_finset_sum (Ω := Ω) (SimpleFunc.range S)
    (fun c x y =>
      c * (T c).indicator (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y)) ?_
  intro c hc
  rcases exists_finpartition_sup_rectIndicator_finiteRank_data
      (Ω := Ω) (P c hc) (hP c hc) c with
    ⟨_A, _B, _hA, _hB, hGoodK, _hbound, _hsep, _ha, _hb⟩
  simpa [(P c hc).sup_parts] using hGoodK

name: OddCycleBound.abs_simpleFunc_rectangular_replacement_le
statement:
lemma abs_simpleFunc_rectangular_replacement_le
    (S : SimpleFunc (Ω × Ω) ℝ)
    (T : ℝ → Set (Ω × Ω))
    (P : ∀ c, c ∈ SimpleFunc.range S → Finpartition (T c))
    (hP : ∀ c (hc : c ∈ SimpleFunc.range S),
      ↑(P c hc).parts ⊆ measurableRectangles Ω)
    (x y : Ω) :
proof:
|(SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
        c * (T c).indicator (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y)|
      ≤ (SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c => |c| := by
  classical
  refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs
    (fun c =>
      c * (T c).indicator (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y))
    (SimpleFunc.range S)).trans ?_
  refine Finset.sum_le_sum ?_
  intro c hc
  rcases exists_finpartition_sup_rectIndicator_finiteRank_data
      (Ω := Ω) (P c hc) (hP c hc) c with
    ⟨_A, _B, _hA, _hB, _hGoodK, hbound, _hsep, _ha, _hb⟩
  simpa [(P c hc).sup_parts] using hbound x y

name: OddCycleBound.exists_simpleFunc_rectangular_replacement_finiteRank_data
statement:
lemma exists_simpleFunc_rectangular_replacement_finiteRank_data
    (S : SimpleFunc (Ω × Ω) ℝ)
    (T : ℝ → Set (Ω × Ω))
    (P : ∀ c, c ∈ SimpleFunc.range S → Finpartition (T c))
    (hP : ∀ c (hc : c ∈ SimpleFunc.range S),
      ↑(P c hc).parts ⊆ measurableRectangles Ω) :
    ∃ J : Type u, ∃ hJ : Fintype J,
    ∃ K : Ω → Ω → ℝ, ∃ Bnd : ℝ,
    ∃ a b : J → Ω → ℝ,
      (∀ x y,
        K x y =
          (SimpleFunc.range S).sum fun c =>
            c * (T c).indicator (fun _ : Ω × Ω => (1 : ℝ)) (x, y)) ∧
      GoodK K ∧
      0 ≤ Bnd ∧
      (∀ x y, |K x y| ≤ Bnd) ∧
      (∀ j, Good (a j)) ∧
      (∀ j, Good (b j)) ∧
