  simp [RCLike.inner_apply, mul_comm]

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.L2Kernel.abs_inner_goodL2_kernelOpL2OfGood_self_le_abs
statement:
lemma abs_inner_goodL2_kernelOpL2OfGood_self_le_abs
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    {f : Omega -> Real} (hf : Good f) :
    |inner Real (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf)
        (kernelOpL2OfGood (mu := mu) hW hf)| <=
      inner Real
        (goodL2 (mu := mu) (good_abs hf))
        (kernelOpL2OfGood (mu := mu) hW (good_abs hf))
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_goodL2_kernelOpL2OfGood_eq_integral hW hf hf,
    inner_goodL2_kernelOpL2OfGood_eq_integral hW (good_abs hf) (good_abs hf)]
  calc
    |∫ x, f x * kernelOp W mu f x ∂mu|
        <= ∫ x, |f x * kernelOp W mu f x| ∂mu := by
          exact abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ <= ∫ x, |f x| * kernelOp W mu (fun y : Omega => |f y|) x ∂mu := by
          refine integral_mono
            ((hf.mul (good_kernelOp hW hf)).integrable).abs
            ((good_abs hf).mul (good_kernelOp hW (good_abs hf))).integrable ?_
          intro x
          change |f x * kernelOp W mu f x| <=
            |f x| * kernelOp W mu (fun y : Omega => |f y|) x
          rw [abs_mul]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (abs_kernelOp_le_kernelOp_abs hW hf x) (abs_nonneg (f x))

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.L2Kernel.abs_inner_goodL2_kernelOpCLM_self_le_abs
statement:
lemma abs_inner_goodL2_kernelOpCLM_self_le_abs
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    {f : Omega -> Real} (hf : Good f) :
    |inner Real (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf)
        (kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf))| <=
      inner Real
        |goodL2 (mu := mu) hf|
        (kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW |goodL2 (mu := mu) hf|)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernelOpCLM_goodL2 (mu := mu) hW hf]
  rw [← goodL2_abs (mu := mu) hf]
  rw [kernelOpCLM_goodL2 (mu := mu) hW (good_abs hf)]
  exact abs_inner_goodL2_kernelOpL2OfGood_self_le_abs (mu := mu) hW hf

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.L2Kernel.kernelOpL2OfGood_selfadj
statement:
lemma kernelOpL2OfGood_selfadj (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    {f g : Omega -> Real} (hf : Good f) (hg : Good g) :
    inner Real (kernelOpL2OfGood (mu := mu) hW hf)
        (goodL2 (mu := mu) hg) =
      inner Real (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf)
        (kernelOpL2OfGood (mu := mu) hW hg)
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_kernelOpL2OfGood_goodL2_eq_integral hW hf hg,
    inner_goodL2_kernelOpL2OfGood_eq_integral hW hg hf]
  exact kernelOp_symm hW hf hg

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.L2Kernel.kernelOpCLM_isSymmetric
statement:
lemma kernelOpCLM_isSymmetric (hW : IsGraphon W mu) :
    (kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW :
      Lp Real 2 mu →ₗ[Real] Lp Real 2 mu).IsSymmetric
proof:
:= by
  intro f g
  let e : Lp.simpleFunc Real 2 mu -> Lp Real 2 mu :=
    fun s => (s : Lp Real 2 mu)
  have hdense : DenseRange e :=
    Lp.simpleFunc.denseRange (E := Real) (p := (2 : ENNReal)) (μ := mu)
      (by norm_num)
  refine hdense.induction_on₂
    (p := fun f g =>
      inner Real (kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW f) g =
        inner Real f (kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW g))
    ?closed ?simple f g
  · exact isClosed_eq (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
  · intro s t
    dsimp [e]
    rw [kernelOpCLM_simpleFunc hW s, kernelOpCLM_simpleFunc hW t]
    dsimp [kernelOpSimple]
    have h :=
      kernelOpL2OfGood_selfadj (mu := mu) hW
        (simpleFunc_good (mu := mu) s) (simpleFunc_good (mu := mu) t)
    simpa [goodL2_simpleFunc_eq_coe (mu := mu) s,
      goodL2_simpleFunc_eq_coe (mu := mu) t] using h

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.L2Kernel.inner_oneL2_degreeL2_eq_edgeDensity
statement:
lemma inner_oneL2_degreeL2_eq_edgeDensity
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu) :
    inner Real (oneL2 (Omega := Omega) mu) (degreeL2 hW) =
      edgeDensity W mu
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
  have hone := oneL2_ae_eq_one (Omega := Omega) (mu := mu)
  have hdeg : (degreeL2 hW : Omega -> Real) =ᵐ[mu] degree W mu := by
    change
      ((degree_memLp_two hW).toLp (degree W mu) : Omega -> Real) =ᵐ[mu]
        degree W mu
    exact MemLp.coeFn_toLp (degree_memLp_two hW)
  calc
    (∫ x : Omega,
        inner Real ((oneL2 (Omega := Omega) mu : Lp Real 2 mu) x)
          ((degreeL2 hW : Lp Real 2 mu) x) ∂mu)
        = ∫ x : Omega, (1 : Real) * degree W mu x ∂mu := by
          refine integral_congr_ae ?_
          filter_upwards [hone, hdeg] with x hxone hxdeg
          rw [hxone, hxdeg]
          simp
    _ = edgeDensity W mu := integral_one_mul_degree_eq_edgeDensity

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.L2Kernel.inner_oneL2_oneL2
statement:
lemma inner_oneL2_oneL2 :
    inner Real (oneL2 (Omega := Omega) mu) (oneL2 (Omega := Omega) mu) =
      1
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
  have hone := oneL2_ae_eq_one (Omega := Omega) (mu := mu)
  calc
    (∫ x : Omega,
        inner Real ((oneL2 (Omega := Omega) mu : Lp Real 2 mu) x)
          ((oneL2 (Omega := Omega) mu : Lp Real 2 mu) x) ∂mu)
        = ∫ _x : Omega, (1 : Real) ∂mu := by
          refine integral_congr_ae ?_
          filter_upwards [hone] with x hxone
          rw [hxone]
          simp
    _ = 1 := by simp

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.L2Kernel.norm_oneL2_sq
statement:
lemma norm_oneL2_sq :
    ‖oneL2 (Omega := Omega) mu‖ ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_oneL2_oneL2]

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.compactSelfAdjointSkeleton
statement:
theorem compactSelfAdjointSkeleton
    {T : E →L[𝕜] E}
    (hcompact : IsCompactOperator T)
    (hsymm : T.IsSymmetric) :
    CompactSelfAdjointSkeleton T where
  orthogonal_family_eigenspaces
proof:
:=
    LinearMap.IsSymmetric.orthogonalFamily_eigenspaces
      (T := (T : End 𝕜 E)) hsymm
  eigenspaces_complete :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.orthogonalComplement_iSup_eigenspaces_eq_bot
      hcompact hsymm
  finite_dimensional_nonzero_eigenspace :=
    fun μ hμ =>
      ContinuousLinearMap.finite_dimensional_eigenspace
        (T := T) hcompact μ hμ
  zero_iff_only_zero_eigenvalue :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.eq_zero_of_forall_hasEigenvalue_eq_zero
      hcompact hsymm

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.symmetric_range_le_orthogonal_zero_eigenspace
statement:
theorem symmetric_range_le_orthogonal_zero_eigenspace
    {T : E →L[𝕜] E}
    (hsymm : T.IsSymmetric) :
    LinearMap.range T.toLinearMap ≤
      (eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) 0)ᗮ
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal]
  rcases LinearMap.mem_range.mp hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  intro u hu
  have hTu : T u = 0 := by
    simpa using hu
  calc
    inner 𝕜 u (T x) = inner 𝕜 (T u) x := by
      simpa using (hsymm u x).symm
    _ = 0 := by simp [hTu]

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.compactSelfAdjoint_nonzero_iSup_orthogonal_inf_zero_eigenspace_orthogonal_eq_bot
statement:
theorem compactSelfAdjoint_nonzero_iSup_orthogonal_inf_zero_eigenspace_orthogonal_eq_bot
    {T : E →L[𝕜] E}
    (hcompact : IsCompactOperator T)
    (hsymm : T.IsSymmetric) :
    ((⨆ lambda : {lambda : 𝕜 // lambda ≠ 0},
        eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) lambda.1)ᗮ ⊓
      (eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) 0)ᗮ) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let N : Submodule 𝕜 E :=
    ⨆ lambda : {lambda : 𝕜 // lambda ≠ 0},
      eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) lambda.1
  let Z : Submodule 𝕜 E := eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) 0
  have hcover : N ⊔ Z = ⨆ lambda : 𝕜, eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) lambda := by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · refine sup_le ?_ ?_
      · refine iSup_le ?_
        intro lambda
        exact le_iSup (fun lambda : 𝕜 =>
          eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) lambda) lambda.1
      · exact le_iSup (fun lambda : 𝕜 =>
          eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) lambda) 0
    · refine iSup_le ?_
      intro lambda
      by_cases hlambda : lambda = 0
      · subst lambda
        exact le_sup_right
      · have hleN :
            eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) lambda ≤ N :=
          le_iSup (fun lambda : {lambda : 𝕜 // lambda ≠ 0} =>
            eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) lambda.1) ⟨lambda, hlambda⟩
        exact hleN.trans le_sup_left
  calc
    ((⨆ lambda : {lambda : 𝕜 // lambda ≠ 0},
        eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) lambda.1)ᗮ ⊓
      (eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) 0)ᗮ)
        = Nᗮ ⊓ Zᗮ := by rfl
    _ = (N ⊔ Z)ᗮ := Submodule.inf_orthogonal N Z
    _ = (⨆ lambda : 𝕜, eigenspace (T : End 𝕜 E) lambda)ᗮ := by
      rw [hcover]
    _ = ⊥ :=
      (compactSelfAdjointSkeleton hcompact hsymm).eigenspaces_complete

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.selfAdjoint_eigenvectors_orthogonal_of_ne
statement:
theorem selfAdjoint_eigenvectors_orthogonal_of_ne
    {T : H →L[Real] H}
    (hsymm : T.IsSymmetric)
    {lambda mu : Real} (hneq : lambda ≠ mu) {v w : H}
    (hv : Module.End.HasEigenvector T.toLinearMap lambda v)
    (hw : Module.End.HasEigenvector T.toLinearMap mu w) :
    inner Real w v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have horth :=
    (LinearMap.IsSymmetric.orthogonalFamily_eigenspaces
      (T := (T : End Real H)) hsymm).pairwise hneq
  exact horth hv.1 w hw.1

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.dist_smul_orthonormal_sq
statement:
private lemma dist_smul_orthonormal_sq
    {mode : Nat → H} (horth : Orthonormal Real mode)
    {i j : Nat} (hij : i ≠ j) (a b : Real) :
    dist (a • mode i) (b • mode j) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hinner_mode : inner Real (mode i) (mode j) = 0 :=
    horth.inner_eq_zero hij
  have hinner : inner Real (a • mode i) (b • mode j) = 0 := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, hinner_mode]
    ring
  have hnorm_i : ‖mode i‖ = 1 := horth.norm_eq_one i
  have hnorm_j : ‖mode j‖ = 1 := horth.norm_eq_one j
  calc
    dist (a • mode i) (b • mode j) ^ 2
        = ‖a • mode i - b • mode j‖ ^ 2 := by rw [dist_eq_norm]
    _ = ‖a • mode i‖ ^ 2 + ‖b • mode j‖ ^ 2 := by
        simpa [pow_two] using
          norm_sub_sq_eq_norm_sq_add_norm_sq_real hinner
    _ = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
        simp [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hnorm_i, hnorm_j, sq_abs]

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.le_dist_smul_orthonormal_of_le_abs
statement:
private lemma le_dist_smul_orthonormal_of_le_abs
    {mode : Nat → H} (horth : Orthonormal Real mode)
    {i j : Nat} (hij : i ≠ j) {eps a b : Real}
    (heps : 0 < eps) (ha : eps ≤ |a|) :
    eps ≤ dist (a • mode i) (b • mode j)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  have hlt : dist (a • mode i) (b • mode j) < eps :=
    lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hlt_sq :
      dist (a • mode i) (b • mode j) ^ 2 < eps ^ 2 := by
    refine sq_lt_sq.mpr ?_
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg dist_nonneg, abs_of_pos heps] using hlt
  have ha_sq : eps ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2 := by
    exact sq_le_sq.mpr (by simpa [abs_of_pos heps] using ha)
  have hdist_sq :=
    dist_smul_orthonormal_sq (H := H) horth hij a b
  have hdist_ge : eps ^ 2 ≤ dist (a • mode i) (b • mode j) ^ 2 := by
    rw [hdist_sq]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
  nlinarith

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.compactOperator_no_orthonormal_eigen_subsequence_bounded_away
statement:
theorem compactOperator_no_orthonormal_eigen_subsequence_bounded_away
    {T : H →L[Real] H}
    (hcompact : IsCompactOperator T)
    {mode : Nat → H} {eigen : Nat → Real}
    (horth : Orthonormal Real mode)
    (hdiag : ∀ n, T (mode n) = eigen n • mode n)
    {φ : Nat → Nat} (hφ : StrictMono φ)
    {eps : Real} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hlower : ∀ n, eps ≤ |eigen (φ n)|) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hsub⟩ := hcompact.image_closedBall_subset_compact 1
  let yseq : Nat → H := fun n => T (mode (φ n))
  have hyseq : ∀ n, yseq n ∈ K := by
    intro n
    apply hsub
    refine ⟨mode (φ n), ?_, rfl⟩
    simp [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm, horth.norm_eq_one (φ n)]
  obtain ⟨y, _hyK, ψ, hψ, hlim⟩ := hK.tendsto_subseq hyseq
  have hhalf : 0 < eps / 2 := by linarith
  have hev : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, yseq (ψ n) ∈ Metric.ball y (eps / 2) :=
    hlim (Metric.ball_mem_nhds y hhalf)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hev
  have hN0 : dist (yseq (ψ N)) y < eps / 2 := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hN N le_rfl
  have hN1 : dist (yseq (ψ (N + 1))) y < eps / 2 := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hN (N + 1) (Nat.le_succ N)
  have hdist_lt : dist (yseq (ψ N)) (yseq (ψ (N + 1))) < eps := by
    calc
      dist (yseq (ψ N)) (yseq (ψ (N + 1)))
          ≤ dist (yseq (ψ N)) y + dist y (yseq (ψ (N + 1))) :=
            dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = dist (yseq (ψ N)) y + dist (yseq (ψ (N + 1))) y := by
            rw [dist_comm y (yseq (ψ (N + 1)))]
      _ < eps := by linarith
  have hidx_ne : φ (ψ N) ≠ φ (ψ (N + 1)) := by
    exact ne_of_lt (hφ (hψ (Nat.lt_succ_self N)))
  have hdist_ge : eps ≤ dist (yseq (ψ N)) (yseq (ψ (N + 1))) := by
    have hbase :=
      le_dist_smul_orthonormal_of_le_abs
        (H := H) horth hidx_ne heps (hlower (ψ N))
        (b := eigen (φ (ψ (N + 1))))
    simpa [yseq, hdiag] using hbase
  exact not_lt_of_ge hdist_ge hdist_lt

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.exists_unit_eigenvector_of_hasEigenvalue
statement:
private theorem exists_unit_eigenvector_of_hasEigenvalue
    {T : H →L[Real] H} {lambda : Real}
    (hlambda : Module.End.HasEigenvalue T.toLinearMap lambda) :
    ∃ v : H, v ≠ 0 ∧ ‖v‖ = 1 ∧ T v = lambda • v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hlambda.exists_hasEigenvector
  let u : H := (‖v‖)⁻¹ • v
  have hvne : v ≠ 0 := hv.2
  have hvnorm_ne : ‖v‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hvne
  have hvact : T v = lambda • v := by
    simpa using hv.apply_eq_smul
  have hunorm : ‖u‖ = 1 := by
    dsimp [u]
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg v))]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hvnorm_ne
  have huact : T u = lambda • u := by
    dsimp [u]
    calc
      T ((‖v‖)⁻¹ • v) = (‖v‖)⁻¹ • T v := by simp
      _ = (‖v‖)⁻¹ • (lambda • v) := by rw [hvact]
      _ = lambda • ((‖v‖)⁻¹ • v) := by
          rw [smul_smul, smul_smul]
          ring_nf
  have hune : u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have : ‖u‖ = 0 := by simp [hzero]
    linarith
  exact ⟨u, hune, hunorm, huact⟩

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.compactSelfAdjoint_no_distinct_eigenvalue_sequence_bounded_away
statement:
theorem compactSelfAdjoint_no_distinct_eigenvalue_sequence_bounded_away
    {T : H →L[Real] H}
    (hcompact : IsCompactOperator T)
    (hsymm : T.IsSymmetric)
    {lambda : Nat → Real}
    (heigen :
      ∀ n, Module.End.HasEigenvalue T.toLinearMap (lambda n))
    (hdistinct : Pairwise fun i j => lambda i ≠ lambda j)
    {eps : Real} (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hlower : ∀ n, eps <= |lambda n|) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose mode hmode_ne hmode_norm hmode_diag using
    fun n => exists_unit_eigenvector_of_hasEigenvalue (T := T) (heigen n)
  have hhas_vec :
      ∀ n, Module.End.HasEigenvector T.toLinearMap (lambda n) (mode n) := by
    intro n
    refine ⟨?_, hmode_ne n⟩
    simpa [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff] using hmode_diag n
  have horth : Orthonormal Real mode := by
    rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
    intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [hmode_norm i, inner_self_eq_norm_sq_to_K]
    · have hneqji : lambda j ≠ lambda i := (hdistinct hij).symm
      have hzero :
          inner Real (mode i) (mode j) = 0 :=
        selfAdjoint_eigenvectors_orthogonal_of_ne
          (T := T) hsymm hneqji (hhas_vec j) (hhas_vec i)
      simp [hij, hzero]
  exact
    compactOperator_no_orthonormal_eigen_subsequence_bounded_away
      (T := T) hcompact horth hmode_diag
      (φ := id) strictMono_id heps (by simpa using hlower)

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.compactSelfAdjoint_finite_eigenvalues_abs_ge
statement:
theorem compactSelfAdjoint_finite_eigenvalues_abs_ge
    {T : H →L[Real] H}
    (hcompact : IsCompactOperator T)
    (hsymm : T.IsSymmetric)
    {eps : Real} (heps : 0 < eps) :
    {lambda : Real |
      Module.End.HasEigenvalue T.toLinearMap lambda ∧ eps <= |lambda|}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Set Real :=
    {lambda : Real |
      Module.End.HasEigenvalue T.toLinearMap lambda ∧ eps <= |lambda|}
  by_contra hfinite
  have hfinite' : ¬s.Finite := by
    intro hs
    exact hfinite (by simpa [s] using hs)
  have hinf : s.Infinite := by
    exact hfinite'
  let e : Nat ↪ s := Set.Infinite.natEmbedding s hinf
  let lambdaSeq : Nat → Real := fun n => (e n : Real)
  have heigen :
      ∀ n, Module.End.HasEigenvalue T.toLinearMap (lambdaSeq n) := by
    intro n
    exact (e n).property.1
  have hdistinct : Pairwise fun i j => lambdaSeq i ≠ lambdaSeq j := by
    intro i j hij heq
    exact hij (e.injective (Subtype.ext heq))
  have hlower : ∀ n, eps <= |lambdaSeq n| := by
    intro n
    exact (e n).property.2
  exact
    compactSelfAdjoint_no_distinct_eigenvalue_sequence_bounded_away
      (T := T) hcompact hsymm heigen hdistinct heps hlower

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.compactSelfAdjoint_countable_nonzero_eigenvalues
statement:
theorem compactSelfAdjoint_countable_nonzero_eigenvalues
    {T : H →L[Real] H}
    (hcompact : IsCompactOperator T)
    (hsymm : T.IsSymmetric) :
    {lambda : Real |
      Module.End.HasEigenvalue T.toLinearMap lambda ∧ lambda ≠ 0}.Countable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let shell : Nat -> Set Real := fun n =>
    {lambda : Real |
      Module.End.HasEigenvalue T.toLinearMap lambda ∧
        1 / ((n : Real) + 1) <= |lambda|}
  have hshell : ∀ n, (shell n).Countable := by
    intro n
    exact (compactSelfAdjoint_finite_eigenvalues_abs_ge
      (T := T) hcompact hsymm
      (eps := 1 / ((n : Real) + 1)) (by positivity)).countable
  have hUnion : (⋃ n : Nat, shell n).Countable :=
    Set.countable_iUnion hshell
  refine Set.Countable.mono ?_ hUnion
  intro lambda hlambda
  have habs_pos : 0 < |lambda| := abs_pos.mpr hlambda.2
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt habs_pos
  refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨n, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨hlambda.1, le_of_lt hn⟩

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.isCompactOperator_of_range_le_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem isCompactOperator_of_range_le_finiteDimensional
    {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    {T : ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id 𝕜) E F} {V : Submodule 𝕜 F}
    [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 V]
    (hV : forall x, (V : Set F) (T x)) :
    IsCompactOperator T
proof:
:= by
  let TV : ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id 𝕜) E V :=
    { T.toLinearMap.codRestrict V hV with
      cont := T.continuous.subtype_mk hV }
  haveI := FiniteDimensional.proper_rclike 𝕜 V
  have hTV : IsCompactOperator TV :=
    isCompactOperator_of_locallyCompactSpace_dom TV
  cases hTV with
  | intro C hC =>
      refine Exists.intro (V.subtypeL '' C) ?_
      refine And.intro (hC.1.image V.subtypeL.continuous) ?_
      filter_upwards [hC.2] with x hx
      exact Exists.intro (TV x) (And.intro hx rfl)

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.isCompactOperator_of_tendsto_finiteDimensional_range
statement:
theorem isCompactOperator_of_tendsto_finiteDimensional_range
    {I F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F]
    [CompleteSpace F]
    {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot]
    {Tn : I -> ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id 𝕜) E F}
    {T : ContinuousLinearMap (RingHom.id 𝕜) E F}
    (hT : Filter.Tendsto Tn l (nhds T))
    (Vn : I -> Submodule 𝕜 F)
    [hVnFinite : forall i, FiniteDimensional 𝕜 (Vn i)]
    (hVn : forall i x, (Vn i : Set F) (Tn i x)) :
    IsCompactOperator T
proof:
:= by
  refine isCompactOperator_of_tendsto hT ?_
  refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_
  intro i
  haveI := hVnFinite i
  exact isCompactOperator_of_range_le_finiteDimensional
    (T := Tn i) (V := Vn i) (hVn i)

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.kernelOpGoodKSimple_mem_span_of_finiteRank
statement:
theorem kernelOpGoodKSimple_mem_span_of_finiteRank
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {K : Omega -> Omega -> Real}
    (hK : GoodK K)
    {a b : ι -> Omega -> Real}
    (ha : forall i, Good (a i)) (hb : forall i, Good (b i))
    (hsep : forall x y, K x y = ∑ i : ι, a i x * b i y)
    (s : Lp.simpleFunc Real 2 mu) :
    L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKSimple (mu := mu) hK s ∈
      Submodule.span Real
        (Set.range fun i : ι => L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let sf : Omega -> Real := Lp.simpleFunc.toSimpleFunc s
  let hs : Good sf := L2Kernel.simpleFunc_good (mu := mu) s
  let coeff : ι -> Real := fun i => ∫ y, b i y * sf y ∂mu
  let V : Submodule Real (Lp Real 2 mu) :=
    Submodule.span Real
      (Set.range fun i : ι => L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i))
  let v : Lp Real 2 mu :=
    ∑ i : ι, coeff i • L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i)
  have hv : v ∈ V := by
    dsimp [v, V]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ (coeff i)
      (Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self i))
  have hterm_int :
      forall (x : Omega) (i : ι),
        Integrable (fun y => (a i x * b i y) * sf y) mu := by
    intro x i
    have hi : Integrable (fun y => b i y * sf y) mu :=
      (Good.mul (hb i) hs).integrable
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hi.const_mul (a i x)
  have hpoint : forall x : Omega,
      kernelOp K mu sf x = ∑ i : ι, coeff i * a i x := by
    intro x
    calc
      kernelOp K mu sf x
          = ∫ y, (∑ i : ι, a i x * b i y) * sf y ∂mu := by
            simp only [kernelOp]
            refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
            simp [hsep x y]
      _ = ∫ y, ∑ i : ι, (a i x * b i y) * sf y ∂mu := by
            refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
            simp [Finset.sum_mul]
      _ = ∑ i : ι, ∫ y, (a i x * b i y) * sf y ∂mu := by
            rw [integral_finsetSum]
            intro i _hi
            exact hterm_int x i
      _ = ∑ i : ι, a i x * coeff i := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
            intro i _hi
            simp only [coeff]
            rw [← integral_const_mul]
            refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
            ring
      _ = ∑ i : ι, coeff i * a i x := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
            intro i _hi
            ring
  have hright : (v : Omega -> Real) =ᵐ[mu]
      fun x => ∑ i : ι, coeff i * a i x := by
    have hsum :=
      Lp.coeFn_fun_finsetSum (μ := mu) (p := (2 : ENNReal))
        (Finset.univ) (fun i : ι =>
          coeff i • L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i))
    have hterms : forall i : ι,
        ((coeff i • L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i) :
            Lp Real 2 mu) : Omega -> Real) =ᵐ[mu]
          fun x => coeff i * a i x := by
      intro i
      filter_upwards
        [Lp.coeFn_smul (μ := mu) (p := (2 : ENNReal))
         (coeff i) (L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i)),
         L2Kernel.goodL2_ae_eq (mu := mu) (ha i)] with x hxsmul hxae
      rw [hxsmul]
      simp [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hxae]
    have hall : (∀ᵐ x ∂mu, forall i : ι,
        ((coeff i • L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i) :
            Lp Real 2 mu) : Omega -> Real) x = coeff i * a i x) := by
      rw [Filter.eventually_all]
      exact hterms
    filter_upwards [hsum, hall] with x hxsum hxterms
    rw [hxsum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _hi => hxterms i)
  have hop : L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKSimple (mu := mu) hK s = v := by
    apply Lp.ext
    change
      ((L2Kernel.kernelOpL2OfGoodK (mu := mu) hK hs : Lp Real 2 mu) :
          Omega -> Real) =ᵐ[mu] (v : Omega -> Real)
    filter_upwards
      [L2Kernel.kernelOpL2OfGoodK_ae_eq (mu := mu) hK hs,
       hright] with x hxop hxv
    rw [hxop, hxv, hpoint x]
  rw [hop]
  exact hv

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.kernelOpGoodKCLM_mem_span_of_finiteRank
statement:
theorem kernelOpGoodKCLM_mem_span_of_finiteRank
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {K : Omega -> Omega -> Real}
    (hK : GoodK K)
    {C : Real} (hC0 : 0 <= C) (hKC : forall x y, |K x y| <= C)
    {a b : ι -> Omega -> Real}
    (ha : forall i, Good (a i)) (hb : forall i, Good (b i))
    (hsep : forall x y, K x y = ∑ i : ι, a i x * b i y)
    (f : Lp Real 2 mu) :
    L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu) hK hC0 hKC f ∈
      Submodule.span Real
        (Set.range fun i : ι => L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V : Submodule Real (Lp Real 2 mu) :=
    Submodule.span Real
      (Set.range fun i : ι => L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i))
  haveI : FiniteDimensional Real V :=
    FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite Real (Set.finite_range _)
  change
    L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu) hK hC0 hKC f ∈ V
  let T := L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu) hK hC0 hKC
  let e := L2Kernel.simpleFuncToL2 (mu := mu)
  have hdense : DenseRange e :=
    Lp.simpleFunc.denseRange (E := Real) (p := (2 : ENNReal)) (μ := mu)
      (by norm_num)
  refine hdense.induction_on
    (p := fun f : Lp Real 2 mu => (V : Set (Lp Real 2 mu)) (T f))
    f ?closed ?simple
  · have hclosedV : IsClosed (V : Set (Lp Real 2 mu)) :=
      V.closed_of_finiteDimensional
    change IsClosed {f : Lp Real 2 mu | T f ∈ V}
    simpa [Set.preimage, T] using hclosedV.preimage
      (L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu) hK hC0 hKC).continuous
  · intro s
    change
      L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu) hK hC0 hKC
          (s : Lp Real 2 mu) ∈ V
    rw [L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM_simpleFunc (mu := mu) hK hC0 hKC s]
    exact kernelOpGoodKSimple_mem_span_of_finiteRank
      (mu := mu) hK ha hb hsep s

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.canonicalGraphonCompact_of_hilbertSchmidt_finiteDimensional_approx
statement:
theorem canonicalGraphonCompact_of_hilbertSchmidt_finiteDimensional_approx
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot]
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    (K : I -> Omega -> Omega -> Real)
    (B : I -> Real)
    (hK : forall i, GoodK (K i))
    (hB0 : forall i, 0 <= B i)
    (hKB : forall i x y, |K i x y| <= B i)
    (hsqrt_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun i =>
          Real.sqrt
            (L2Kernel.kernelSqNorm mu
              (fun x y => K i x y - W x y)))
        l (nhds 0))
    (V : I -> Submodule Real (Lp Real 2 mu))
    [hVFinite : forall i, FiniteDimensional Real (V i)]
    (hV : forall i f,
      (V i : Set (Lp Real 2 mu))
        (L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu)
          (hK i) (hB0 i) (hKB i) f)) :
    IsCompactOperator (L2Kernel.kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW)
proof:
:= by
  have hTendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun i =>
          L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu)
            (hK i) (hB0 i) (hKB i))
        l
        (nhds (L2Kernel.kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW)) := by
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    refine squeeze_zero (fun i => norm_nonneg _) ?_ hsqrt_tendsto
    intro i
    have hSub0 : 0 <= B i + 1 := add_nonneg (hB0 i) zero_le_one
    have hSub : forall x y, |K i x y - W x y| <= B i + 1 := by
      intro x y
      calc
        |K i x y - W x y| <= |K i x y| + |W x y| := abs_sub _ _
        _ <= B i + 1 := by
              exact add_le_add (hKB i x y)
                (L2Kernel.graphon_abs_le_one (mu := mu) hW x y)
    calc
      ‖L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu)
          (hK i) (hB0 i) (hKB i) -
          L2Kernel.kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW‖
          =
        ‖L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu)
            (hK i) (hB0 i) (hKB i) -
            L2Kernel.kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu)
              (goodK_of_isGraphon hW)
              zero_le_one (L2Kernel.graphon_abs_le_one (mu := mu) hW)‖ := by
            rw [L2Kernel.kernelOpCLM_eq_kernelOpGoodKCLM (mu := mu) hW]
      _ <=
          Real.sqrt
            (L2Kernel.kernelSqNorm mu
              (fun x y => K i x y - W x y)) := by
            exact L2Kernel.norm_kernelOpGoodKCLM_sub_le_sqrt_kernelSqNorm
              (mu := mu)
              (hK i) (goodK_of_isGraphon hW)
              (hB0 i) (hKB i)
              zero_le_one (L2Kernel.graphon_abs_le_one (mu := mu) hW)
              hSub0 hSub
  exact isCompactOperator_of_tendsto_finiteDimensional_range
    (hT := hTendsto) V hV

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.canonicalGraphonCompact_of_hilbertSchmidt_finiteRank_approx
statement:
theorem canonicalGraphonCompact_of_hilbertSchmidt_finiteRank_approx
    {I : Type*} {l : Filter I} [l.NeBot]
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    (κ : I -> Type*) [hκ : forall i, Fintype (κ i)]
    (K : I -> Omega -> Omega -> Real)
    (B : I -> Real)
    (hK : forall i, GoodK (K i))
    (hB0 : forall i, 0 <= B i)
    (hKB : forall i x y, |K i x y| <= B i)
    (a b : forall i, κ i -> Omega -> Real)
    (ha : forall i j, Good (a i j))
    (hb : forall i j, Good (b i j))
    (hsep : forall i x y, K i x y = ∑ j : κ i, a i j x * b i j y)
    (hsqrt_tendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto
        (fun i =>
          Real.sqrt
            (L2Kernel.kernelSqNorm mu
              (fun x y => K i x y - W x y)))
        l (nhds 0)) :
    IsCompactOperator (L2Kernel.kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V : I -> Submodule Real (Lp Real 2 mu) := fun i =>
    Submodule.span Real
      (Set.range fun j : κ i => L2Kernel.goodL2 (mu := mu) (ha i j))
  haveI : forall i, FiniteDimensional Real (V i) := by
    intro i
    dsimp [V]
    exact FiniteDimensional.span_of_finite Real (Set.finite_range _)
  refine canonicalGraphonCompact_of_hilbertSchmidt_finiteDimensional_approx
    (mu := mu) hW K B hK hB0 hKB hsqrt_tendsto V ?_
  intro i f
  dsimp [V]
  exact kernelOpGoodKCLM_mem_span_of_finiteRank
    (mu := mu) (ι := κ i)
    (hK i) (hB0 i) (hKB i)
    (ha i) (hb i) (hsep i) f

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.graphonHilbertSchmidtFiniteRankApproxFor
statement:
theorem graphonHilbertSchmidtFiniteRankApproxFor
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu) :
    GraphonHilbertSchmidtFiniteRankApproxFor (mu := mu) hW
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let eps : Nat -> Real := fun n => (1 : Real) / (n + 1)
  have heps : forall n, 0 < eps n := by
    intro n
    dsimp [eps]
    positivity
  have hex :
      forall n : Nat,
        exists J : Type u, exists hJ : Fintype J,
        exists K : Omega -> Omega -> Real, exists B : Real,
        exists a b : J -> Omega -> Real,
          GoodK K /\
          0 <= B /\
          (forall x y, |K x y| <= B) /\
          (forall j, Good (a j)) /\
          (forall j, Good (b j)) /\
          (forall x y, K x y = (@Finset.univ J hJ).sum
            (fun j : J => a j x * b j y)) /\
          Real.sqrt (L2Kernel.kernelSqNorm mu
            (fun x y => K x y - W x y)) < eps n := by
    intro n
    exact L2Kernel.exists_finiteRank_kernel_sqrt_kernelSqNorm_sub_lt_of_goodK
      (mu := mu) (goodK_of_isGraphon hW) (heps n)
  choose J hJ K B a b hK hB0 hKB ha hb hsep hsqrt_lt using hex
  let I : Type u := ULift.{u} Nat
  let up : Nat -> I := fun n => ULift.up n
  let l : Filter I := Filter.map up Filter.atTop
  refine ⟨I, l, ?_, (fun i : I => J i.down), (fun i : I => hJ i.down),
    (fun i : I => K i.down), (fun i : I => B i.down),
    (fun i : I => a i.down), (fun i : I => b i.down),
    (fun i : I => hK i.down), (fun i : I => hB0 i.down),
    (fun i : I => hKB i.down), (fun i : I => ha i.down),
    (fun i : I => hb i.down), (fun i : I => hsep i.down), ?_⟩
  · dsimp [l]
    exact Filter.NeBot.map inferInstance up
  · have hNat :
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n : Nat =>
            Real.sqrt
              (L2Kernel.kernelSqNorm mu
                (fun x y => K n x y - W x y)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      refine squeeze_zero
        (f := fun n : Nat =>
          Real.sqrt
            (L2Kernel.kernelSqNorm mu
              (fun x y => K n x y - W x y)))
        (g := eps)
        (fun n => Real.sqrt_nonneg _) ?_ ?_
      · intro n
        exact (hsqrt_lt n).le
      · simpa [eps] using
          (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := Real))
    dsimp [l]
    rw [Filter.tendsto_map'_iff]
    simpa [Function.comp_def, up]
      using hNat

name: OddCycleBound.Spectral.CompactSpectral.canonicalGraphonCompact_of_hilbertSchmidtFiniteRankApproxFor
statement:
theorem canonicalGraphonCompact_of_hilbertSchmidtFiniteRankApproxFor
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    (happrox : GraphonHilbertSchmidtFiniteRankApproxFor (mu := mu) hW) :
    IsCompactOperator (L2Kernel.kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW)
proof:
:= by
  rcases happrox with
    ⟨I, l, hl, J, hJ, K, B, a, b,
      hK, hB0, hKB, ha, hb, hsep, hsqrt_tendsto⟩
  letI : Filter.NeBot l := hl
  letI : forall i, Fintype (J i) := hJ
  exact
    canonicalGraphonCompact_of_hilbertSchmidt_finiteRank_approx
      (mu := mu) hW J K B hK hB0 hKB a b ha hb hsep hsqrt_tendsto

name: OddCycleBound.multiKernel_seven_one_pos

proof:
:= by
  have hD := shortD_pos q
  have hN := shortN_pos hq
  have hsq := multiKernel_seven_one_sq q ℓ
  have h24 : 0 < 24 * shortD q * multiKernel 7 1 q [ℓ] := by
    rw [hsq]; positivity
  have h24D : 0 < 24 * shortD q := by positivity
  exact pos_of_mul_pos_right h24 h24D.le

name: OddCycleBound.multiKernel_nonneg_short
statement:
theorem multiKernel_nonneg_short {m r : ℕ} (hm : m = 3 ∨ m = 5 ∨ m = 7) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (h2r : 2 * r < m) {q : ℝ} (_hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ 1 / 2) (L : List ℝ)
    (hlen : L.length = r) : 0 ≤ multiKernel m r q L
proof:
:= by
  rcases hm with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · obtain rfl : r = 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨ℓ, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
    rw [multiKernel_three_one]; norm_num
  · obtain rfl | rfl : r = 1 ∨ r = 2 := by omega
    · obtain ⟨ℓ, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
      rw [multiKernel_five_one_sq]; positivity
    · obtain ⟨ℓ₁, ℓ₂, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_two.mp hlen
      rw [multiKernel_five_two]; norm_num
  · obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : r = 1 ∨ r = 2 ∨ r = 3 := by omega
    · obtain ⟨ℓ, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.mp hlen
      exact (multiKernel_seven_one_pos hq ℓ).le
    · obtain ⟨ℓ₁, ℓ₂, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_two.mp hlen
      rw [multiKernel_seven_two]; positivity
    · obtain ⟨ℓ₁, ℓ₂, ℓ₃, rfl⟩ := List.length_eq_three.mp hlen
      rw [multiKernel_seven_three]; norm_num

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.odd_trace_le
statement:
lemma odd_trace_le (h1 : T 1 ≤ q) (hstep : ∀ j, T (2 * j + 3) ≤ q ^ 2 * T (2 * j + 1)) :
    ∀ j, T (2 * j + 1) ≤ q ^ (2 * j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => simpa using h1
  | succ j ih =>
      have := hstep j
      calc T (2 * (j + 1) + 1) = T (2 * j + 3) := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ q ^ 2 * T (2 * j + 1) := this
        _ ≤ q ^ 2 * q ^ (2 * j + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by positivity)
        _ = q ^ (2 * (j + 1) + 1) := by ring

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.odd_trace_down
statement:
lemma odd_trace_down (hstep : ∀ j, T (2 * j + 3) ≤ q ^ 2 * T (2 * j + 1)) :
    ∀ i j, T (2 * (i + j) + 1) ≤ q ^ (2 * i) * T (2 * j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  induction i with
  | zero => simp
  | succ i ih =>
      calc T (2 * (i + 1 + j) + 1) = T (2 * (i + j) + 3) := by ring_nf
        _ ≤ q ^ 2 * T (2 * (i + j) + 1) := hstep _
        _ ≤ q ^ 2 * (q ^ (2 * i) * T (2 * j + 1)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by positivity)
        _ = q ^ (2 * (i + 1)) * T (2 * j + 1) := by ring

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.odd_trace_eq
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, a = b + 1 := ⟨a - 1, by omega⟩
  have hle := odd_trace_le T h1 hstep
  set Q := q ^ (2 * b + 1) with hQ
  have hQpos : 0 < Q := by positivity
  have hX0 := hT0 b
  have hXle : T (2 * b + 1) ≤ Q := hle b
  have hY : T (2 * b + 3) ≤ q ^ 2 * T (2 * b + 1) := hstep b
  have hcs' : (Q * q) ^ 2 ≤ T (2 * b + 1) * T (2 * b + 3) := by
    have e1 : 2 * (b + 1) - 1 = 2 * b + 1 := by omega
    have e2 : 2 * (b + 1) + 1 = 2 * b + 3 := by omega
    rw [e1, e2, hTm] at hcs
    calc (Q * q) ^ 2 = (q ^ (2 * (b + 1))) ^ 2 := by rw [hQ]; ring
      _ ≤ _ := hcs
  have hq2 : 0 < q ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hX : T (2 * b + 1) = Q := by
    have : Q ^ 2 * q ^ 2 ≤ q ^ 2 * T (2 * b + 1) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY hX0]
    have hsq : Q ^ 2 ≤ T (2 * b + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (T (2 * b + 1) - Q)]
  have hYeq : T (2 * b + 3) = q ^ 2 * Q := by
    rw [hX] at hcs' hY
    have : Q * (Q * q ^ 2) ≤ Q * T (2 * b + 3) := by nlinarith
    have := le_of_mul_le_mul_left this hQpos
    linarith
  intro j hj
  have hdown := odd_trace_down T hstep (b + 1 - j) j
  rw [show 2 * (b + 1 - j + j) + 1 = 2 * b + 3 by omega, hYeq] at hdown
  have hpos : 0 < q ^ (2 * (b + 1 - j)) := by positivity
  have hlow : q ^ (2 * j + 1) ≤ T (2 * j + 1) := by
    have e : q ^ 2 * Q = q ^ (2 * (b + 1 - j)) * q ^ (2 * j + 1) := by
      rw [hQ, ← pow_add, ← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
    rw [e] at hdown
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hdown hpos
  exact le_antisymm (hle j) hlow

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.edgeDensity_of_regular
statement:
lemma edgeDensity_of_regular {q : ℝ}
    (hdeg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree U μ x = q) : edgeDensity U μ = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeDensity, mean, integral_congr_ae hdeg]
  simp

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.integral_prod_eq_edgeDensity
statement:
lemma integral_prod_eq_edgeDensity (hU : IsGraphon U μ) :
    ∫ p, U p.1 p.2 ∂(μ.prod μ) = edgeDensity U μ
proof:
:= by
  have hint : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => U p.1 p.2) (μ.prod μ) :=
    (goodK_of_isGraphon hU).integrable_prod
  rw [integral_prod _ hint]
  rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.hsInner_self_le_edgeDensity
statement:
lemma hsInner_self_le_edgeDensity (hU : IsGraphon U μ) :
    hsInner μ U U ≤ edgeDensity U μ
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  rw [← integral_prod_eq_edgeDensity hU]
  refine integral_mono (hGU.integrable_mul hGU) hGU.integrable_prod fun p => ?_
  have h0 := hU.nonneg p.1 p.2
  have h1 := hU.le_one p.1 p.2
  show U p.1 p.2 * U p.1 p.2 ≤ U p.1 p.2
  nlinarith

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.zero_or_one_of_hsInner_self_eq
statement:
lemma zero_or_one_of_hsInner_self_eq (hU : IsGraphon U μ)
    (h : hsInner μ U U = edgeDensity U μ) :
    ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), U p.1 p.2 = 0 ∨ U p.1 p.2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  rw [← integral_prod_eq_edgeDensity hU, hsInner] at h
  have hI1 : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => U p.1 p.2) (μ.prod μ) := hGU.integrable_prod
  have hI2 : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => U p.1 p.2 * U p.1 p.2) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hGU.integrable_mul hGU
  have hI : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => U p.1 p.2 - U p.1 p.2 * U p.1 p.2) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hI1.sub hI2
  have hdiff : ∫ p, (U p.1 p.2 - U p.1 p.2 * U p.1 p.2) ∂(μ.prod μ) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_sub hI1 hI2]
    linarith
  rw [integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun p => by
      have h0 := hU.nonneg p.1 p.2
      have h1 := hU.le_one p.1 p.2
      show 0 ≤ U p.1 p.2 - U p.1 p.2 * U p.1 p.2
      nlinarith) hI] at hdiff
  filter_upwards [hdiff] with p hp
  have hp' : U p.1 p.2 * (1 - U p.1 p.2) = 0 := by
    have : U p.1 p.2 - U p.1 p.2 * U p.1 p.2 = 0 := hp
    linarith
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hp' with h | h
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.regular_cycle_equality
statement:
theorem regular_cycle_equality (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hdeg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree U μ x = q) {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hcyc : cycleDensity μ U m = q ^ (m - 1)) :
    (∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), U p.1 p.2 = 0 ∨ U p.1 p.2 = 1) ∧
      ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), comp μ U U p.1 p.2 = q * U p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  set T : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => trace μ (compPow μ U n) with hTdef
  have hP : ∀ a b, hsInner μ (compPow μ U a) (compPow μ U b) = T (a + b + 1) :=
    fun a b => hsInner_compPow hU a b
  have hT0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ T (2 * j + 1) := fun j => by
    rw [show 2 * j + 1 = j + j + 1 by ring, ← hP]
    exact hsInner_self_nonneg _
  have hedge := edgeDensity_of_regular hdeg
  have hT1eq : hsInner μ U U = T 1 := hP 0 0
  have h1 : T 1 ≤ q := by
    have := hsInner_self_le_edgeDensity (μ := μ) hU
    rw [hedge, hT1eq] at this
    exact this
  have hstep : ∀ j, T (2 * j + 3) ≤ q ^ 2 * T (2 * j + 1) := fun j => by
    have h := hsInner_comp_le hU hdeg (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU j)
    rw [show comp μ U (compPow μ U j) = compPow μ U (j + 1) from rfl, hP, hP] at h
    rw [show 2 * j + 3 = j + 1 + (j + 1) + 1 by ring, show 2 * j + 1 = j + j + 1 by ring]
    exact h
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hm
  have ha : 1 ≤ a := by omega
  have hTm : T (2 * a) = q ^ (2 * a) := by
    simpa [cycleDensity] using hcyc
  have hcs : T (2 * a) ^ 2 ≤ T (2 * a - 1) * T (2 * a + 1) := by
    have h := hsInner_sq_le (μ := μ) (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU (a - 1)) (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU a)
    rw [hP, hP, hP] at h
    rw [show a - 1 + a + 1 = 2 * a by omega, show a - 1 + (a - 1) + 1 = 2 * a - 1 by omega,
      show a + a + 1 = 2 * a + 1 by omega] at h
    exact h
  have hodd := odd_trace_eq T hq ha h1 hT0 hstep hcs hTm
  have hT1 : T 1 = q := by simpa using hodd 0 (by omega)
  have hT3 : T 3 = q ^ 3 := by simpa using hodd 1 ha
  
  have hT2 : T 2 = q ^ 2 := by
    rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le ha with h | h
    · subst h; simpa using hTm
    · have hT5 : T 5 = q ^ 5 := by simpa using hodd 2 (by omega)
      have hY : hsInner μ (fun x y => compPow μ U 2 x y - q ^ 2 * compPow μ U 0 x y)
          (fun x y => compPow μ U 2 x y - q ^ 2 * compPow μ U 0 x y) = 0 := by
        rw [hsInner_sub_smul_self (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 2) (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 0), hP, hP, hP]
        norm_num [hT5, hT3, hT1]
        ring
      have hshift : ∀ b, T (b + 3) = q ^ 2 * T (b + 1) := fun b => by
        have h0 := hsInner_eq_zero_of_self_eq_zero (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU b)
          (goodK_sub_smul (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 2) (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 0) _) hY
        rw [hsInner_sub_left (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 2) (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 0)
          (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU b), hP, hP] at h0
        rw [show b + 3 = b + 2 + 1 by ring, show b + 1 = b + 0 + 1 by ring]
        linarith
      have hev : ∀ i, T (2 * i + 2) = q ^ (2 * i) * T 2 := fun i => by
        induction i with
        | zero => simp
        | succ i ih =>
            rw [show 2 * (i + 1) + 2 = (2 * i + 1) + 3 by ring, hshift,
              show 2 * i + 1 + 1 = 2 * i + 2 by ring, ih]
            ring
      have h2a := hev (a - 1)
      rw [show 2 * (a - 1) + 2 = 2 * a by omega, hTm] at h2a
      have hpos : 0 < q ^ (2 * (a - 1)) := by positivity
      have e : q ^ (2 * a) = q ^ (2 * (a - 1)) * q ^ 2 := by
        rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega
      rw [e] at h2a
      exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hpos.ne' h2a).symm
  refine ⟨zero_or_one_of_hsInner_self_eq hU ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hedge, hT1eq, hT1]
  · have hZ : hsInner μ (fun x y => compPow μ U 1 x y - q * compPow μ U 0 x y)
        (fun x y => compPow μ U 1 x y - q * compPow μ U 0 x y) = 0 := by
      rw [hsInner_sub_smul_self (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 1) (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 0), hP, hP, hP]
      norm_num [hT3, hT2, hT1]
      ring
    filter_upwards [ae_eq_zero_of_hsInner_self_eq_zero
      (goodK_sub_smul (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 1) (goodK_compPow (μ := μ) hGU 0) _) hZ] with p hp
    have : compPow μ U 1 p.1 p.2 - q * compPow μ U 0 p.1 p.2 = 0 := hp
    change compPow μ U 1 p.1 p.2 = q * compPow μ U 0 p.1 p.2
    linarith

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.SameNbhd.symm
statement: lemma SameNbhd.symm {x y : Ω} (h : SameNbhd μ U x y) : SameNbhd μ U y x
proof:
:=
  h.mono fun _ hz => hz.symm

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.SameNbhd.trans
statement:
lemma SameNbhd.trans {x y z : Ω} (h1 : SameNbhd μ U x y) (h2 : SameNbhd μ U y z) :
    SameNbhd μ U x z
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [h1, h2] with w hw1 hw2
  rw [hw1, hw2]

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.measurableSet_sameNbhd
statement:
lemma measurableSet_sameNbhd (hU : Measurable (Function.uncurry U)) :
    MeasurableSet {p : Ω × Ω | SameNbhd μ U p.1 p.2}
proof:
:= by
  set D : Set ((Ω × Ω) × Ω) := {r | U r.1.1 r.2 ≠ U r.1.2 r.2} with hDdef
  have hD : MeasurableSet D := by
    have h1 : Measurable fun r : (Ω × Ω) × Ω => U r.1.1 r.2 :=
      hU.comp ((measurable_fst.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
    have h2 : Measurable fun r : (Ω × Ω) × Ω => U r.1.2 r.2 :=
      hU.comp ((measurable_snd.comp measurable_fst).prodMk measurable_snd)
    exact (measurableSet_eq_fun h1 h2).compl
  have hmeas := measurable_measure_prodMk_left (ν := μ) hD
  have hset : {p : Ω × Ω | SameNbhd μ U p.1 p.2} =
      (fun p => μ (Prod.mk p ⁻¹' D)) ⁻¹' {0} := by
    ext p
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, SameNbhd, ae_iff,
      hDdef]
    rfl
  rw [hset]
  exact hmeas (measurableSet_singleton 0)

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.measurableSet_nbhdClass
statement:
lemma measurableSet_nbhdClass (hU : Measurable (Function.uncurry U)) (x : Ω) :
    MeasurableSet (nbhdClass μ U x)
proof:
:=
  measurable_prodMk_left (measurableSet_sameNbhd (μ := μ) hU)

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.disjoint_nbhdClass
statement:
lemma disjoint_nbhdClass {x y : Ω} (h : ¬ SameNbhd μ U x y) :
    Disjoint (nbhdClass μ U x) (nbhdClass μ U y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro z hzx hzy
  exact h (SameNbhd.trans hzx (SameNbhd.symm hzy))

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.ae_eq_ite_sameNbhd
statement:
lemma ae_eq_ite_sameNbhd (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hdeg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree U μ x = q)
    (h01 : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), U p.1 p.2 = 0 ∨ U p.1 p.2 = 1)
    (hsq : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), comp μ U U p.1 p.2 = q * U p.1 p.2) :
    ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), U p.1 p.2 = if SameNbhd μ U p.1 p.2 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  have hrow : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, (∀ᵐ z ∂μ, U x z = 0 ∨ U x z = 1) ∧ degree U μ x = q := by
    filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod h01, hdeg] with x hx1 hx2 using ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
  have hfst := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).ae hrow
  have hsnd := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).ae hrow
  filter_upwards [h01, hsq, hfst, hsnd] with p h1 h2 h3 h4
  obtain ⟨x, y⟩ := p
  simp only at h1 h2 h3 h4 ⊢
  have hsq_row : ∀ w, (∀ᵐ z ∂μ, U w z = 0 ∨ U w z = 1) → degree U μ w = q →
      ∫ z, U w z * U w z ∂μ = q := fun w hw hdw => by
    rw [← hdw, degree]
    refine integral_congr_ae (hw.mono fun z hz => ?_)
    rcases hz with h | h <;> simp [h]
  have hxx := hsq_row x h3.1 h3.2
  have hyy := hsq_row y h4.1 h4.2
  have hxy : ∫ z, U x z * U y z ∂μ = q * U x y := by
    rw [← h2]
    refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_)
    simp only [hU.symm y z]
  have hIx := hGU.integrable_row (μ := μ) x
  have hIy := hGU.integrable_row (μ := μ) y
  have hmul : ∀ a b : Ω, Integrable (fun z => U a z * U b z) μ := fun a b =>
    integrable_Uf hU ⟨(hGU.meas.comp measurable_prodMk_left).stronglyMeasurable,
      ⟨1, zero_le_one, fun z => by
        show |U b z| ≤ 1
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (hU.nonneg b z)]; exact hU.le_one b z⟩⟩ a
  have hD : ∫ z, (U x z - U y z) ^ 2 ∂μ = 2 * q - 2 * q * U x y := by
    have e : (fun z => (U x z - U y z) ^ 2) =
        fun z => U x z * U x z - 2 * (U x z * U y z) + U y z * U y z := by
      funext z; ring
    have hJ1 : Integrable (fun z => 2 * (U x z * U y z)) μ := (hmul x y).const_mul _
    have hJ : Integrable (fun z => U x z * U x z - 2 * (U x z * U y z)) μ := (hmul x x).sub hJ1
    rw [e, integral_add hJ (hmul y y), integral_sub (hmul x x) hJ1, integral_const_mul, hxx, hyy,
      hxy]
    ring
  have hIsq : Integrable (fun z => (U x z - U y z) ^ 2) μ := by
    have e : (fun z => (U x z - U y z) ^ 2) =
        fun z => U x z * U x z - 2 * (U x z * U y z) + U y z * U y z := by
      funext z; ring
    rw [e]
    have hJ1 : Integrable (fun z => 2 * (U x z * U y z)) μ := (hmul x y).const_mul _
    have hJ : Integrable (fun z => U x z * U x z - 2 * (U x z * U y z)) μ := (hmul x x).sub hJ1
    exact hJ.add (hmul y y)
  rcases h1 with h | h
  · rw [h, if_neg]
    intro hsame
    have h0 : ∫ z, (U x z - U y z) ^ 2 ∂μ = 0 := by
      refine integral_eq_zero_of_ae (hsame.mono fun z hz => ?_)
      simp [hz]
    rw [hD, h] at h0
    linarith
  · rw [h, if_pos]
    have h0 : ∫ z, (U x z - U y z) ^ 2 ∂μ = 0 := by rw [hD, h]; ring
    rw [integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun z => sq_nonneg _) hIsq] at h0
    filter_upwards [h0] with z hz
    have : (U x z - U y z) ^ 2 = 0 := hz
    have := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp this
    linarith

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.ae_measureReal_nbhdClass
statement:
lemma ae_measureReal_nbhdClass (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hdeg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree U μ x = q)
    (h01 : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), U p.1 p.2 = 0 ∨ U p.1 p.2 = 1)
    (hsq : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), comp μ U U p.1 p.2 = q * U p.1 p.2) :
    ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, μ.real (nbhdClass μ U x) = q
proof:
:= by
  have hchar := ae_eq_ite_sameNbhd hU hq hdeg h01 hsq
  filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod hchar, hdeg] with x hx hdx
  rw [← hdx, degree, integral_congr_ae hx,
    ← integral_indicator_one (measurableSet_nbhdClass (μ := μ) hU.meas x)]
  refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
  by_cases h : SameNbhd μ U x y
  · simp [Set.indicator, nbhdClass, h]
  · simp [Set.indicator, nbhdClass, h]

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.measureReal_iUnion_family
statement:
lemma measureReal_iUnion_family (hU : Measurable (Function.uncurry U)) {q : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    {e : Fin n → Ω} (he : ∀ i, μ.real (nbhdClass μ U (e i)) = q)
    (hdist : Pairwise fun i j => ¬ SameNbhd μ U (e i) (e j)) :
    μ.real (⋃ i, nbhdClass μ U (e i)) = n * q
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureReal_iUnion_fintype (fun i j hij => disjoint_nbhdClass (hdist hij))
    (fun i => measurableSet_nbhdClass hU (e i))]
  simp [he]

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.GoodFamily.card_mul_le
statement:
lemma GoodFamily.card_mul_le (hU : Measurable (Function.uncurry U)) {q : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (h : GoodFamily μ U q n) : (n : ℝ) * q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hdist⟩ := h
  rw [← measureReal_iUnion_family hU he hdist]
  exact measureReal_le_one

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.exists_clique_partition
statement:
theorem exists_clique_partition (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hdeg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree U μ x = q)
    (h01 : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), U p.1 p.2 = 0 ∨ U p.1 p.2 = 1)
    (hsq : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), comp μ U U p.1 p.2 = q * U p.1 p.2) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, (k : ℝ) * q = 1 ∧ ∃ φ : Ω → Fin k, Measurable φ ∧
      Measure.map φ μ = uniformFin k ∧
      ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), U p.1 p.2 = if φ p.1 = φ p.2 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmeas := hU.meas
  
  set N := ⌊1 / q⌋₊ with hN
  have hbound : ∀ n, GoodFamily μ U q n → n ≤ N := fun n hn => by
    apply Nat.le_floor
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hq]
    exact hn.card_mul_le hmeas
  set k := Nat.findGreatest (GoodFamily μ U q) N with hk
  have h0 : GoodFamily μ U q 0 := ⟨Fin.elim0, fun i => i.elim0, fun i => i.elim0⟩
  have hkgood : GoodFamily μ U q k := Nat.findGreatest_spec (Nat.zero_le N) h0
  have hknot : ¬ GoodFamily μ U q (k + 1) := by
    intro hk1
    have := hbound _ hk1
    exact Nat.findGreatest_is_greatest (Nat.lt_succ_self k) this hk1
  obtain ⟨e, he, hdist⟩ := hkgood
  
  have hcover : ∀ x, μ.real (nbhdClass μ U x) = q → ∃ i, SameNbhd μ U (e i) x := by
    intro x hx
    by_contra hcon
    simp only [not_exists] at hcon
    apply hknot
    refine ⟨Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => Ω) e x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simpa using hx
      · simpa using he j
    · intro i j hij
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          induction j using Fin.lastCases with
          | last => exact absurd rfl hij
          | cast j =>
              simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
              exact fun h => hcon j h.symm
      | cast i =>
          induction j using Fin.lastCases with
          | last =>
              simp only [Fin.snoc_last, Fin.snoc_castSucc]
              exact hcon i
          | cast j =>
              simp only [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
              exact hdist fun h => hij (by rw [h])
  have hclass := ae_measureReal_nbhdClass hU hq hdeg h01 hsq
  have hae_cover : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ i, x ∈ nbhdClass μ U (e i) := by
    filter_upwards [hclass] with x hx using hcover x hx
  
  set C : Set Ω := ⋃ i, nbhdClass μ U (e i) with hC
  have hCmeas : MeasurableSet C := MeasurableSet.iUnion fun i => measurableSet_nbhdClass hmeas _
  have hCcompl : μ Cᶜ = 0 := by
    have hmem : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ C := by
      filter_upwards [hae_cover] with x hx
      simpa [hC] using hx
    exact ae_iff.mp hmem
  have hCreal : μ.real C = 1 := by
    rw [measureReal_def, measure_congr (ae_eq_univ.mpr hCcompl), measure_univ,
      ENNReal.toReal_one]
  have hkq : (k : ℝ) * q = 1 := by
    rw [← hCreal, hC, measureReal_iUnion_family hmeas he hdist]
  have hkpos : 0 < k := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with h | h
    · rw [h] at hkq; simp at hkq
    · exact h
  
  have huniq : ∀ x i j, SameNbhd μ U (e i) x → SameNbhd μ U (e j) x → i = j := by
    intro x i j hi hj
    by_contra hij
    exact hdist hij (hi.trans hj.symm)
  
  let φ : Ω → Fin k := fun x =>
    if h : ∃ i, SameNbhd μ U (e i) x then Classical.choose h else ⟨0, hkpos⟩
  have hφ : ∀ x i, SameNbhd μ U (e i) x → φ x = i := by
    intro x i hi
    have h : ∃ i, SameNbhd μ U (e i) x := ⟨i, hi⟩
    simp only [φ, dif_pos h]
    exact huniq x _ _ (Classical.choose_spec h) hi
  have hpre : ∀ i, φ ⁻¹' {i} =
      nbhdClass μ U (e i) ∪ (Cᶜ ∩ {_x | (⟨0, hkpos⟩ : Fin k) = i}) := by
    intro i
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_inter_iff,
      Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, hC, Set.mem_iUnion, not_exists]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      by_cases h : ∃ j, SameNbhd μ U (e j) x
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h
        left
        rw [hφ x j hj] at hx
        rw [← hx]; exact hj
      · right
        refine ⟨fun j hj => h ⟨j, hj⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [← hx]
        simp only [φ, dif_neg h]
    · rintro (hx | ⟨hx, hi⟩)
      · exact hφ x i hx
      · rw [← hi]
        have hx' : ¬ ∃ j, SameNbhd μ U (e j) x := fun ⟨j, hj⟩ => hx j hj
        simp only [φ, dif_neg hx']
  have hφmeas : Measurable φ := by
    refine measurable_to_countable' fun i => ?_
    rw [hpre i]
    exact (measurableSet_nbhdClass hmeas _).union (hCmeas.compl.inter (MeasurableSet.const _))
  refine ⟨k, hkq, φ, hφmeas, ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    refine Measure.ext_of_singleton fun i => ?_
    rw [Measure.map_apply hφmeas (measurableSet_singleton i), hpre i]
    have hnull : μ (Cᶜ ∩ {_x | (⟨0, hkpos⟩ : Fin k) = i}) = 0 :=
      measure_mono_null Set.inter_subset_left hCcompl
    rw [le_antisymm ((measure_union_le _ _).trans (by rw [hnull, add_zero]))
      (measure_mono Set.subset_union_left)]
    have hq' : μ (nbhdClass μ U (e i)) = ENNReal.ofReal q := by
      rw [← he i, ofReal_measureReal]
    rw [hq', uniformFin, Measure.smul_apply, Measure.count_singleton, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    have hqk : q = 1 / k := by
      have hk' : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hkpos.ne'
      field_simp; linarith
    rw [hqk, one_div, ENNReal.ofReal_inv_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hkpos),
      ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
  · have hchar := ae_eq_ite_sameNbhd hU hq hdeg h01 hsq
    have hfst := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_fst (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).ae hae_cover
    have hsnd := (Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd (μ := μ) (ν := μ)).ae hae_cover
    filter_upwards [hchar, hfst, hsnd] with p hp h1 h2
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := h2
    rw [hp, hφ _ i hi, hφ _ j hj]
    have hiff : SameNbhd μ U p.1 p.2 ↔ i = j := by
      constructor
      · intro hs
        exact huniq p.2 i j (hi.trans hs) hj
      · rintro rfl
        exact hi.symm.trans hj
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · rw [if_pos (hiff.mpr hij), if_pos hij]
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => hij (hiff.mp h)), if_neg hij]

name: OddCycleBound.compPow_pullback
statement:
lemma compPow_pullback (hφ : Measurable φ) (hmap : Measure.map φ μ = uniformFin k) :
    ∀ n x y, compPow μ (fun x y => completePartite k (φ x) (φ y)) n x y =
      compPow (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) n (φ x) (φ y)
proof:
| 0, _, _ => rfl
  | n + 1, x, y => by
      show ∫ z, completePartite k (φ x) (φ z) *
          compPow μ (fun x y => completePartite k (φ x) (φ y)) n z y ∂μ =
        ∫ i, completePartite k (φ x) i * compPow (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) n i (φ y)
          ∂(uniformFin k)
      simp only [compPow_pullback hφ hmap n]
      rw [← hmap, integral_map hφ.aemeasurable
        (measurable_of_finite _).aestronglyMeasurable]

name: OddCycleBound.isGraphon_pullback
statement:
lemma isGraphon_pullback (hφ : Measurable φ) :
    IsGraphon (fun x y => completePartite k (φ x) (φ y)) μ where
  meas
proof:
:= (measurable_of_finite (Function.uncurry (completePartite k))).comp
    ((hφ.comp measurable_fst).prodMk (hφ.comp measurable_snd))
  nonneg _ _ := (isGraphon_completePartite k).nonneg _ _
  le_one _ _ := (isGraphon_completePartite k).le_one _ _
  symm _ _ := (isGraphon_completePartite k).symm _ _

name: OddCycleBound.cycleDensity_pullback_exact
statement:
lemma cycleDensity_pullback_exact (hφ : Measurable φ)
    (hmap : Measure.map φ μ = uniformFin k) (m : ℕ) :
    cycleDensity μ (fun x y => completePartite k (φ x) (φ y)) m =
      cycleDensity (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleDensity, cycleDensity, trace, trace]
  simp only [compPow_pullback hφ hmap]
  rw [← hmap, integral_map hφ.aemeasurable (measurable_of_finite _).aestronglyMeasurable]

name: OddCycleBound.edgeDensity_pullback_exact
statement:
lemma edgeDensity_pullback_exact (hφ : Measurable φ)
    (hmap : Measure.map φ μ = uniformFin k) :
    edgeDensity (fun x y => completePartite k (φ x) (φ y)) μ =
      edgeDensity (completePartite k) (uniformFin k)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x, degree (fun x y => completePartite k (φ x) (φ y)) μ x =
      degree (completePartite k) (uniformFin k) (φ x) := fun x => by
    rw [degree, degree, ← hmap,
      integral_map hφ.aemeasurable (measurable_of_finite _).aestronglyMeasurable]
  rw [edgeDensity, edgeDensity, mean, mean]
  simp only [h]
  rw [← hmap, integral_map hφ.aemeasurable (measurable_of_finite _).aestronglyMeasurable]

name: OddCycleBound.compPow_ae_eq
statement:
lemma compPow_ae_eq {W W' : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hW' : IsGraphon W' μ)
    (h : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), W p.1 p.2 = W' p.1 p.2) :
    ∀ n, ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), compPow μ W n p.1 p.2 = compPow μ W' n p.1 p.2
proof:
| 0 => h
  | n + 1 => by
      have hG := goodK_of_isGraphon hW
      have hG' := goodK_of_isGraphon hW'
      have ih := compPow_ae_eq hW hW' h n
      have hset : MeasurableSet
          {p : Ω × Ω | compPow μ W (n + 1) p.1 p.2 = compPow μ W' (n + 1) p.1 p.2} :=
        measurableSet_eq_fun (goodK_compPow hG (n + 1)).meas (goodK_compPow hG' (n + 1)).meas
      rw [Measure.ae_prod_iff_ae_ae hset]
      filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod h] with x hx
      filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ae_of_ae_prod ih] with y hy
      show ∫ z, W x z * compPow μ W n z y ∂μ = ∫ z, W' x z * compPow μ W' n z y ∂μ
      refine integral_congr_ae ?_
      filter_upwards [hx, hy] with z hz1 hz2
      rw [hz1, compPow_symm hG hW.symm n z y, compPow_symm hG' hW'.symm n z y]
      exact congrArg _ hz2

name: OddCycleBound.hsInner_congr_ae
statement:
lemma hsInner_congr_ae {A A' B B' : Ω → Ω → ℝ}
    (hA : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), A p.1 p.2 = A' p.1 p.2)
    (hB : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), B p.1 p.2 = B' p.1 p.2) :
    hsInner μ A B = hsInner μ A' B'
proof:
:= by
  unfold hsInner
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hA, hB] with p h1 h2
  rw [h1, h2]

name: OddCycleBound.cycleDensity_congr_ae
statement:
lemma cycleDensity_congr_ae {W W' : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hW' : IsGraphon W' μ)
    (h : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), W p.1 p.2 = W' p.1 p.2) {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m = cycleDensity μ W' m
proof:
:= by
  have hG := goodK_of_isGraphon hW
  have hG' := goodK_of_isGraphon hW'
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 2 := ⟨m - 2, by omega⟩
  rw [cycleDensity, cycleDensity, show n + 2 - 1 = n + 1 by omega,
    show compPow μ W (n + 1) = comp μ W (compPow μ W n) from rfl,
    show compPow μ W' (n + 1) = comp μ W' (compPow μ W' n) from rfl,
    trace_comp_eq_hsInner hG (goodK_compPow hG n) (compPow_symm hG hW.symm n),
    trace_comp_eq_hsInner hG' (goodK_compPow hG' n) (compPow_symm hG' hW'.symm n)]
  exact hsInner_congr_ae h (compPow_ae_eq hW hW' h n)

name: OddCycleBound.edgeDensity_congr_ae
statement:
lemma edgeDensity_congr_ae {W W' : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hW' : IsGraphon W' μ)
    (h : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), W p.1 p.2 = W' p.1 p.2) :
    edgeDensity W μ = edgeDensity W' μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← integral_prod_eq_edgeDensity hW, ← integral_prod_eq_edgeDensity hW']
  exact integral_congr_ae h

name: OddCycleBound.cycleDensity_pullback
statement:
theorem cycleDensity_pullback (hWg : IsGraphon W μ) (φ : Ω → Fin k) (hφ : Measurable φ)
    (hmap : Measure.map φ μ = uniformFin k)
    (hW : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), W p.1 p.2 = completePartite k (φ p.1) (φ p.2))
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m = cycleDensity (uniformFin k) (completePartite k) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleDensity_congr_ae hWg (isGraphon_pullback hφ) hW hm,
    cycleDensity_pullback_exact hφ hmap]

name: OddCycleBound.edgeDensity_pullback
statement:
theorem edgeDensity_pullback (hWg : IsGraphon W μ) (φ : Ω → Fin k) (hφ : Measurable φ)
    (hmap : Measure.map φ μ = uniformFin k)
    (hW : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), W p.1 p.2 = completePartite k (φ p.1) (φ p.2)) :
    edgeDensity W μ = edgeDensity (completePartite k) (uniformFin k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeDensity_congr_ae hWg (isGraphon_pullback hφ) hW, edgeDensity_pullback_exact hφ hmap]

name: OddCycleBound.gaps_eq_zero_of_eq
statement:
lemma gaps_eq_zero_of_eq (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (heq : cycleDensity μ W m =
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)) :
    DenseRegion.commonalityGap W μ m = 0 ∧
      cycleDensity μ (compl W) m = pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hgap := DenseRegion.commonality_gap_ge_degree_variance hW hp hm hm3
  have hV : 0 ≤ ((m : ℝ) - 1) *
      (∫ x, (degree W μ x - edgeDensity W μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ ((m - 1) / 2) := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ m by omega)
    exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (pow_nonneg (integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _) _)
  have hdel := edge_deletion_general (isGraphon_compl hW) (m - 2)
  rw [show m - 2 + 2 = m by omega, show m - 2 + 1 = m - 1 by omega] at hdel
  have hdef : DenseRegion.commonalityGap W μ m =
      cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m - pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1) -
        (edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)) := rfl
  constructor <;> linarith

name: OddCycleBound.completePartite_unique
statement:
theorem completePartite_unique {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hW : IsGraphon W μ)
    (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) (hp1 : edgeDensity W μ < 1)
    (heq : cycleDensity μ W m =
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 3 ≤ k ∧ edgeDensity W μ = 1 - 1 / k ∧
      ∃ φ : Ω → Fin k, Measurable φ ∧ Measure.map φ μ = uniformFin k ∧
        ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), W p.1 p.2 = completePartite k (φ p.1) (φ p.2)
proof:
:= by
  set q := 1 - edgeDensity W μ with hqdef
  have hq : 0 < q := by linarith
  have hU := isGraphon_compl hW
  obtain ⟨hgap, hcyc⟩ := gaps_eq_zero_of_eq hW hp hm hm3 heq
  
  have hregW := (DenseRegion.commonality_eq_iff_regular hW hp hm hm3).mp hgap
  have hdegU : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree (compl W) μ x = q := by
    filter_upwards [hregW] with x hx
    rw [DenseRegion.degree_compl hW, hx]
  have hcycU : cycleDensity μ (compl W) m = q ^ (m - 1) := by
    rw [hcyc, pathDensity_of_regular hU hdegU]
  obtain ⟨h01, hsq⟩ := regular_cycle_equality hU hq hdegU hm hm3 hcycU
  obtain ⟨k, hkq, φ, hφ, hmap, hφU⟩ := exists_clique_partition hU hq hdegU h01 hsq
  have hk0 : (k : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    rintro h; rw [h, zero_mul] at hkq; exact zero_ne_one hkq
  have hqk : q = 1 / k := by field_simp; linarith
  have hpk : edgeDensity W μ = 1 - 1 / k := by linarith
  refine ⟨k, ?_, hpk, φ, hφ, hmap, ?_⟩
  · have h3 : (3 : ℝ) ≤ k := by
      have hkpos : (0 : ℝ) < k := by
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk0 with h | h
        · exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr (Nat.cast_nonneg k))
        · exact h
      rw [hqk] at hq
      have : 1 / (k : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3 := by linarith
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hkpos (by norm_num)] at this
      linarith
    exact_mod_cast h3
  · filter_upwards [hφU] with p hp
    have : W p.1 p.2 = 1 - compl W p.1 p.2 := by simp [compl]
    rw [this, hp]
    unfold completePartite
    split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: OddCycleBound.pullback_attains_bound
statement:
theorem pullback_attains_bound (hWg : IsGraphon W μ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 1 ≤ k) (φ : Ω → Fin k)
    (hφ : Measurable φ) (hmap : Measure.map φ μ = uniformFin k)
    (hW : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), W p.1 p.2 = completePartite k (φ p.1) (φ p.2))
    {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m =
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleDensity_pullback hWg φ hφ hmap hW (by omega), edgeDensity_pullback hWg φ hφ hmap hW,
    edgeDensity_completePartite (by omega), cycleDensity_completePartite_odd hk hm]

name: OddCycleBound.GoodK.integrable_mul
statement:
lemma _root_.OddCycleBound.GoodK.integrable_mul {K L : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hK : GoodK K) (hL : GoodK L) :
    Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => K p.1 p.2 * L p.1 p.2) (μ.prod μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨CK, _, hCK⟩ := hK.bdd
  obtain ⟨CL, _, hCL⟩ := hL.bdd
  refine (integrable_const (CK * CL)).mono' (hK.meas.mul hL.meas).aestronglyMeasurable
    (ae_of_all _ fun p => ?_)
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul (hCK _ _) (hCL _ _) (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hCK p.1 p.2))

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.goodK_sub_smul
statement:
lemma goodK_sub_smul {A B : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hA : GoodK A) (hB : GoodK B) (c : ℝ) :
    GoodK (fun x y => A x y - c * B x y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨CA, hCA0, hCA⟩ := hA.bdd
  obtain ⟨CB, hCB0, hCB⟩ := hB.bdd
  refine ⟨hA.meas.sub (hB.meas.const_mul c), ⟨CA + |c| * CB, by positivity, fun x y => ?_⟩⟩
  calc |A x y - c * B x y| ≤ |A x y| + |c * B x y| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ CA + |c| * CB := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact add_le_add (hCA x y) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hCB x y) (abs_nonneg c))

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.hsInner_self_nonneg
statement: lemma hsInner_self_nonneg (K : Ω → Ω → ℝ) : 0 ≤ hsInner μ K K
proof:
:=
  integral_nonneg fun _ => mul_self_nonneg _

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.hsInner_sub_smul_self
statement:
lemma hsInner_sub_smul_self {A B : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hA : GoodK A) (hB : GoodK B) (c : ℝ) :
    hsInner μ (fun x y => A x y - c * B x y) (fun x y => A x y - c * B x y) =
      hsInner μ A A - 2 * c * hsInner μ A B + c ^ 2 * hsInner μ B B
proof:
:= by
  unfold hsInner
  have e : ∀ p : Ω × Ω, (A p.1 p.2 - c * B p.1 p.2) * (A p.1 p.2 - c * B p.1 p.2) =
      A p.1 p.2 * A p.1 p.2 - 2 * c * (A p.1 p.2 * B p.1 p.2) +
        c ^ 2 * (B p.1 p.2 * B p.1 p.2) := fun p => by ring
  simp_rw [e]
  have h1 : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => A p.1 p.2 * A p.1 p.2) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hA.integrable_mul hA
  have h2 : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => 2 * c * (A p.1 p.2 * B p.1 p.2)) (μ.prod μ) :=
    (hA.integrable_mul hB).const_mul _
  have h3 : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => c ^ 2 * (B p.1 p.2 * B p.1 p.2)) (μ.prod μ) :=
    (hB.integrable_mul hB).const_mul _
  have h12 : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω =>
      A p.1 p.2 * A p.1 p.2 - 2 * c * (A p.1 p.2 * B p.1 p.2)) (μ.prod μ) := h1.sub h2
  rw [integral_add h12 h3, integral_sub h1 h2, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.hsInner_sub_left
statement:
lemma hsInner_sub_left {A B C : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hA : GoodK A) (hB : GoodK B) (hC : GoodK C)
    (c : ℝ) :
    hsInner μ C (fun x y => A x y - c * B x y) = hsInner μ C A - c * hsInner μ C B
proof:
:= by
  unfold hsInner
  have e : ∀ p : Ω × Ω, C p.1 p.2 * (A p.1 p.2 - c * B p.1 p.2) =
      C p.1 p.2 * A p.1 p.2 - c * (C p.1 p.2 * B p.1 p.2) := fun p => by ring
  simp_rw [e]
  have h1 : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => C p.1 p.2 * A p.1 p.2) (μ.prod μ) :=
    hC.integrable_mul hA
  have h2 : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω => c * (C p.1 p.2 * B p.1 p.2)) (μ.prod μ) :=
    (hC.integrable_mul hB).const_mul _
  rw [integral_sub h1 h2, integral_const_mul]

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.hsInner_sq_le
statement:
lemma hsInner_sq_le {A B : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hA : GoodK A) (hB : GoodK B) :
    hsInner μ A B ^ 2 ≤ hsInner μ A A * hsInner μ B B
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ t : ℝ,
      0 ≤ hsInner μ B B * (t * t) + (-2 * hsInner μ A B) * t + hsInner μ A A := by
    intro t
    have := hsInner_self_nonneg (μ := μ) (fun x y => A x y - t * B x y)
    rw [hsInner_sub_smul_self hA hB t] at this
    nlinarith [this]
  have hd := discrim_le_zero h
  unfold discrim at hd
  nlinarith [hd]

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.hsInner_eq_zero_of_self_eq_zero
statement:
lemma hsInner_eq_zero_of_self_eq_zero {A B : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hA : GoodK A) (hB : GoodK B)
    (h : hsInner μ B B = 0) : hsInner μ A B = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := hsInner_sq_le (μ := μ) hA hB
  rw [h, mul_zero] at this
  exact pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp (le_antisymm this (sq_nonneg _))

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.ae_eq_zero_of_hsInner_self_eq_zero
statement:
lemma ae_eq_zero_of_hsInner_self_eq_zero {A : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hA : GoodK A)
    (h : hsInner μ A A = 0) : ∀ᵐ p ∂(μ.prod μ), A p.1 p.2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold hsInner at h
  rw [integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun p => mul_self_nonneg _) (hA.integrable_mul hA)] at h
  filter_upwards [h] with p hp
  exact mul_self_eq_zero.mp hp

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.trace_comp_eq_hsInner
statement:
lemma trace_comp_eq_hsInner {A B : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hA : GoodK A) (hB : GoodK B)
    (hBs : ∀ x y, B x y = B y x) : trace μ (comp μ A B) = hsInner μ A B
proof:
:= by
  unfold trace comp hsInner
  rw [integral_prod _ (hA.integrable_mul hB)]
  refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_))
  simp only [hBs z x]

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.comp_compPow_compPow
statement:
lemma comp_compPow_compPow {U : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hU : GoodK U) : ∀ a b : ℕ,
    comp μ (compPow μ U a) (compPow μ U b) = compPow μ U (a + b + 1)
proof:
| 0, b => by rw [show 0 + b + 1 = b + 1 by omega]; rfl
  | a + 1, b => by
      show comp μ (comp μ U (compPow μ U a)) (compPow μ U b) = _
      rw [comp_assoc hU (goodK_compPow hU a) (goodK_compPow hU b), comp_compPow_compPow hU a b,
        show a + 1 + b + 1 = (a + b + 1) + 1 by omega]
      rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.hsInner_compPow
statement:
lemma hsInner_compPow {U : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (a b : ℕ) :
    hsInner μ (compPow μ U a) (compPow μ U b) = trace μ (compPow μ U (a + b + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  rw [← comp_compPow_compPow hGU a b,
    trace_comp_eq_hsInner (goodK_compPow hGU a) (goodK_compPow hGU b)
      (compPow_symm hGU hU.symm b)]

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.pathIter_ae_eq_of_regular
statement:
lemma pathIter_ae_eq_of_regular (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {q : ℝ}
    (hdeg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree U μ x = q) : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, pathIter U μ k x = q ^ k
proof:
| 0 => ae_of_all _ fun _ => by simp [pathIter]
  | k + 1 => by
      have ih := pathIter_ae_eq_of_regular hU hdeg k
      filter_upwards [hdeg] with x hx
      show ∫ y, U x y * pathIter U μ k y ∂μ = q ^ (k + 1)
      have hcongr : (fun y => U x y * pathIter U μ k y) =ᵐ[μ] fun y => U x y * q ^ k := by
        filter_upwards [ih] with y hy
        rw [hy]
      rw [integral_congr_ae hcongr, integral_mul_const]
      change degree U μ x * q ^ k = _
      rw [hx, pow_succ]
      ring

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.pathDensity_of_regular
statement:
lemma pathDensity_of_regular (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {q : ℝ}
    (hdeg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree U μ x = q) (k : ℕ) : pathDensity U μ k = q ^ k
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathDensity, mean, integral_congr_ae (pathIter_ae_eq_of_regular hU hdeg k)]
  simp

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.sq_kernelOp_le
statement:
lemma sq_kernelOp_le (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (x : Ω) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) :
    (∫ z, U x z * f z ∂μ) ^ 2 ≤ degree U μ x * ∫ z, U x z * (f z * f z) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hI1 : Integrable (fun z => U x z * (f z * f z)) μ := integrable_Uf hU (hf.mul hf) x
  have hI2 : Integrable (fun z => U x z * f z) μ := integrable_Uf hU hf x
  have hI3 : Integrable (fun z => U x z) μ := (goodK_of_isGraphon hU).integrable_row x
  have h : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ degree U μ x * (t * t) + (2 * ∫ z, U x z * f z ∂μ) * t +
      ∫ z, U x z * (f z * f z) ∂μ := by
    intro t
    have hnn : 0 ≤ ∫ z, U x z * ((f z + t) * (f z + t)) ∂μ :=
      integral_nonneg fun z => mul_nonneg (hU.nonneg x z) (mul_self_nonneg _)
    have e : (fun z => U x z * ((f z + t) * (f z + t))) =
        fun z => U x z * (f z * f z) + (2 * t * (U x z * f z) + t * t * U x z) := by
      funext z; ring
    have hJ2 : Integrable (fun z => 2 * t * (U x z * f z)) μ := hI2.const_mul _
    have hJ3 : Integrable (fun z => t * t * U x z) μ := hI3.const_mul _
    have hJ : Integrable (fun z => 2 * t * (U x z * f z) + t * t * U x z) μ := hJ2.add hJ3
    rw [e, integral_add hI1 hJ, integral_add hJ2 hJ3, integral_const_mul,
      integral_const_mul] at hnn
    have hd : degree U μ x = ∫ z, U x z ∂μ := rfl
    rw [hd]
    nlinarith [hnn]
  have hd := discrim_le_zero h
  unfold discrim at hd
  nlinarith [hd]

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.integral_comp_row
statement:
lemma integral_comp_row {L : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hU : IsGraphon U μ) (hL : GoodK L) (x : Ω) :
    ∫ y, comp μ U L x y ∂μ = kernelOp U μ (fun z => ∫ y, L z y ∂μ) x
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := hL.bdd
  have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun y z => U x z * L z y) (μ.prod μ) := by
    have hm : Measurable (Function.uncurry fun y z => U x z * L z y) :=
      (hGU.meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_snd)).mul
        (hL.meas.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst))
    refine (integrable_const (1 * C)).mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun p => ?_)
    simp only [Function.uncurry, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (hU.nonneg _ _)]; exact hU.le_one _ _) (hC _ _)
      (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
  calc ∫ y, comp μ U L x y ∂μ = ∫ y, ∫ z, U x z * L z y ∂μ ∂μ := rfl
    _ = ∫ z, ∫ y, U x z * L z y ∂μ ∂μ := integral_integral_swap hint
    _ = ∫ z, U x z * ∫ y, L z y ∂μ ∂μ := by
        refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun z => ?_)
        exact integral_const_mul _ _
    _ = kernelOp U μ (fun z => ∫ y, L z y ∂μ) x := rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.good_rowIntegral
statement: lemma good_rowIntegral {L : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hL : GoodK L) : Good (fun z => ∫ y, L z y ∂μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hL.bdd
  refine ⟨(show StronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry L) from
    hL.meas.stronglyMeasurable).integral_prod_right', ⟨C, hC0, fun z => ?_⟩⟩
  calc |∫ y, L z y ∂μ| ≤ ∫ y, |L z y| ∂μ := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ ≤ ∫ _y, C ∂μ := integral_mono (hL.integrable_row z).abs (integrable_const C)
        fun y => hC z y
    _ = C := by simp

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.goodK_sq
statement: lemma goodK_sq {K : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hK : GoodK K) : GoodK (fun x y => K x y * K x y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hK.bdd
  refine ⟨hK.meas.mul hK.meas, ⟨C * C, mul_nonneg hC0 hC0, fun x y => ?_⟩⟩
  rw [abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul (hC x y) (hC x y) (abs_nonneg _) hC0

name: OddCycleBound.Equality.hsInner_comp_le
statement:
lemma hsInner_comp_le (hU : IsGraphon U μ) {q : ℝ} (hdeg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree U μ x = q)
    {K : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hK : GoodK K) :
    hsInner μ (comp μ U K) (comp μ U K) ≤ q ^ 2 * hsInner μ K K
proof:
:= by
  have hGU := goodK_of_isGraphon hU
  have hUK := goodK_comp (μ := μ) hGU hK
  have hK2 := goodK_sq hK
  have hUK2 := goodK_comp (μ := μ) hGU hK2
  have hD : GoodK (fun x y => degree U μ x * comp μ U (fun x y => K x y * K x y) x y) := by
    obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hUK2.bdd
    obtain ⟨Cd, hCd0, hCd⟩ := (good_degree hU).bdd
    refine ⟨((good_degree hU).meas.measurable.comp measurable_fst).mul hUK2.meas,
      ⟨Cd * C, mul_nonneg hCd0 hC0, fun x y => ?_⟩⟩
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hCd x) (hC x y) (abs_nonneg _) hCd0
  have hint1 := hUK.integrable_mul (μ := μ) hUK
  have hint2 : Integrable (fun p : Ω × Ω =>
      degree U μ p.1 * comp μ U (fun x y => K x y * K x y) p.1 p.2) (μ.prod μ) := by
    have := hD.integrable_mul (μ := μ) goodK_onesKernel
    simpa [onesKernel] using this
  have hrow : ∀ x, ∫ y, comp μ U K x y * comp μ U K x y ∂μ ≤
      ∫ y, degree U μ x * comp μ U (fun x y => K x y * K x y) x y ∂μ := by
    intro x
    refine integral_mono ((goodK_sq hUK).integrable_row x) (hD.integrable_row x) fun y => ?_
    have hf : Good (fun z => K z y) := by
      obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := hK.bdd
      exact ⟨(hK.meas.comp (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).stronglyMeasurable,
        ⟨C, hC0, fun z => hC z y⟩⟩
    calc comp μ U K x y * comp μ U K x y = (∫ z, U x z * K z y ∂μ) ^ 2 := by
          simp only [comp]; ring
      _ ≤ _ := sq_kernelOp_le hU x hf
  have h1 : hsInner μ (comp μ U K) (comp μ U K) ≤
      ∫ x, ∫ y, degree U μ x * comp μ U (fun x y => K x y * K x y) x y ∂μ ∂μ := by
    unfold hsInner
    rw [integral_prod _ hint1]
    exact integral_mono hint1.integral_prod_left hint2.integral_prod_left hrow
  set ρ : Ω → ℝ := fun z => ∫ y, K z y * K z y ∂μ with hρdef
  have hρ : Good ρ := good_rowIntegral (μ := μ) hK2
  have h2 : ∫ x, ∫ y, degree U μ x * comp μ U (fun x y => K x y * K x y) x y ∂μ ∂μ =
      q ^ 2 * hsInner μ K K := by
    calc ∫ x, ∫ y, degree U μ x * comp μ U (fun x y => K x y * K x y) x y ∂μ ∂μ
        = ∫ x, degree U μ x * kernelOp U μ ρ x ∂μ := by
          refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
          dsimp only
          rw [integral_const_mul, integral_comp_row hU hK2 x]
      _ = ∫ x, q * kernelOp U μ ρ x ∂μ := by
          refine integral_congr_ae ?_
          filter_upwards [hdeg] with x hx
          rw [hx]
      _ = q * ∫ x, ρ x * degree U μ x ∂μ := by
          rw [integral_const_mul]
          congr 1
          have hs := kernelOp_symm hU hρ good_one
          rw [kernelOp_one hU] at hs
          simpa only [mul_one] using hs
      _ = q * ∫ x, ρ x * q ∂μ := by
          congr 1
          refine integral_congr_ae ?_
          filter_upwards [hdeg] with x hx
          rw [hx]
      _ = q ^ 2 * hsInner μ K K := by
          rw [integral_mul_const]
          unfold hsInner
          rw [integral_prod _ (hK.integrable_mul hK)]
          ring
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.neckSum_ge_baseline_of_diagKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem neckSum_ge_baseline_of_diagKernel_nonneg {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hdiag : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r ∧ 2 * r < m →
      ∀ ell ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 : ℝ) / 2) (1 / 2),
        0 ≤ diagKernel m r (1 - edgeDensity W mu) ell) :
    edgeDensity W mu ^ m - edgeDensity W mu * (1 - edgeDensity W mu) ^ (m - 1) ≤
      neckSum W mu m
proof:
:= by
  rw [neckSum_eq_baseline_add_momentPhi hW hm hm3]
  linarith [momentPhi_specMoment_nonneg hm hm3 (isGraphon_compl hW)
    (1 - edgeDensity W mu) hdiag]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.neckSum_ge_baseline_of_multiKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem neckSum_ge_baseline_of_multiKernel_nonneg {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hP : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r ∧ 2 * r < m → ∀ L : List ℝ, L.length = r →
      (∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 : ℝ) / 2) (1 / 2)) →
        0 ≤ multiKernel m r (1 - edgeDensity W mu) L) :
    edgeDensity W mu ^ m - edgeDensity W mu * (1 - edgeDensity W mu) ^ (m - 1) ≤
      neckSum W mu m
proof:
:= by
  rw [neckSum_eq_baseline_add_momentPhi hW hm hm3]
  linarith [momentPhi_specMoment_nonneg' hm hm3 (isGraphon_compl hW)
    (1 - edgeDensity W mu) hP]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.cycle_bound_of_diagKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem cycle_bound_of_diagKernel_nonneg {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hdiag : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r ∧ 2 * r < m →
      ∀ ell ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 : ℝ) / 2) (1 / 2),
        0 ≤ diagKernel m r (1 - edgeDensity W mu) ell) :
    edgeDensity W mu ^ m - edgeDensity W mu * (1 - edgeDensity W mu) ^ (m - 1) ≤
      cycleDensity mu W m
proof:
:=
  cycle_bound_of_neckSum hW hm hm3
    (neckSum_ge_baseline_of_diagKernel_nonneg hW hm hm3 hdiag)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.hsym_cons
statement:
lemma hsym_cons (x : ℝ) (xs : List ℝ) (d : ℕ) :
    hsym (x :: xs) d = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), x ^ j * hsym xs (d - j)
proof: := rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.hsym_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma hsym_nil (d : ℕ) : hsym [] d = if d = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  cases d <;> rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.hsym_append
statement:
lemma hsym_append (ys : List ℝ) : ∀ (xs : List ℝ) (d : ℕ),
    hsym (xs ++ ys) d = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), hsym xs j * hsym ys (d - j)
proof:
