        -(∫ x, f x * kernelOp W mu f x ∂mu) := by
    calc
      (∫ x, f x * kernelOp U mu f x ∂mu) =
          ∫ x, -(f x * kernelOp W mu f x) ∂mu := by
            refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
            change f x * kernelOp (compl W) mu f x = _
            rw [kernelOp_compl hW hf x, hmean]
            ring
      _ = -(∫ x, f x * kernelOp W mu f x ∂mu) := by rw [integral_neg]
  have hdomU' :
      |∫ x, f x * kernelOp W mu f x ∂mu| ≤
        ∫ x, |f x| * kernelOp U mu (fun y => |f y|) x ∂mu := by
    simpa only [hcomp, abs_neg] using hdomU
  have hsum :
      (∫ x, |f x| * kernelOp W mu (fun y => |f y|) x ∂mu) +
          (∫ x, |f x| * kernelOp U mu (fun y => |f y|) x ∂mu) =
        (∫ x, |f x| ∂mu) ^ 2 := by
    have hWa := (good_abs hf).mul (good_kernelOp hW (good_abs hf))
    have hUa := (good_abs hf).mul (good_kernelOp hU (good_abs hf))
    rw [← integral_add hWa.integrable hUa.integrable]
    calc
      (∫ x,
          (|f x| * kernelOp W mu (fun y => |f y|) x +
            |f x| * kernelOp U mu (fun y => |f y|) x) ∂mu) =
          ∫ x, (∫ y, |f y| ∂mu) * |f x| ∂mu := by
            refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
            change _ + |f x| * kernelOp (compl W) mu (fun y => |f y|) x = _
            rw [kernelOp_compl hW (good_abs hf) x]
            simp only [mean]
            ring
      _ = (∫ x, |f x| ∂mu) ^ 2 := by
            rw [integral_const_mul]
            ring
  have hL1 := integral_abs_sq_le_integral_mul_self (mu := mu) hf
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.abs_inner_centeredGraphonOp_goodL2_le_half
statement:
lemma abs_inner_centeredGraphonOp_goodL2_le_half (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    {f : Omega → ℝ} (hf : Good f) :
    |inner ℝ (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf)
        (centeredGraphonOp hW (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf))| ≤
      (1 : ℝ) / 2 * ‖goodL2 (mu := mu) hf‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let fc : Omega → ℝ := fun x => f x - mean mu f
  have hfc : Good fc := good_sub hf (good_const (Omega := Omega) (mean mu f))
  have hfc_mean : mean mu fc = 0 := by
    unfold fc mean
    rw [integral_sub hf.integrable (integrable_const _)]
    simp
  have hP : centerProjection (Omega := Omega) (mu := mu)
      (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf) = goodL2 (mu := mu) hfc := by
    simpa only [fc] using centerProjection_apply_goodL2 (mu := mu) hf
  have hpoint := abs_integral_mul_kernelOp_le_half (mu := mu) hW hfc hfc_mean
  have hcontract := norm_centerProjection_apply_le (Omega := Omega) (mu := mu)
    (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf)
  have hsquare : ‖goodL2 (mu := mu) hfc‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖goodL2 (mu := mu) hf‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hP] at hcontract
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (goodL2 (mu := mu) hfc),
      norm_nonneg (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf)]
  have hquad :
      |inner ℝ (goodL2 (mu := mu) hfc)
          (kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW (goodL2 (mu := mu) hfc))| ≤
        (1 : ℝ) / 2 * ‖goodL2 (mu := mu) hfc‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [kernelOpCLM_goodL2_eq_goodL2 hW hfc,
      inner_goodL2_eq_integral_mul,
      norm_goodL2_sq_eq_integral_mul]
    exact hpoint
  change |inner ℝ (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf)
      (centerProjection (Omega := Omega) (mu := mu)
        (kernelOpCLM (mu := mu) hW
          (centerProjection (Omega := Omega) (mu := mu)
            (goodL2 (mu := mu) hf))))| ≤ _
  rw [← (centerProjection_isSymmetric (Omega := Omega) (mu := mu)).apply_clm,
    hP]
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.abs_inner_centeredGraphonOp_self_le_half
statement:
lemma abs_inner_centeredGraphonOp_self_le_half (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    (f : Lp ℝ 2 mu) :
    |inner ℝ f (centeredGraphonOp hW f)| ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let p : Lp ℝ 2 mu → Prop := fun f =>
    |inner ℝ f (centeredGraphonOp hW f)| ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2
  change p f
  exact DenseRange.induction_on
    (denseRange_goodL2 (Omega := Omega) (mu := mu)) f
    (by
      dsimp [p]
      exact isClosed_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop))
    (by
      intro a
      rcases a with ⟨g, hg⟩
      dsimp [p]
      exact abs_inner_centeredGraphonOp_goodL2_le_half (mu := mu) hW hg)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.norm_centeredGraphonOp_le_half
statement:
theorem norm_centeredGraphonOp_le_half (hW : IsGraphon W mu) :
    ‖centeredGraphonOp hW‖ ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [(centeredGraphonOp hW).norm_eq_iSup_rayleighQuotient
    (centeredGraphonOp_isSymmetric hW)]
  refine ciSup_le fun f => ?_
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  have hnorm : 0 < ‖f‖ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hf)
  have hquad := abs_inner_centeredGraphonOp_self_le_half (mu := mu) hW f
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.rayleighQuotient,
    ContinuousLinearMap.reApplyInnerSelf_apply]
  simp only [RCLike.re_to_real, abs_div, abs_sq]
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hnorm]
  simpa only [real_inner_comm, mul_assoc] using hquad

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.graphonAtomEigenvalue_mem_halfInterval
statement:
theorem graphonAtomEigenvalue_mem_halfInterval (hW : IsGraphon W mu) (d : ℕ) (i) :
    graphonAtomEigenvalue hW d i ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 : ℝ) / 2) (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact graphonAtomEigenvalue_mem_halfInterval_of_norm hW d
    (norm_centeredGraphonOp_le_half hW) i

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentPhi_specMoment_eq_graphonAtomicMoment
statement:
theorem momentPhi_specMoment_eq_graphonAtomicMoment (hW : IsGraphon W mu)
    (m : ℕ) (q : ℝ) :
    momentPhi m q (specMoment W mu) =
      momentPhi m q
        (atomicMoment (graphonAtomWeight hW m) (graphonAtomEigenvalue hW m))
proof:
:= by
  apply momentPhi_congr_of_le q
  intro j hj
  exact specMoment_eq_graphonAtomicMoment hW hj

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentPhi_specMoment_nonneg'
statement:
theorem momentPhi_specMoment_nonneg' {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu) (q : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r ∧ 2 * r < m → ∀ L : List ℝ, L.length = r →
      (∀ x ∈ L, x ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 : ℝ) / 2) (1 / 2)) → 0 ≤ multiKernel m r q L) :
    0 ≤ momentPhi m q (specMoment W mu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [momentPhi_specMoment_eq_graphonAtomicMoment hW m q]
  exact momentPhi_nonneg_of_atomic' hm hm3 q
    (graphonAtomWeight hW m) (graphonAtomEigenvalue hW m)
    (graphonAtomWeight_nonneg hW m)
    (graphonAtomEigenvalue_mem_halfInterval hW m)
    (fun r hr hrm => hP r ⟨hr, hrm⟩)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentPhi_specMoment_nonneg
statement:
theorem momentPhi_specMoment_nonneg {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m)
    (hW : IsGraphon W mu) (q : ℝ)
    (hdiag : ∀ r, 1 ≤ r ∧ 2 * r < m →
      ∀ ell ∈ Set.Icc (-(1 : ℝ) / 2) (1 / 2), 0 ≤ diagKernel m r q ell) :
    0 ≤ momentPhi m q (specMoment W mu)
proof:
:= by
  rw [momentPhi_specMoment_eq_graphonAtomicMoment hW m q]
  exact momentPhi_nonneg_of_atomic hm hm3 q
    (graphonAtomWeight hW m) (graphonAtomEigenvalue hW m)
    (graphonAtomWeight_nonneg hW m)
    (graphonAtomEigenvalue_mem_halfInterval hW m)
    (fun r hr hrm => hdiag r ⟨hr, hrm⟩)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.abs_eigenvalue_le_opNorm
statement:
lemma abs_eigenvalue_le_opNorm (A : E →L[ℝ] E) {lam : ℝ} {v : E}
    (hv : v ≠ 0) (heigen : A v = lam • v) : |lam| ≤ ‖A‖
proof:
:= by
  have hvpos : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hv
  have hmul : |lam| * ‖v‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖v‖ := by
    calc
      |lam| * ‖v‖ = ‖lam • v‖ := by rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ = ‖A v‖ := congrArg norm heigen.symm
      _ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖v‖ := A.le_opNorm v
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul hvpos

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.eigenvalue_mem_halfInterval
proof:
:= by
  have habs : |lam| ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 2 := (abs_eigenvalue_le_opNorm A hv heigen).trans hA
  constructor <;> linarith [neg_abs_le lam, le_abs_self lam]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.conv_comm
statement: lemma conv_comm (f g : ℕ → ℝ) : conv f g = conv g f
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  unfold conv
  rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
  rw [show n + 1 - 1 - i = n - i by omega, show n - (n - i) = i by omega, mul_comm]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.conv_assoc
statement: lemma conv_assoc (f g h : ℕ → ℝ) : conv (conv f g) h = conv f (conv g h)
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  simp only [conv, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun p => ⟨p.2, p.1 - p.2⟩) (fun p => ⟨p.1 + p.2, p.1⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨j, k⟩ hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp
    show (⟨j + (i - j), j⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) = ⟨i, j⟩
    rw [show j + (i - j) = i by omega]
  · rintro ⟨j, k⟩ hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp
    show (⟨j, j + k - j⟩ : Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) = ⟨j, k⟩
    rw [show j + k - j = k by omega]
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hp
    show f j * g (i - j) * h (n - i) = f j * (g (i - j) * h (n - j - (i - j)))
    rw [show n - j - (i - j) = n - i by omega]
    ring

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.conv_left_comm
statement: lemma conv_left_comm (f g h : ℕ → ℝ) : conv f (conv g h) = conv g (conv f h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← conv_assoc, conv_comm f g, conv_assoc]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.conv_conv_conv_comm
statement:
lemma conv_conv_conv_comm (a b c d : ℕ → ℝ) :
    conv a (conv b (conv c d)) = conv (conv a c) (conv b d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [conv_left_comm b c d, conv_assoc]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.hsym_cons_eq_conv
statement:
lemma hsym_cons_eq_conv (y : ℝ) (L : List ℝ) :
    (fun d => hsym (y :: L) d) = conv (fun i => y ^ i) (fun d => hsym L d)
proof:
:= by
  funext d; rw [hsym_cons]; rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.momentConv_succ_eq_conv
statement:
lemma momentConv_succ_eq_conv (s : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    momentConv s (r + 1) = conv s (momentConv s r)
proof:
:= by
  funext j; rw [momentConv_succ]; rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.le_excess_of_mem
statement: lemma le_excess_of_mem {t : List (ℕ × ℕ)} {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ t) : p.1 + p.2 ≤ excess t
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | nil => simp at hp
  | cons a t ih =>
      rw [excess_cons]
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hp with rfl | hp
      · omega
      · have := ih hp; omega

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.mem_listsOf_filter_excess
statement:
lemma mem_listsOf_filter_excess {r N M : ℕ} (hM : M ≤ N) {t : List (ℕ × ℕ)} :
    t ∈ (listsOf (range (N + 1) ×ˢ range (N + 1)) r).filter (fun t => excess t = M) ↔
      t.length = r ∧ excess t = M
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_listsOf]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hlen, _⟩, hex⟩; exact ⟨hlen, hex⟩
  · rintro ⟨hlen, hex⟩
    refine ⟨⟨hlen, fun p hp => ?_⟩, hex⟩
    have := le_excess_of_mem hp
    simp only [Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
    omega

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.mem_tuples
statement:
lemma mem_tuples {r N : ℕ} {t : List (ℕ × ℕ)} :
    t ∈ tuples r N ↔ t.length = r ∧ excess t = N
proof:
:=
  mem_listsOf_filter_excess le_rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_tuples_succ
statement:
lemma sum_tuples_succ (r N : ℕ) (G : List (ℕ × ℕ) → ℝ) :
    ∑ t ∈ tuples (r + 1) N, G t =
      ∑ a ∈ range (N + 1), ∑ b ∈ range (N - a + 1),
        ∑ t ∈ tuples r (N - a - b), G ((a, b) :: t)
proof:
:= by
  set S := range (N + 1) ×ˢ range (N + 1) with hS
  rw [tuples, Finset.sum_filter, ← hS, sum_listsOf_succ, hS, Finset.sum_product]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at ha
  have hsplit : ∀ b ∈ range (N + 1), (∑ t ∈ listsOf S r,
      if excess ((a, b) :: t) = N then G ((a, b) :: t) else 0) =
      if a + b ≤ N then ∑ t ∈ tuples r (N - a - b), G ((a, b) :: t) else 0 := by
    intro b _
    split_ifs with hab
    · rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
      refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
      ext t
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_tuples, mem_listsOf, excess_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨hlen, _⟩, hex⟩; exact ⟨hlen, by simp at hex; omega⟩
      · rintro ⟨hlen, hex⟩
        refine ⟨⟨hlen, fun p hp => ?_⟩, by simp; omega⟩
        have := le_excess_of_mem hp
        simp only [hS, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
        omega
    · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t _ => ?_
      rw [if_neg]
      rw [excess_cons]; simp only; omega
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hsplit, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
  ext b
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  omega

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.tupleWeight_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma tupleWeight_nil (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) : tupleWeight q s [] = 1
proof: := rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.tupleWeight_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma tupleWeight_cons (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) (p : ℕ × ℕ) (t : List (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    tupleWeight q s (p :: t) = q ^ p.1 * s p.2 * tupleWeight q s t
proof:
:= by
  simp [tupleWeight]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.tupleSum_zero
statement:
lemma tupleSum_zero (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    tupleSum q s 0 N = if N = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold tupleSum
  by_cases hN : N = 0
  · subst hN
    rw [if_pos rfl, Finset.sum_eq_single []]
    · exact tupleWeight_nil q s
    · intro t ht hne
      rw [mem_tuples, List.length_eq_zero_iff] at ht
      exact absurd ht.1 hne
    · intro h; exact (h (mem_tuples.mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)).elim
  · rw [if_neg hN]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t ht => ?_
    rw [mem_tuples, List.length_eq_zero_iff] at ht
    obtain ⟨rfl, h⟩ := ht
    exact absurd h.symm hN

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.tupleSum_succ
statement:
lemma tupleSum_succ (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) (r : ℕ) :
    tupleSum q s (r + 1) = conv (fun i => q ^ i) (conv s (tupleSum q s r))
proof:
:= by
  funext N
  unfold tupleSum conv
  rw [sum_tuples_succ]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr (by rw [Nat.sub_sub]) fun t _ => ?_
  rw [tupleWeight_cons]
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.tupleSum_eq
statement:
theorem tupleSum_eq (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) : ∀ r : ℕ,
    tupleSum q s r = conv (fun d => hsym (List.replicate r q) d) (momentConv s r)
proof:
| 0 => by
      funext N
      rw [tupleSum_zero]
      unfold conv
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
      · simp only [List.replicate_zero, hsym_nil, if_true, one_mul, Nat.sub_zero]
        cases N <;> simp
      · intro i _ hi; simp [hi]
      · intro h; simp at h
  | r + 1 => by
      rw [tupleSum_succ, tupleSum_eq q s r, conv_conv_conv_comm, List.replicate_succ,
        hsym_cons_eq_conv, momentConv_succ_eq_conv]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.blockWord_of_pq
statement:
lemma blockWord_of_pq {l : List Bool} (hl : l.head? = some false) (hl' : l.getLast? = some true) :
    ∃ t, t ≠ [] ∧ l = blockWord t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, a, rfl⟩ := exists_blockWord l.length l le_rfl (by rw [hl]; simp)
  cases a with
  | zero =>
      refine ⟨t, ?_, by simp⟩
      rintro rfl; simp at hl
  | succ a =>
      exfalso
      rw [List.replicate_succ', ← List.append_assoc, List.getLast?_concat] at hl'
      simp at hl'

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.isMark_rot
statement:
lemma isMark_rot (j i : Fin (n + 1)) (w : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) :
    IsMark (rot j w) i ↔ IsMark w (i + j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsMark, rot, sub_add_eq_add_sub]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.rot_rot
statement: lemma rot_rot (i j : Fin (n + 1)) (w : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) : rot i (rot j w) = rot (j + i) w
proof:
:= by
  funext x; simp only [rot]; congr 1; abel

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.rot_zero
statement: lemma rot_zero (w : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) : rot 0 w = w
proof:
:= by
  funext x; simp [rot]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.numMarks_rot
statement:
lemma numMarks_rot (j : Fin (n + 1)) (w : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) :
    numMarks (rot j w) = numMarks w
proof:
:= by
  unfold numMarks marks
  refine Finset.card_nbij' (fun i => i + j) (fun i => i - j) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hi ⊢
    exact (isMark_rot j i w).mp hi
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.coe_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hi ⊢
    rw [isMark_rot, sub_add_cancel]; exact hi
  · intro i _; simp
  · intro i _; simp

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_numMarks_mul
statement:
theorem sum_numMarks_mul (F : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ) (hF : ∀ j w, F (rot j w) = F w) :
    ∑ w, (numMarks w : ℝ) * F w = (n + 1) * ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => IsMark v 0), F v
proof:
:= by
  calc ∑ w, (numMarks w : ℝ) * F w
      = ∑ w, ∑ j, if IsMark w j then F w else 0 := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
        rw [← Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        rfl
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ w, if IsMark w j then F w else 0 := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ _j : Fin (n + 1), ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => IsMark v 0), F v := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
        refine Finset.sum_nbij' (rot j) (rot (-j)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro w hw
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hw ⊢
          rw [isMark_rot, zero_add]; exact hw
        · intro v hv
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hv ⊢
          exact (isMark_rot (-j) j v).mpr (by rw [add_neg_cancel]; exact hv)
        · intro w _; rw [rot_rot, add_neg_cancel, rot_zero]
        · intro v _; rw [rot_rot, neg_add_cancel, rot_zero]
        · intro w _; exact (hF j w).symm
    _ = (n + 1) * ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => IsMark v 0), F v := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul]
        push_cast; ring

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_numMarks_eq
statement:
theorem sum_numMarks_eq (r : ℕ) (F : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ j w, F (rot j w) = F w) :
    (r : ℝ) * ∑ w ∈ univ.filter (fun w => numMarks w = r), F w =
      (n + 1) * ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => IsMark v 0 ∧ numMarks v = r), F v
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_numMarks_mul (fun w => if numMarks w = r then F w else 0) fun j w => by
    simp only [numMarks_rot, hF]
  have e1 : ∑ w, (numMarks w : ℝ) * (if numMarks w = r then F w else 0) =
      (r : ℝ) * ∑ w ∈ univ.filter (fun w => numMarks w = r), F w := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
    split_ifs with hw
    · rw [hw]
    · ring
  have e2 : ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => IsMark v 0), (if numMarks v = r then F v else 0) =
      ∑ v ∈ univ.filter (fun v => IsMark v 0 ∧ numMarks v = r), F v := by
    rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
    rw [ite_and]
  rw [← e1, h, e2]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.eq_const_of_numMarks_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_const_of_numMarks_eq_zero {w : Fin (n + 1) → Bool} (h : numMarks w = 0) :
    w = (fun _ => false) ∨ w = (fun _ => true)
proof:
:= by
  have hno : ∀ j, w (j - 1) = true → w j = true := by
    intro j hj
    by_contra hjf
    have hmem : j ∈ marks w := by
      simp only [marks, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, IsMark]
      exact ⟨hj, by simpa using hjf⟩
    rw [numMarks, Finset.card_eq_zero] at h
    rw [h] at hmem
    exact absurd hmem (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  by_cases hall : ∀ i, w i = false
  · left; funext i; exact hall i
  · right
    simp only [not_forall] at hall
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hall
    have hi' : w i = true := by simpa using hi
    have hstep : ∀ d : Fin (n + 1), w (i + d) = true := by
      intro d
      induction d using Fin.induction with
      | zero => simpa using hi'
      | succ k ih =>
          apply hno
          rw [← Fin.coeSucc_eq_succ, ← add_assoc, add_sub_cancel_right]
          exact ih
    funext j
    have := hstep (j - i)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel] at this

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.mem_listsOf
statement:
lemma mem_listsOf {s : Finset α} : ∀ {r : ℕ} {l : List α},
    l ∈ listsOf s r ↔ l.length = r ∧ ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ s
proof:
| 0, l => by cases l <;> simp [listsOf]
  | r + 1, l => by
      cases l with
      | nil => simp [listsOf]
      | cons a l =>
          simp only [listsOf, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_product, Prod.exists,
            List.cons.injEq, List.length_cons, List.mem_cons, forall_eq_or_imp]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨b, l', ⟨hb, hl'⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
            exact ⟨by rw [(mem_listsOf.mp hl').1], hb, (mem_listsOf.mp hl').2⟩
          · rintro ⟨hlen, ha, hl⟩
            exact ⟨a, l, ⟨ha, mem_listsOf.mpr ⟨by omega, hl⟩⟩, rfl, rfl⟩

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_listsOf_succ
statement:
lemma sum_listsOf_succ {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (s : Finset α) (r : ℕ)
    (G : List α → β) :
    ∑ l ∈ listsOf s (r + 1), G l = ∑ a ∈ s, ∑ l ∈ listsOf s r, G (a :: l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [listsOf, Finset.sum_image, Finset.sum_product]
  rintro ⟨a, l⟩ _ ⟨b, l'⟩ _ h
  simp only [List.cons.injEq] at h
  rw [h.1, h.2]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.mem_allWords
statement: lemma mem_allWords {L : ℕ} {l : List Bool} : l ∈ allWords L ↔ l.length = L
proof:
:= by
  simp [allWords, mem_listsOf]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_allWords_succ
statement:
lemma sum_allWords_succ {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (L : ℕ) (G : List Bool → β) :
    ∑ l ∈ allWords (L + 1), G l = ∑ l ∈ allWords L, (G (false :: l) + G (true :: l))
proof:
:= by
  rw [allWords, sum_listsOf_succ, Fintype.sum_bool, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => add_comm _ _

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_fin_eq_sum_allWords
statement:
lemma sum_fin_eq_sum_allWords {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] :
    ∀ (L : ℕ) (G : List Bool → β), ∑ w : Fin L → Bool, G (List.ofFn w) = ∑ l ∈ allWords L, G l
proof:
| 0, G => by simp [allWords, listsOf]
  | L + 1, G => by
      rw [← (Fin.consEquiv fun _ : Fin (L + 1) => Bool).sum_comp, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
        allWords, sum_listsOf_succ]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
      show _ = ∑ l ∈ allWords L, G (b :: l)
      rw [← sum_fin_eq_sum_allWords L (fun l => G (b :: l))]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
      simp [Fin.consEquiv, List.ofFn_succ]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.blockWord_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma blockWord_nil : blockWord [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.blockWord_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma blockWord_cons (p : ℕ × ℕ) (t : List (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    blockWord (p :: t) = blk p ++ blockWord t
proof: := by simp [blockWord]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.excess_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma excess_nil : excess [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.excess_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma excess_cons (p : ℕ × ℕ) (t : List (ℕ × ℕ)) :
    excess (p :: t) = p.1 + p.2 + excess t
proof: := by simp [excess]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.length_blockWord
statement: lemma length_blockWord : ∀ t : List (ℕ × ℕ), (blockWord t).length = excess t + 2 * t.length
proof:
| [] => rfl
  | p :: t => by
      simp only [blockWord_cons, List.length_append, blk, List.length_replicate,
        length_blockWord t, excess_cons, List.length_cons]
      ring

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.head?_blockWord_append
statement:
lemma head?_blockWord_append (t : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (a : ℕ) :
    (blockWord t ++ List.replicate a false).head? ≠ some true
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | nil => cases a <;> simp [List.replicate_succ]
  | cons p t => simp [blk, List.replicate_succ]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.exists_run
statement:
lemma exists_run (a : Bool) : ∀ l : List Bool,
    ∃ k l', l = List.replicate k a ++ l' ∧ l'.head? ≠ some a
proof:
| [] => ⟨0, [], by simp⟩
  | b :: l => by
      by_cases hb : b = a
      · obtain ⟨k, l', hl, hl'⟩ := exists_run a l
        exact ⟨k + 1, l', by rw [hl, hb]; simp [List.replicate_succ], hl'⟩
      · exact ⟨0, b :: l, by simp, by simpa using hb⟩

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.run_unique
statement:
lemma run_unique (a : Bool) : ∀ (k k' : ℕ) (l l' : List Bool),
    l.head? ≠ some a → l'.head? ≠ some a →
    List.replicate k a ++ l = List.replicate k' a ++ l' → k = k' ∧ l = l'
proof:
| 0, 0, l, l', _, _, h => ⟨rfl, by simpa using h⟩
  | k + 1, 0, l, l', _, h', h => by
      simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at h
      rw [← h] at h'; simp at h'
  | 0, k' + 1, l, l', hl, _, h => by
      simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append, List.cons_append] at h
      rw [h] at hl; simp at hl
  | k + 1, k' + 1, l, l', hl, hl', h => by
      simp only [List.replicate_succ, List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq, true_and] at h
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := run_unique a k k' l l' hl hl' h
      exact ⟨by rw [h1], h2⟩

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.exists_blockWord
statement:
lemma exists_blockWord : ∀ (L : ℕ) (l : List Bool), l.length ≤ L → l.head? ≠ some true →
    ∃ t a, l = blockWord t ++ List.replicate a false
proof:
| L, l, hL, hl => by
      obtain ⟨k, l₁, rfl, hl₁⟩ := exists_run false l
      cases l₁ with
      | nil => exact ⟨[], k, by simp⟩
      | cons b l₁ =>
          have hb : b = true := by simpa using hl₁
          subst hb
          obtain ⟨k', l₂, hl₂eq, hl₂⟩ := exists_run true (true :: l₁)
          have hk : k ≠ 0 := by
            rintro rfl; simp at hl
          have hk' : k' ≠ 0 := by
            rintro rfl
            simp only [List.replicate_zero, List.nil_append] at hl₂eq
            rw [← hl₂eq] at hl₂; simp at hl₂
          obtain ⟨L', rfl⟩ : ∃ L', L = L' + 1 := ⟨L - 1, by
            simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons] at hL
            omega⟩
          have hlen : l₂.length ≤ L' := by
            have := congrArg List.length hl₂eq
            simp only [List.length_append, List.length_replicate, List.length_cons] at this hL
            omega
          obtain ⟨t, a, rfl⟩ := exists_blockWord L' l₂ hlen hl₂
          refine ⟨(k - 1, k' - 1) :: t, a, ?_⟩
          rw [hl₂eq]
          simp only [blockWord_cons, blk, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hk),
            Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hk'), List.append_assoc]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.blockWord_append_injective
statement:
lemma blockWord_append_injective : ∀ (t t' : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (a a' : ℕ),
    blockWord t ++ List.replicate a false = blockWord t' ++ List.replicate a' false →
      t = t' ∧ a = a'
proof:
| [], [], a, a', h => by
      simp only [blockWord_nil, List.nil_append] at h
      exact ⟨rfl, by simpa using congrArg List.length h⟩
  | [], p :: t', a, a', h => by
      exfalso
      have hmem : true ∈ blockWord (p :: t') ++ List.replicate a' false := by
        simp [blk, List.mem_replicate]
      rw [← h] at hmem
      simp [List.mem_replicate] at hmem
  | p :: t, [], a, a', h => by
      exfalso
      have hmem : true ∈ blockWord (p :: t) ++ List.replicate a false := by
        simp [blk, List.mem_replicate]
      rw [h] at hmem
      simp [List.mem_replicate] at hmem
  | p :: t, p' :: t', a, a', h => by
      simp only [blockWord_cons, blk, List.append_assoc] at h
      have hhd : ∀ (s : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (b : ℕ),
          (blockWord s ++ List.replicate b false).head? ≠ some true :=
        head?_blockWord_append
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := run_unique false (p.1 + 1) (p'.1 + 1) _ _ (by simp [List.replicate_succ])
        (by simp [List.replicate_succ]) h
      obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := run_unique true (p.2 + 1) (p'.2 + 1) _ _ (hhd t a) (hhd t' a') h2
      obtain ⟨h5, h6⟩ := blockWord_append_injective t t' a a' h4
      refine ⟨?_, h6⟩
      rw [h5]
      congr 1
      exact Prod.ext (by omega) (by omega)

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.qpCount_append
statement:
lemma qpCount_append : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List Bool, qpCount (l₁ ++ l₂) =
    qpCount l₁ + qpCount l₂ +
      (if l₁.getLast? = some true ∧ l₂.head? = some false then 1 else 0)
proof:
| [], l₂ => by simp [qpCount]
  | [a], [] => by simp [qpCount]
  | [a], b :: l₂ => by
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, qpCount, List.getLast?_singleton,
        List.head?_cons, Option.some.injEq]
      ring
  | a :: b :: l₁, l₂ => by
      simp only [List.cons_append, qpCount]
      rw [← List.cons_append, qpCount_append (b :: l₁) l₂, List.getLast?_cons_cons]
      ring

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.qpCount_replicate
statement: lemma qpCount_replicate (a : Bool) : ∀ k, qpCount (List.replicate k a) = 0
proof:
| 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | k + 2 => by
      rw [List.replicate_succ, List.replicate_succ, qpCount, ← List.replicate_succ,
        qpCount_replicate a (k + 1)]
      cases a <;> simp

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.getLast?_replicate_succ
statement:
lemma getLast?_replicate_succ (a : Bool) (k : ℕ) :
    (List.replicate (k + 1) a).getLast? = some a
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.replicate_succ', List.getLast?_concat]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.qpCount_blk
statement: lemma qpCount_blk (p : ℕ × ℕ) : qpCount (blk p) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [blk, qpCount_append, qpCount_replicate, qpCount_replicate, getLast?_replicate_succ]
  simp

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.getLast?_blk
statement: lemma getLast?_blk (p : ℕ × ℕ) : (blk p).getLast? = some true
proof:
:= by
  rw [blk, List.getLast?_append_of_ne_nil _ (by simp), getLast?_replicate_succ]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.head?_blk_append
statement: lemma head?_blk_append (p : ℕ × ℕ) (l : List Bool) : (blk p ++ l).head? = some false
proof:
:= by
  simp [blk, List.replicate_succ]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.getLast?_blockWord
statement: lemma getLast?_blockWord : ∀ {t : List (ℕ × ℕ)}, t ≠ [] → (blockWord t).getLast? = some true
proof:
| [p], _ => by simp [getLast?_blk]
  | p :: p' :: t, _ => by
      rw [blockWord_cons, List.getLast?_append_of_ne_nil]
      · exact getLast?_blockWord (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
      · simp [blk]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.qpCount_blockWord
statement: lemma qpCount_blockWord : ∀ {t : List (ℕ × ℕ)}, t ≠ [] → qpCount (blockWord t) + 1 = t.length
proof:
| [p], _ => by simp [qpCount_blk]
  | p :: p' :: t, _ => by
      rw [blockWord_cons, qpCount_append, qpCount_blk, getLast?_blk, blockWord_cons,
        head?_blk_append, ← blockWord_cons]
      have := qpCount_blockWord (t := p' :: t) (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
      simp only [and_self, if_true, List.length_cons] at this ⊢
      omega

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.isPQ_blockWord
statement: lemma isPQ_blockWord {t : List (ℕ × ℕ)} (ht : t ≠ []) : IsPQ (blockWord t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, t', rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil ht
  exact ⟨by rw [blockWord_cons, head?_blk_append], getLast?_blockWord ht⟩

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.fin_zero_sub_one
statement: lemma fin_zero_sub_one (n : ℕ) : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) - 1 = Fin.last n
proof:
:=
  (eq_sub_of_add_eq (Fin.last_add_one n)).symm

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.fin_succ_sub_one
statement: lemma fin_succ_sub_one {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : (i.succ : Fin (n + 1)) - 1 = i.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add, Fin.coeSucc_eq_succ]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.head?_ofFn
statement: lemma head?_ofFn {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) : (List.ofFn v).head? = some (v 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.ofFn_succ]; rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.getLast?_ofFn
statement:
lemma getLast?_ofFn {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) :
    (List.ofFn v).getLast? = some (v (Fin.last n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.ofFn_succ', List.concat_eq_append, List.getLast?_concat]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.isMark_zero_iff
statement: lemma isMark_zero_iff {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) : IsMark v 0 ↔ IsPQ (List.ofFn v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsMark, IsPQ, head?_ofFn, getLast?_ofFn, fin_zero_sub_one]
  simp only [Option.some.injEq]
  tauto

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_lin_qp
statement:
lemma sum_lin_qp : ∀ {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → Bool),
    (∑ i : Fin n, if v i.castSucc = true ∧ v i.succ = false then 1 else 0) =
      qpCount (List.ofFn v)
proof:
| 0, v => by simp [List.ofFn_succ, qpCount]
  | n + 1, v => by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, List.ofFn_succ, List.ofFn_succ]
      have ih := sum_lin_qp (n := n) (fun i => v i.succ)
      rw [List.ofFn_succ] at ih
      simp only [qpCount]
      rw [← ih]
      simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_castSucc]
      rfl

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.numMarks_eq
statement:
lemma numMarks_eq {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) :
    numMarks v = (if IsMark v 0 then 1 else 0) + qpCount (List.ofFn v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [numMarks, marks, Finset.card_filter, Fin.sum_univ_succ, ← sum_lin_qp]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  simp only [IsMark, fin_succ_sub_one]

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_pq_eq_sum_tuples
statement:
theorem sum_pq_eq_sum_tuples {L r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (h2r : 2 * r ≤ L) (H : List Bool → ℝ) :
    ∑ l ∈ (allWords L).filter (fun l => IsPQ l ∧ qpCount l + 1 = r), H l =
      ∑ t ∈ tuples r (L - 2 * r), H (blockWord t)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun t _ => blockWord t) ?_ ?_ ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
  · intro t ht
    rw [mem_tuples] at ht
    have hne : t ≠ [] := by rintro rfl; simp at ht; omega
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_allWords, length_blockWord]
    refine ⟨by omega, isPQ_blockWord hne, ?_⟩
    rw [qpCount_blockWord hne, ht.1]
  · intro t ht t' ht' h
    have := blockWord_append_injective t t' 0 0 (by simpa using h)
    exact this.1
  · intro l hl
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_allWords] at hl
    obtain ⟨hlen, hpq, hqp⟩ := hl
    obtain ⟨t, hne, rfl⟩ := blockWord_of_pq hpq.1 hpq.2
    refine ⟨t, ?_, rfl⟩
    rw [qpCount_blockWord hne] at hqp
    rw [mem_tuples]
    rw [length_blockWord] at hlen
    exact ⟨hqp, by omega⟩

name: OddCycleBound.Excursion.sum_head_ne_true_eq
statement:
theorem sum_head_ne_true_eq (L : ℕ) (H : List Bool → ℝ) :
    ∑ l ∈ (allWords L).filter (fun l => l.head? ≠ some true), H l =
      ∑ r ∈ range (L + 1), ∑ N ∈ range (L + 1),
        if 2 * r + N ≤ L then
          ∑ t ∈ tuples r N, H (blockWord t ++ List.replicate (L - 2 * r - N) false)
        else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Finset (Σ _ : ℕ, Σ _ : ℕ, List (ℕ × ℕ)) :=
    (range (L + 1)).sigma fun r => (range (L + 1)).sigma fun N =>
      if 2 * r + N ≤ L then tuples r N else ∅ with hS
  have hRHS : (∑ r ∈ range (L + 1), ∑ N ∈ range (L + 1),
      if 2 * r + N ≤ L then
        ∑ t ∈ tuples r N, H (blockWord t ++ List.replicate (L - 2 * r - N) false)
      else 0) =
      ∑ x ∈ S, H (blockWord x.2.2 ++ List.replicate (L - 2 * x.1 - x.2.1) false) := by
    rw [hS, Finset.sum_sigma]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_sigma]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun N _ => ?_
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [hRHS]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun x _ => blockWord x.2.2 ++ List.replicate (L - 2 * x.1 - x.2.1) false)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
  · rintro ⟨r, N, t⟩ hx
    simp only [hS, Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hx
    obtain ⟨hr, hN, ht⟩ := hx
    dsimp only
    split_ifs at ht with hle
    · rw [mem_tuples] at ht
      rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_allWords, List.length_append, length_blockWord,
        List.length_replicate]
      exact ⟨by omega, head?_blockWord_append t _⟩
    · simp at ht
  · rintro ⟨r, N, t⟩ hx ⟨r', N', t'⟩ hx' h
    simp only [hS, Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hx hx'
    obtain ⟨_, _, ht⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨_, _, ht'⟩ := hx'
    split_ifs at ht ht' with h1 h2
    · rw [mem_tuples] at ht ht'
      obtain ⟨rfl, _⟩ := blockWord_append_injective t t' _ _ h
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := ht
      obtain ⟨hr', hN'⟩ := ht'
      subst hr' hN'
      rfl
    all_goals simp at ht ht'
  · intro l hl
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_allWords] at hl
    obtain ⟨hlen, hhead⟩ := hl
    obtain ⟨t, a, rfl⟩ := exists_blockWord l.length l le_rfl hhead
    rw [List.length_append, length_blockWord, List.length_replicate] at hlen
    refine ⟨⟨t.length, excess t, t⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [hS, Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range]
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      rw [if_pos (by omega), mem_tuples]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · show blockWord t ++ List.replicate (L - 2 * t.length - excess t) false =
        blockWord t ++ List.replicate a false
      congr 2
      omega

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.kerP_add_kerQ
statement: lemma kerP_add_kerQ (x y : Ω) : kerP V μ x y + kerQ V μ x y = V x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kerP, kerQ]; ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.goodK_kerP
statement: lemma goodK_kerP (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : GoodK (kerP V μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := (good_degree hV).bdd
  exact ⟨(good_degree hV).meas.measurable.comp measurable_snd, ⟨C, hC0, fun _ y => hC y⟩⟩

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.goodK_kerQ
statement: lemma goodK_kerQ (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : GoodK (kerQ V μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC⟩ := (good_degree hV).bdd
  refine ⟨hV.meas.sub ((good_degree hV).meas.measurable.comp measurable_snd),
    ⟨1 + C, by positivity, fun x y => ?_⟩⟩
  simp only [kerQ]
  have h1 : |V x y| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (hV.nonneg x y)]; exact hV.le_one x y
  calc |V x y - degree V μ y| ≤ |V x y| + |degree V μ y| := abs_sub _ _
    _ ≤ 1 + C := add_le_add h1 (hC y)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.goodK_letterKer
statement: lemma goodK_letterKer (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (b : Bool) : GoodK (letterKer V μ b)
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · exact goodK_kerP hV
  · exact goodK_kerQ hV

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.goodK_wordKer
statement: lemma goodK_wordKer (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : ∀ (b : Bool) (l : List Bool), GoodK (wordKer V μ b l)
proof:
| b, [] => goodK_letterKer hV b
  | b, c :: l => goodK_comp (goodK_letterKer hV b) (goodK_wordKer hV c l)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.goodK_listKer
statement: lemma goodK_listKer (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : ∀ l : List Bool, GoodK (listKer V μ l)
proof:
| [] => goodK_zero
  | b :: l => goodK_wordKer hV b l

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.comp_finset_sum_right
statement:
lemma comp_finset_sum_right {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) {K : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hK : GoodK K)
    {L : ι → Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hL : ∀ i ∈ s, GoodK (L i)) :
    comp μ K (fun x y => ∑ i ∈ s, L i x y) = fun x y => ∑ i ∈ s, comp μ K (L i) x y
proof:
:= by
  funext x y
  simp only [comp, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact integral_finsetSum s fun i hi => integrable_KL hK (hL i hi) x y

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.trace_finset_sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [trace]
  exact integral_finsetSum s fun i hi => (hL i hi).diag_integrable

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.comp_eq_kerP_add_kerQ
statement:
lemma comp_eq_kerP_add_kerQ (hV : IsGraphon V μ) {L : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hL : GoodK L) :
    comp μ V L = fun x y => comp μ (kerP V μ) L x y + comp μ (kerQ V μ) L x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_add_left (goodK_kerP hV) (goodK_kerQ hV) hL]
  congr 1
  funext x y
  exact (kerP_add_kerQ x y).symm

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.listKer_cons_cons
statement:
lemma listKer_cons_cons (b c : Bool) (l : List Bool) :
    listKer V μ (b :: c :: l) = comp μ (letterKer V μ b) (listKer V μ (c :: l))
proof: := rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.compPow_eq_sum_listKer
statement:
theorem compPow_eq_sum_listKer (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : ∀ n : ℕ,
    compPow μ V n = fun x y => ∑ w ∈ allWords (n + 1), listKer V μ w x y
proof:
| 0 => by
      funext x y
      rw [sum_allWords_succ]
      simp only [allWords, listsOf, Finset.sum_singleton]
      exact (kerP_add_kerQ x y).symm
  | n + 1 => by
      have hGV := goodK_of_isGraphon hV
      have hmem : ∀ w ∈ allWords (n + 1), GoodK (listKer V μ w) :=
        fun w _ => goodK_listKer hV w
      show comp μ V (compPow μ V n) = _
      rw [compPow_eq_sum_listKer hV n, comp_finset_sum_right _ hGV hmem]
      funext x y
      rw [sum_allWords_succ (n + 1)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w hw => ?_
      obtain ⟨c, l, rfl⟩ : ∃ c l, w = c :: l := by
        have := (mem_allWords.mp hw)
        cases w with
        | nil => simp at this
        | cons c l => exact ⟨c, l, rfl⟩
      rw [listKer_cons_cons, listKer_cons_cons, comp_eq_kerP_add_kerQ hV (goodK_listKer hV _)]
      rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.cycleDensity_eq_sum_words
statement:
theorem cycleDensity_eq_sum_words (hV : IsGraphon V μ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ V m = ∑ w ∈ allWords m, trace μ (listKer V μ w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n, m = n + 1 := ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩
  rw [cycleDensity, Nat.add_sub_cancel, compPow_eq_sum_listKer hV n,
    trace_finset_sum _ fun w _ => goodK_listKer hV w]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.wordKer_append_single
statement:
lemma wordKer_append_single (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (b : Bool) :
    ∀ (c : Bool) (l : List Bool),
      wordKer V μ c (l ++ [b]) = comp μ (wordKer V μ c l) (letterKer V μ b)
proof:
| c, [] => rfl
  | c, d :: l => by
      show comp μ (letterKer V μ c) (wordKer V μ d (l ++ [b])) = _
      rw [wordKer_append_single hV b d l, ← comp_assoc (goodK_letterKer hV c)
        (goodK_wordKer hV d l) (goodK_letterKer hV b)]
      rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.trace_listKer_rotate_one
statement:
lemma trace_listKer_rotate_one (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (l : List Bool) :
    trace μ (listKer V μ (l.rotate 1)) = trace μ (listKer V μ l)
proof:
:= by
  match l with
  | [] => rfl
  | [b] => rw [List.rotate_singleton]
  | b :: c :: l =>
      rw [List.rotate_cons_succ, List.rotate_zero, List.cons_append]
      show trace μ (wordKer V μ c (l ++ [b])) = trace μ (comp μ (letterKer V μ b)
        (wordKer V μ c l))
      rw [wordKer_append_single hV b c l,
        trace_comp_comm (goodK_wordKer hV c l) (goodK_letterKer hV b)]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.ofFn_rot_one
statement:
lemma ofFn_rot_one {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) :
    List.ofFn (rot 1 v) = (List.ofFn v).rotate 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.ofFn_succ' (rot 1 v), List.ofFn_succ, List.rotate_cons_succ, List.rotate_zero,
    List.concat_eq_append]
  simp only [rot, Fin.coeSucc_eq_succ, Fin.last_add_one]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.trace_listKer_ofFn_rot
statement:
lemma trace_listKer_ofFn_rot (hV : IsGraphon V μ) {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1))
    (v : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) :
    trace μ (listKer V μ (List.ofFn (rot j v))) = trace μ (listKer V μ (List.ofFn v))
proof:
:= by
  induction j using Fin.induction with
  | zero => rw [rot_zero]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [← Fin.coeSucc_eq_succ, ← rot_rot, ofFn_rot_one, trace_listKer_rotate_one hV, ih]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.applyWord_append
statement:
lemma applyWord_append (l₁ l₂ : List Bool) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    applyWord V μ (l₁ ++ l₂) f = applyWord V μ l₁ (applyWord V μ l₂ f)
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons b l₁ ih => simp only [List.cons_append, applyWord, ih]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.good_applyWord
statement:
lemma good_applyWord (hV : IsGraphon V μ) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) :
    ∀ l : List Bool, Good (applyWord V μ l f)
proof:
| [] => hf
  | b :: l => Spectral.L2Kernel.good_kernelOp_goodK (goodK_letterKer hV b) (good_applyWord hV hf l)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.integral_comp_row'
statement:
lemma integral_comp_row' {K L : Ω → Ω → ℝ} (hK : GoodK K) (hL : GoodK L) (x : Ω) :
    ∫ y, comp μ K L x y ∂μ = kernelOp K μ (fun z => ∫ y, L z y ∂μ) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨CK, _, hCK⟩ := hK.bdd
  obtain ⟨CL, _, hCL⟩ := hL.bdd
  have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun y z => K x z * L z y) (μ.prod μ) := by
    have hm : Measurable (Function.uncurry fun y z => K x z * L z y) :=
      (hK.meas.comp (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_snd)).mul
        (hL.meas.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst))
    refine (integrable_const (CK * CL)).mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable (ae_of_all _ fun p => ?_)
    simp only [Function.uncurry, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul (hCK _ _) (hCL _ _) (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hCK x p.2))
  calc ∫ y, comp μ K L x y ∂μ = ∫ y, ∫ z, K x z * L z y ∂μ ∂μ := rfl
    _ = ∫ z, ∫ y, K x z * L z y ∂μ ∂μ := integral_integral_swap hint
    _ = ∫ z, K x z * ∫ y, L z y ∂μ ∂μ :=
        integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun z => integral_const_mul _ _)
    _ = kernelOp K μ (fun z => ∫ y, L z y ∂μ) x := rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.rowIntegral_wordKer
statement:
lemma rowIntegral_wordKer (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : ∀ (b : Bool) (l : List Bool),
    (fun x => ∫ y, wordKer V μ b l x y ∂μ) = applyWord V μ (b :: l) (fun _ => 1)
proof:
| b, [] => by
      funext x
      simp only [wordKer, applyWord, kernelOp, mul_one]
  | b, c :: l => by
      funext x
      show ∫ y, comp μ (letterKer V μ b) (wordKer V μ c l) x y ∂μ = _
      rw [integral_comp_row' (goodK_letterKer hV b) (goodK_wordKer hV c l),
        rowIntegral_wordKer hV c l]
      rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.kernelOp_kerP
statement:
lemma kernelOp_kerP (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    kernelOp (kerP V μ) μ f = fun _ => ∫ y, degree V μ y * f y ∂μ
proof: := rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.applyWord_false_cons
statement:
lemma applyWord_false_cons (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (l : List Bool) :
    applyWord V μ (false :: l) (fun _ => 1) = fun _ => trace μ (listKer V μ (false :: l))
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  cases l with
  | nil =>
      show ∫ y, degree V μ y * 1 ∂μ = ∫ x, degree V μ x ∂μ
      simp
  | cons c l =>
      have hW := goodK_wordKer hV c l
      obtain ⟨C, _, hC⟩ := hW.bdd
      obtain ⟨Cd, _, hCd⟩ := (good_degree hV).bdd
      have hint : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun x z => degree V μ z * wordKer V μ c l z x)
          (μ.prod μ) := by
        have hm : Measurable (Function.uncurry fun x z => degree V μ z * wordKer V μ c l z x) :=
          ((good_degree hV).meas.measurable.comp measurable_snd).mul
            (hW.meas.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst))
        refine (integrable_const (Cd * C)).mono' hm.aestronglyMeasurable
          (ae_of_all _ fun p => ?_)
        simp only [Function.uncurry, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (hCd _) (hC _ _) (abs_nonneg _) (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (hCd p.2))
      show kernelOp (kerP V μ) μ (applyWord V μ (c :: l) fun _ => 1) x =
        ∫ x, comp μ (kerP V μ) (wordKer V μ c l) x x ∂μ
      rw [← rowIntegral_wordKer hV c l, kernelOp_kerP]
      simp only [comp, kerP]
      rw [integral_integral_swap hint]
      exact integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun z => (integral_const_mul _ _).symm)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.kernelOp_kerQ
statement:
lemma kernelOp_kerQ (hV : IsGraphon V μ) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) :
    kernelOp (kerQ V μ) μ f = compress V μ f
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  have h1 : ∫ y, degree V μ y * f y ∂μ = mean μ (kernelOp V μ f) := by
    have hs := kernelOp_symm hV good_one hf
    rw [kernelOp_one hV] at hs
    simp only [one_mul] at hs
    rw [mean, ← hs]
  show ∫ y, (V x y - degree V μ y) * f y ∂μ = kernelOp V μ f x - mean μ (kernelOp V μ f)
  have e : (fun y => (V x y - degree V μ y) * f y) =
      fun y => V x y * f y - degree V μ y * f y := by funext y; ring
  rw [e, integral_sub (integrable_Uf hV hf x) ((good_degree hV).mul hf).integrable, h1]
  rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.kernelOp_eq_kerP_add_kerQ
statement:
lemma kernelOp_eq_kerP_add_kerQ (hV : IsGraphon V μ) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) (x : Ω) :
    kernelOp V μ f x = kernelOp (kerP V μ) μ f x + kernelOp (kerQ V μ) μ f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kernelOp]
  rw [← integral_add (Spectral.L2Kernel.integrable_Kf (goodK_kerP hV) hf x)
    (Spectral.L2Kernel.integrable_Kf (goodK_kerQ hV) hf x)]
  refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun y => ?_)
  simp only [kerP, kerQ]; ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.applyWord_replicate_false
statement:
lemma applyWord_replicate_false (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (c : ℝ) : ∀ a : ℕ,
    applyWord V μ (List.replicate a false) (fun _ => c) = fun _ => edgeDensity V μ ^ a * c
proof:
| 0 => by funext x; simp [applyWord]
  | a + 1 => by
      rw [List.replicate_succ]
      show kernelOp (kerP V μ) μ (applyWord V μ (List.replicate a false) fun _ => c) = _
      rw [applyWord_replicate_false hV c a, kernelOp_kerP]
      funext x
      rw [integral_mul_const]
      change edgeDensity V μ * (edgeDensity V μ ^ a * c) = _
      ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.compress_one
statement:
lemma compress_one (hV : IsGraphon V μ) :
    compress V μ (fun _ => 1) = compressIter V μ 0
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  show kernelOp V μ (fun _ => 1) x - mean μ (kernelOp V μ fun _ => 1) = degCentered V μ x
  rw [kernelOp_one hV]
  rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.applyWord_replicate_true
statement:
lemma applyWord_replicate_true (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (c : ℝ) : ∀ β : ℕ,
    applyWord V μ (List.replicate (β + 1) true) (fun _ => c) =
      fun x => c * compressIter V μ β x
proof:
| 0 => by
      show kernelOp (kerQ V μ) μ (fun _ => c) = _
      rw [kernelOp_kerQ hV ⟨stronglyMeasurable_const, ⟨|c|, abs_nonneg c, fun _ => le_rfl⟩⟩]
      have : (fun _ : Ω => c) = fun y => c * (fun _ : Ω => (1 : ℝ)) y := by funext; ring
      rw [this, compress_const_mul, compress_one hV]
  | β + 1 => by
      rw [List.replicate_succ]
      show kernelOp (kerQ V μ) μ (applyWord V μ (List.replicate (β + 1) true) fun _ => c) = _
      rw [applyWord_replicate_true hV c β,
        kernelOp_kerQ hV (f := fun x => c * compressIter V μ β x)
          (good_smul c (good_compressIter hV β)), compress_const_mul]
      rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.kernelOp_kerP_compressIter
statement:
lemma kernelOp_kerP_compressIter (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (c : ℝ) (β : ℕ) :
    kernelOp (kerP V μ) μ (fun x => c * compressIter V μ β x) =
      fun _ => c * specMoment V μ β
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernelOp_kerP]
  funext x
  have e : (fun y => degree V μ y * (c * compressIter V μ β y)) =
      fun y => c * (edgeDensity V μ * compressIter V μ β y) +
        c * (degCentered V μ y * compressIter V μ β y) := by
    funext y; rw [degree_eq y]; ring
  rw [e, integral_add (((good_compressIter hV β).integrable.const_mul _).const_mul _)
      (((good_degCentered hV).mul (good_compressIter hV β)).integrable.const_mul _),
    integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  have h0 : ∫ y, compressIter V μ β y ∂μ = 0 := mean_compressIter hV β
  rw [h0]
  show c * (edgeDensity V μ * 0) + c * specMoment V μ β = _
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.applyWord_blk
statement:
lemma applyWord_blk (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (p : ℕ × ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    applyWord V μ (blk p) (fun _ => c) =
      fun _ => edgeDensity V μ ^ p.1 * specMoment V μ p.2 * c
proof:
:= by
  rw [blk, applyWord_append, applyWord_replicate_true hV c p.2, List.replicate_succ',
    applyWord_append]
  show applyWord V μ (List.replicate p.1 false)
    (kernelOp (kerP V μ) μ fun x => c * compressIter V μ p.2 x) = _
  rw [kernelOp_kerP_compressIter hV, applyWord_replicate_false hV]
  funext x; ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.applyWord_blockWord
statement:
lemma applyWord_blockWord (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (a : ℕ) : ∀ t : List (ℕ × ℕ),
    applyWord V μ (blockWord t ++ List.replicate a false) (fun _ => 1) =
      fun _ => edgeDensity V μ ^ a * tupleWeight (edgeDensity V μ) (specMoment V μ) t
proof:
| [] => by
      rw [blockWord_nil, List.nil_append, applyWord_replicate_false hV]
      simp
  | p :: t => by
      rw [blockWord_cons, List.append_assoc, applyWord_append, applyWord_blockWord hV a t,
        applyWord_blk hV, tupleWeight_cons]
      funext x; ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.trace_listKer_false_cons
statement:
lemma trace_listKer_false_cons (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (l : List Bool) (x : Ω) :
    trace μ (listKer V μ (false :: l)) = applyWord V μ (false :: l) (fun _ => 1) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [applyWord_false_cons hV l]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.trace_listKer_blockWord
statement:
lemma trace_listKer_blockWord (hV : IsGraphon V μ) {t : List (ℕ × ℕ)} (ht : t ≠ []) :
    trace μ (listKer V μ (blockWord t)) =
      tupleWeight (edgeDensity V μ) (specMoment V μ) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ
  obtain ⟨p, t', rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil ht
  set l := List.replicate p.1 false ++ List.replicate (p.2 + 1) true ++ blockWord t' with hldef
  have hl : blockWord (p :: t') = false :: l := by
    rw [blockWord_cons, blk, List.replicate_succ, hldef]
    simp
  rw [hl, trace_listKer_false_cons hV l x, ← hl]
  have h2 := congrFun (applyWord_blockWord hV 0 (p :: t')) x
  rw [List.replicate_zero, List.append_nil] at h2
  rw [h2, pow_zero, one_mul]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.trace_listKer_replicate_false
statement:
lemma trace_listKer_replicate_false (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (n : ℕ) :
    trace μ (listKer V μ (List.replicate (n + 1) false)) = edgeDensity V μ ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ
  rw [List.replicate_succ, trace_listKer_false_cons hV _ x, ← List.replicate_succ,
    applyWord_replicate_false hV, mul_one]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.filter_numMarks_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert,
    Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · exact eq_const_of_numMarks_eq_zero
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;>
    · rw [numMarks, Finset.card_eq_zero, marks, Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff]
      intro j _ hj
      simp [IsMark] at hj

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.sum_pq_marks
statement:
lemma sum_pq_marks (hV : IsGraphon V μ) {n r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun v : Fin (n + 1) → Bool => IsMark v 0 ∧ numMarks v = r),
        trace μ (listKer V μ (List.ofFn v)) =
      if 2 * r ≤ n + 1 then tupleSum (edgeDensity V μ) (specMoment V μ) r (n + 1 - 2 * r)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hbridge : ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ.filter
      (fun v : Fin (n + 1) → Bool => IsMark v 0 ∧ numMarks v = r),
        trace μ (listKer V μ (List.ofFn v)) =
      ∑ l ∈ (allWords (n + 1)).filter (fun l => IsPQ l ∧ qpCount l + 1 = r),
        trace μ (listKer V μ l) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_filter, Finset.sum_filter, ← sum_fin_eq_sum_allWords]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v _ => ?_
    have hiff : (IsMark v 0 ∧ numMarks v = r) ↔
        (IsPQ (List.ofFn v) ∧ qpCount (List.ofFn v) + 1 = r) := by
      rw [numMarks_eq]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        rw [if_pos h1] at h2
        exact ⟨(isMark_zero_iff v).mp h1, by omega⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        have h1' := (isMark_zero_iff v).mpr h1
        rw [if_pos h1']
        exact ⟨h1', by omega⟩
    simp only [hiff]
  rw [hbridge]
  split_ifs with h2r
  · rw [sum_pq_eq_sum_tuples hr h2r, tupleSum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht => ?_
    have hne : t ≠ [] := by
      rintro rfl; rw [mem_tuples] at ht; simp at ht; omega
    exact trace_listKer_blockWord hV hne
  · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun l hl => ?_
    exfalso
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, mem_allWords] at hl
    obtain ⟨hlen, hpq, hqp⟩ := hl
    obtain ⟨t, hne, rfl⟩ := blockWord_of_pq hpq.1 hpq.2
    rw [qpCount_blockWord hne] at hqp
    rw [length_blockWord] at hlen
    omega

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.cycleDensity_excursions
statement:
theorem cycleDensity_excursions (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (n : ℕ) :
    cycleDensity μ V (n + 1) =
      edgeDensity V μ ^ (n + 1) + trace μ (listKer V μ (List.replicate (n + 1) true)) +
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          if 2 * (k + 1) ≤ n + 1 then
            ((n + 1 : ℝ) / (k + 1 : ℕ)) *
              tupleSum (edgeDensity V μ) (specMoment V μ) (k + 1) (n + 1 - 2 * (k + 1))
          else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set F : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → ℝ := fun v => trace μ (listKer V μ (List.ofFn v)) with hF
  have hrot : ∀ j v, F (rot j v) = F v := fun j v => trace_listKer_ofFn_rot hV j v
  rw [cycleDensity_eq_sum_words hV (by omega), ← sum_fin_eq_sum_allWords]
  change ∑ v, F v = _
  rw [← Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to (g := numMarks) (t := Finset.range (n + 2))
    (fun v _ => by
      rw [Finset.mem_range, numMarks]
      have := Finset.card_le_univ (marks v)
      rw [Fintype.card_fin] at this
      omega)]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', filter_numMarks_eq_zero,
    Finset.sum_pair (by
      intro h
      have := congrFun h 0
      simp at this)]
  have hP : F (fun _ => false) = edgeDensity V μ ^ (n + 1) := by
    simp only [hF, List.ofFn_const]
    exact trace_listKer_replicate_false hV n
  have hQ : F (fun _ => true) = trace μ (listKer V μ (List.replicate (n + 1) true)) := by
    simp only [hF, List.ofFn_const]
  rw [hP, hQ, add_comm]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  have hcount := sum_numMarks_eq (k + 1) F hrot
  rw [sum_pq_marks hV (by omega)] at hcount
  have hk : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  split_ifs at hcount ⊢ with h2r
  · rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, eq_div_iff hk]
    linarith
  · rw [mul_zero] at hcount
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hcount).resolve_left hk

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.kernelOp_finset_sum
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kernelOp, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact integral_finsetSum s fun i hi => integrable_Uf hV (hf i hi) x

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.pathIter_eq_sum_words
statement:
lemma pathIter_eq_sum_words (hV : IsGraphon V μ) : ∀ k : ℕ,
    pathIter V μ k = fun x => ∑ w ∈ allWords k, applyWord V μ w (fun _ => 1) x
proof:
| 0 => by
      funext x
      simp [allWords, listsOf, applyWord, pathIter]
  | k + 1 => by
      funext x
      show kernelOp V μ (pathIter V μ k) x = _
      rw [pathIter_eq_sum_words hV k,
        kernelOp_finset_sum hV _ fun w _ => good_applyWord hV good_one w, sum_allWords_succ]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun w _ => ?_
      rw [kernelOp_eq_kerP_add_kerQ hV (good_applyWord hV good_one w)]
      rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.mean_compress
statement:
lemma mean_compress (hV : IsGraphon V μ) {f : Ω → ℝ} (hf : Good f) :
    mean μ (compress V μ f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold mean compress
  rw [integral_sub (good_kernelOp hV hf).integrable (integrable_const _)]
  simp [mean]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.mean_applyWord_true_cons
statement:
lemma mean_applyWord_true_cons (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (l : List Bool) :
    mean μ (applyWord V μ (true :: l) (fun _ => 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show mean μ (kernelOp (kerQ V μ) μ (applyWord V μ l fun _ => 1)) = 0
  rw [kernelOp_kerQ hV (good_applyWord hV good_one l)]
  exact mean_compress hV (good_applyWord hV good_one l)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.sum_range_ite_le
statement:
lemma sum_range_ite_le (K c : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ N ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), (if c + N ≤ K then f N else 0) =
      if c ≤ K then ∑ N ∈ Finset.range (K - c + 1), f N else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  split_ifs with hc
  · refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
    ext N; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]; omega
  · refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun N hN => ?_
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hN; omega

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.pathDensity_excursions
statement:
theorem pathDensity_excursions (hV : IsGraphon V μ) (k : ℕ) :
    pathDensity V μ k = ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      if 2 * r ≤ k then
        conv (fun d => hsym (List.replicate (r + 1) (edgeDensity V μ)) d)
          (momentConv (specMoment V μ) r) (k - 2 * r)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum : pathDensity V μ k =
      ∑ w ∈ allWords k, mean μ (applyWord V μ w (fun _ => 1)) := by
    rw [pathDensity, pathIter_eq_sum_words hV k, mean]
    exact integral_finsetSum _ fun w _ => (good_applyWord hV good_one w).integrable
  rw [hsum, ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (allWords k) (fun l => l.head? ≠ some true)]
  have hzero : ∑ w ∈ (allWords k).filter (fun l => ¬ l.head? ≠ some true),
      mean μ (applyWord V μ w (fun _ => 1)) = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun w hw => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, not_not] at hw
    obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ : ∃ l, w = true :: l := by
      cases w with
      | nil => simp at hw
      | cons b l => simp at hw; exact ⟨l, by rw [hw.2]⟩
    exact mean_applyWord_true_cons hV l
  rw [hzero, add_zero, sum_head_ne_true_eq]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
  have hinner : ∀ N, (∑ t ∈ tuples r N, mean μ (applyWord V μ
      (blockWord t ++ List.replicate (k - 2 * r - N) false) fun _ => 1)) =
      edgeDensity V μ ^ (k - 2 * r - N) * tupleSum (edgeDensity V μ) (specMoment V μ) r N := by
    intro N
    rw [tupleSum, Finset.mul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
    rw [applyWord_blockWord hV, mean_const]
  simp only [hinner]
  rw [show (fun N => if 2 * r + N ≤ k then edgeDensity V μ ^ (k - 2 * r - N) *
      tupleSum (edgeDensity V μ) (specMoment V μ) r N else 0) =
      fun N => if 2 * r + N ≤ k then edgeDensity V μ ^ (k - 2 * r - N) *
      tupleSum (edgeDensity V μ) (specMoment V μ) r N else 0 from rfl, sum_range_ite_le]
  split_ifs with h2r
  · rw [List.replicate_succ, hsym_cons_eq_conv, conv_assoc, ← tupleSum_eq, conv_comm]
    unfold conv
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun N hN => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hN
    rw [show k - 2 * r - N = k - 2 * r - N from rfl]
    ring
  · rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentConv_neg_pow
statement:
lemma momentConv_neg_pow (s : ℕ → ℝ) : ∀ r j : ℕ,
    momentConv (fun i => (-1 : ℝ) ^ i * s i) r j = (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * momentConv s r j
proof:
| 0, j => by cases j <;> simp [momentConv]
  | r + 1, j => by
      rw [momentConv_succ, momentConv_succ, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
      rw [momentConv_neg_pow s r (j - i),
        show (-1 : ℝ) ^ j = (-1) ^ i * (-1) ^ (j - i) by rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; omega]
      ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.tupleSum_eq_choose
statement:
lemma tupleSum_eq_choose (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) :
    tupleSum q s r n = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      (Nat.choose (n - j + (r - 1)) (r - 1) : ℝ) * q ^ (n - j) * momentConv s r j
proof:
:= by
  rw [tupleSum_eq, conv_comm]
  unfold conv
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  dsimp only
  rw [hsym_replicate' q hr]
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.conv_hsym_succ_eq
statement:
lemma conv_hsym_succ_eq (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) (r n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    conv (fun d => hsym (List.replicate (r + 1) q) d) (momentConv s r) (n - 1) =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (if j < n then (Nat.choose (n - 1 - j + r) r : ℝ) * q ^ (n - 1 - j) else 0) *
          momentConv s r j
proof:
:= by
  rw [conv_comm]
  unfold conv
  rw [show n - 1 + 1 = n by omega, Finset.sum_range_succ, if_neg (lt_irrefl n), zero_mul,
    add_zero]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
  dsimp only
  rw [if_pos hj, hsym_replicate' q (Nat.succ_ne_zero r), Nat.succ_sub_one]
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.listKer_compl_replicate_true
statement:
lemma listKer_compl_replicate_true (hW : IsGraphon W μ) : ∀ k : ℕ,
    listKer W μ (List.replicate (k + 1) true) =
      fun x y => (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * listKer (compl W) μ (List.replicate (k + 1) true) x y
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : kerQ W μ = fun x y => -kerQ (compl W) μ x y := by
    funext x y
    simp only [kerQ, DenseRegion.degree_compl hW, compl]
    ring
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      funext x y
      show kerQ W μ x y = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (0 + 1) * kerQ (compl W) μ x y
      rw [hQ]; ring
  | succ k ih =>
      show comp μ (letterKer W μ true) (listKer W μ (List.replicate (k + 1) true)) =
        fun x y => (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) * comp μ (letterKer (compl W) μ true)
          (listKer (compl W) μ (List.replicate (k + 1) true)) x y
      rw [ih]
      show comp μ (kerQ W μ) _ = _
      rw [hQ, comp_neg_left, comp_smul_right]
      funext x y
      show -((-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1) * comp μ (kerQ (compl W) μ)
          (listKer (compl W) μ (List.replicate (k + 1) true)) x y) =
        (-1 : ℝ) ^ (k + 2) * comp μ (kerQ (compl W) μ)
          (listKer (compl W) μ (List.replicate (k + 1) true)) x y
      ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.sum_range_ite_two_mul_le
statement:
lemma sum_range_ite_two_mul_le (R : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * R + 1), (if 2 * (k + 1) ≤ 2 * R + 1 then f k else 0) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range R, f k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
  ext k
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
  omega

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.sum_range_ite_two_mul_le'
statement:
lemma sum_range_ite_two_mul_le' (R : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (2 * R + 1), (if 2 * r ≤ 2 * R then f r else 0) =
      f 0 + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range R, f (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  rw [show (Finset.range (2 * R + 1)).filter (fun r => 2 * r ≤ 2 * R) = Finset.range (R + 1) by
    ext r; simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]; omega]
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ', add_comm]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.conv_hsym_one_momentConv_zero
statement:
lemma conv_hsym_one_momentConv_zero (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    conv (fun d => hsym (List.replicate (0 + 1) q) d) (momentConv s 0) n = q ^ n
proof:
:= by
  unfold conv
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single n]
  · simp
  · intro i hi hin
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, n - i = j + 1 := ⟨n - i - 1, by omega⟩
    rw [hj, momentConv_zero_succ, mul_zero]
  · intro h; simp at h

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.neckSum_eq_baseline_add_momentPhi
statement:
theorem neckSum_eq_baseline_add_momentPhi (hW : IsGraphon W μ) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    neckSum W μ m =
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1) +
      momentPhi m (1 - edgeDensity W μ) (specMoment (compl W) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hU := isGraphon_compl hW
  set p := edgeDensity W μ with hp
  set q := 1 - p with hq
  set s := specMoment (compl W) μ with hs
  have hqU : edgeDensity (compl W) μ = q := edgeDensity_compl hW
  have hsW : specMoment W μ = fun j => (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * s j := by
    funext j
    rw [hs, specMoment_compl hW j, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  have hid := cycleDensity_eq_neckSum_add hW hm hm3
  obtain ⟨R, rfl⟩ := hm
  have hR : 1 ≤ R := by omega
  have hCU := cycleDensity_excursions hU (2 * R)
  have hCW := cycleDensity_excursions hW (2 * R)
  have hPU := pathDensity_excursions hU (2 * R)
  have hτ : trace μ (listKer W μ (List.replicate (2 * R + 1) true)) =
      -trace μ (listKer (compl W) μ (List.replicate (2 * R + 1) true)) := by
    rw [listKer_compl_replicate_true hW (2 * R)]
    simp only [trace]
    rw [integral_const_mul, Odd.neg_one_pow ⟨R, rfl⟩]
    ring
  rw [hqU, sum_range_ite_two_mul_le, ← hs] at hCU
  rw [hsW, sum_range_ite_two_mul_le, ← hp] at hCW
  rw [hqU, sum_range_ite_two_mul_le', conv_hsym_one_momentConv_zero, ← hs, Nat.mul_zero,
    Nat.sub_zero] at hPU
  rw [show 2 * R + 1 - 1 = 2 * R by omega] at hid ⊢
  have hphi : momentPhi (2 * R + 1) q s = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range R,
      momentPhiTerm (2 * R + 1) (k + 1) q s := by
    unfold momentPhi
    rw [show (2 * R + 1 - 1) / 2 = R by omega]
  rw [hphi]
  have hterm : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range R,
      (((2 * R : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          tupleSum p (fun j => (-1 : ℝ) ^ j * s j) (k + 1) (2 * R + 1 - 2 * (k + 1)) +
        (((2 * R : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          tupleSum q s (k + 1) (2 * R + 1 - 2 * (k + 1)) -
        conv (fun d => hsym (List.replicate (k + 1 + 1) q) d) (momentConv s (k + 1))
          (2 * R - 2 * (k + 1)) =
      momentPhiTerm (2 * R + 1) (k + 1) q s := by
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_range] at hk
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ 2 * R + 1 - 2 * (k + 1) := by omega
    rw [show 2 * R - 2 * (k + 1) = 2 * R + 1 - 2 * (k + 1) - 1 by omega,
      conv_hsym_succ_eq q s (k + 1) _ hn1,
      tupleSum_eq_choose p _ (Nat.succ_ne_zero k), tupleSum_eq_choose q s (Nat.succ_ne_zero k)]
    unfold momentPhiTerm momentShiftTerm momentPathTerm
    simp only [momentConv_neg_pow, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    have hp' : p = 1 - q := by rw [hq]; ring
    rw [hp']
    push_cast
    ring
  have hsum := Finset.sum_congr (s₁ := Finset.range R) rfl hterm
  rw [← hsum, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have hsplit : q ^ (2 * R + 1) = q * q ^ (2 * R) := by ring
  linarith [hid, hCU, hCW, hPU, hτ, hsplit]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.pow_exp_pow_int_b
statement:
private lemma pow_exp_pow_int_b (r a d : ℕ) (_ha : r - 1 ≤ a) (b : ℝ) :
    IntegrableOn (fun y => y ^ a * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ d) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine IntegrableOn.congr_fun (gExp_affinePow_integrableOn (a + 1) d 1 (-b))
    (fun y _ => ?_) measurableSet_Ioi
  rw [show a + 1 - 1 = a from by omega, show (1 : ℝ) * y + -b = y - b from by ring]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.Mb_explicit
statement:
lemma Mb_explicit (r : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    Mb r b k = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      (Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i) * (Nat.factorial (r - 1 + i) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold Mb
  have hrw : (fun y : ℝ => (y - b) ^ k)
      = fun y => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ((Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i)) * y ^ i := by
    funext y
    rw [show y - b = y + -b from by ring, add_pow]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_); ring
  rw [hrw, gExp_finset_sum r _ _ (fun i _ =>
    IntegrableOn.congr_fun ((gExp_integrableOn r i).const_mul ((Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i)))
      (fun y _ => by ring) measurableSet_Ioi)]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
  rw [gExp_const_mul r _ (fun y => y ^ i), gExp_monomial r i]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.gExp_y_mul_b
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : (fun y : ℝ => y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k)
      = fun y => y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * ((y - b) ^ (k + 1) + b * (y - b) ^ k) := by
    funext y
    have h1 : y ^ r = y ^ (r - 1) * y := by rw [← pow_succ]; congr 1; omega
    have h2 : (y - b) ^ (k + 1) + b * (y - b) ^ k = y * (y - b) ^ k := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
    rw [h1, h2]; ring
  rw [hrw]
  show gExp r (fun y => (y - b) ^ (k + 1) + b * (y - b) ^ k) = _
  rw [gExp_add r (fun y => (y - b) ^ (k + 1)) (fun y => b * (y - b) ^ k)
      (pow_exp_pow_int_b r (r - 1) (k + 1) (le_refl _) b)
      (IntegrableOn.congr_fun ((pow_exp_pow_int_b r (r - 1) k (le_refl _) b).const_mul b)
        (fun y _ => by ring) measurableSet_Ioi),
    gExp_const_mul r b (fun y => (y - b) ^ k)]
  rfl

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.Mb_recurrence
statement:
lemma Mb_recurrence (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (b : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    Mb r b (k + 1) = ((r : ℝ) + k - b) * Mb r b k + (k : ℝ) * b * Mb r b (k - 1)
proof:
:= by
  set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k with hg
  set g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
      (r : ℝ) * (y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k)
      - y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k
      + (k : ℝ) * (y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ (k - 1)) with hg'
  have hderiv : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (g' y) y := by
    intro y
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y ^ r) ((r : ℝ) * y ^ (r - 1)) y := hasDerivAt_pow r y
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-y)) (-Real.exp (-y)) y := by
      simpa using (((hasDerivAt_id y).neg).exp)
    have hbd : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => y - b) 1 y := by simpa using (hasDerivAt_id y).sub_const b
    have hp := (h1.mul h2).mul (hbd.pow k)
    have heq : g' y = ((r : ℝ) * y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) + y ^ r * -Real.exp (-y))
        * (y - b) ^ k
        + y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * ((k : ℝ) * (y - b) ^ (k - 1) * 1) := by
      simp only [hg']; ring
    rw [heq]; exact hp
  have hg0 : g 0 = 0 := by simp only [hg]; rw [zero_pow (show r ≠ 0 by omega)]; ring
  have htend : Tendsto g atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hsum : g = fun y => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
        (Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i) * (y ^ (r + i) * Real.exp (-y)) := by
      funext y; simp only [hg]
      rw [show y - b = y + -b from by ring, add_pow, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
      rw [pow_add]; ring
    rw [hsum, show (0 : ℝ) = ∑ _i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (0 : ℝ) from by simp]
    refine tendsto_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => ?_)
    simpa using (Real.tendsto_pow_mul_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero (r + i)).const_mul
      ((Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i))
  have hg'int : IntegrableOn g' (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [hg']
    exact (((pow_exp_pow_int_b r (r - 1) k (le_refl _) b).const_mul (r : ℝ)).sub
      (pow_exp_pow_int_b r r k (by omega) b)).add
      ((pow_exp_pow_int_b r r (k - 1) (by omega) b).const_mul (k : ℝ))
  have hFTC : (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), g' y) = 0 := by
    rw [integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto' (fun x _ => hderiv x) hg'int htend, hg0, sub_zero]
  have hsplit : (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), g' y)
      = (r : ℝ) * (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k)
        - (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k)
        + (k : ℝ) * (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ (k - 1)) := by
    simp only [hg']
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_add
          (f := fun y => (r : ℝ) * (y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k)
            - y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k)
          (g := fun y => (k : ℝ) * (y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ (k - 1)))
          (((pow_exp_pow_int_b r (r - 1) k (le_refl _) b).const_mul (r : ℝ)).sub
            (pow_exp_pow_int_b r r k (by omega) b))
          ((pow_exp_pow_int_b r r (k - 1) (by omega) b).const_mul (k : ℝ)),
        MeasureTheory.integral_sub
          (f := fun y => (r : ℝ) * (y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k))
          (g := fun y => y ^ r * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k)
          ((pow_exp_pow_int_b r (r - 1) k (le_refl _) b).const_mul (r : ℝ))
          (pow_exp_pow_int_b r r k (by omega) b),
        MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  rw [hFTC,
    show (∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ k) = Mb r b k from rfl,
    gExp_y_mul_b r hr b k, gExp_y_mul_b r hr b (k - 1)] at hsplit
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk1
  · subst hk0; simp only [Mb, Nat.zero_sub, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] at hsplit ⊢
    linear_combination hsplit
  · rw [show k - 1 + 1 = k from by omega] at hsplit
    linear_combination hsplit

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.Mb_hasDeriv
statement:
lemma Mb_hasDeriv (r : ℕ) (b : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => Mb r b k) (-(k : ℝ) * Mb r b (k - 1)) b
proof:
:= by

  have hpoly : (fun b : ℝ => Mb r b k)
      = fun b => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          (Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i) * (Nat.factorial (r - 1 + i) : ℝ) :=
    funext (fun b => Mb_explicit r b k)

  have hterm : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
      HasDerivAt (fun b : ℝ =>
          (Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i) * (Nat.factorial (r - 1 + i) : ℝ))
        ((Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * (((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i - 1) * (-1))
          * (Nat.factorial (r - 1 + i) : ℝ)) b := by
    intro i _
    have hb : HasDerivAt (fun b : ℝ => -b) (-1 : ℝ) b := hasDerivAt_neg' b
    have hp : HasDerivAt (fun b : ℝ => (-b) ^ (k - i))
        (((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i - 1) * (-1)) b := hb.pow (k - i)
    exact (hp.const_mul (Nat.choose k i : ℝ)).mul_const (Nat.factorial (r - 1 + i) : ℝ)

  have hval : -(k : ℝ) * Mb r b (k - 1)
      = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k + 1),
          (Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * (((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ) * (-b) ^ (k - i - 1) * (-1))
            * (Nat.factorial (r - 1 + i) : ℝ) := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk0 | hk1
    · subst hk0; simp
    · rw [Mb_explicit r b (k - 1), Finset.mul_sum, show k - 1 + 1 = k from by omega,
        Finset.sum_range_succ, show k - k = 0 from by omega]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => ?_)
      rw [Finset.mem_range] at hi
      have hidx : k - i - 1 = k - 1 - i := by omega
      have hchoose : (Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ)
          = (k : ℝ) * (Nat.choose (k - 1) i : ℝ) := by
        have h0 := Nat.choose_mul_succ_eq (k - 1) i
        rw [show (k - 1) + 1 = k from by omega] at h0
        calc (Nat.choose k i : ℝ) * ((k - i : ℕ) : ℝ)
            = ((Nat.choose k i * (k - i) : ℕ) : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
          _ = ((Nat.choose (k - 1) i * k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by rw [h0.symm]
          _ = (k : ℝ) * (Nat.choose (k - 1) i : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [hidx]
      linear_combination ((-b) ^ (k - 1 - i) * (Nat.factorial (r - 1 + i) : ℝ)) * hchoose
  rw [hpoly, hval]
  exact HasDerivAt.fun_sum hterm

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.Hb_hasDeriv
statement:
lemma Hb_hasDeriv (r j : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (b : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun b => Hb r j b) (Hb' r j b) b
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun b => Hb r j b)
      = fun b => ((r : ℝ) + j) * Mb r b (2 * j) - 3 * (j : ℝ) * (b * Mb r b (2 * j - 1)) := by
    funext b; unfold Hb; ring
  rw [hfun]
  have hM1 := Mb_hasDeriv r b (2 * j - 1)
  have hraw := ((Mb_hasDeriv r b (2 * j)).const_mul ((r : ℝ) + j)).sub
    (((hasDerivAt_id b).mul hM1).const_mul (3 * (j : ℝ)))
  have hrec := Mb_recurrence r hr b (2 * j - 1)
  rw [show 2 * j - 1 + 1 = 2 * j from by omega] at hrec
  have e2j1 : ((2 * j - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * (j : ℝ) - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega : 1 ≤ 2 * j)]; push_cast; ring
  rw [e2j1] at hrec
  have hdeq : Hb' r j b
      = ((r : ℝ) + j) * (-(((2 * j : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Mb r b (2 * j - 1))
        - 3 * (j : ℝ) * (1 * Mb r b (2 * j - 1)
            + b * (-(((2 * j - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) * Mb r b (2 * j - 1 - 1))) := by
    unfold Hb'
    rw [show ((2 * j : ℕ) : ℝ) = 2 * (j : ℝ) from by push_cast; ring, e2j1]
    linear_combination (3 * (j : ℝ)) * hrec
  rw [hdeq]
  exact hraw

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.Hb_cross
statement:
lemma Hb_cross (r j : ℕ) (β : ℝ) (hz : Hb r j β = 0) :
    3 * β * Hb' r j β
      = Mb r β (2 * j)
        * (3 * ((r : ℝ) + 4 * (j : ℝ)) * β - ((r : ℝ) + (j : ℝ)) * (5 * (r : ℝ) + 8 * (j : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold Hb at hz
  unfold Hb'
  linear_combination (5 * (r : ℝ) + 8 * (j : ℝ) - 3 * β) * hz

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.Mb_pos_even
statement: lemma Mb_pos_even (r j : ℕ) (_hr : 1 ≤ r) (b : ℝ) : 0 < Mb r b (2 * j)
proof:
:= by
  have hMb : Mb r b (2 * j)
      = ∫ y in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ (2 * j) := rfl
  have hnn : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ (2 * j) := by
    intro y hy; rw [Set.mem_Ioi] at hy
    have : (y - b) ^ (2 * j) = ((y - b) ^ 2) ^ j := by rw [← pow_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
    rw [this]; positivity
  have haenn : 0 ≤ᵐ[MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))]
      fun y => y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ (2 * j) :=
    (MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).mpr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hnn)
  have hint : MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
      (fun y => y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ (2 * j)) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
    pow_exp_pow_int_b r (r - 1) (2 * j) (le_refl _) b
  rw [hMb, MeasureTheory.setIntegral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg_ae haenn hint]

  have hsub : Set.Ioo (|b| + 1) (|b| + 2)
      ⊆ Function.support (fun y => y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (y - b) ^ (2 * j))
        ∩ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) := by
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_Ioo] at hy
    have hy0 : 0 < y := by have := abs_nonneg b; linarith [hy.1]
    have hyb : y - b ≠ 0 := by
      have hbb : b ≤ |b| := le_abs_self b
      have : 0 < y - b := by linarith [hy.1]
      exact ne_of_gt this
    refine ⟨?_, Set.mem_Ioi.mpr hy0⟩
    rw [Function.mem_support]
    exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero _ (ne_of_gt hy0)) (Real.exp_ne_zero _))
      (pow_ne_zero _ hyb)
  have hpos : (0 : ENNReal) < MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Ioo (|b| + 1) (|b| + 2)) := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo]; simp
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hpos (MeasureTheory.measure_mono hsub)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.bstar_pos
statement: lemma bstar_pos (r j : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) : 0 < bstar r j
proof:
:= by
  have hr1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hjnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j := Nat.cast_nonneg j
  unfold bstar; positivity

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.cross_bracket
statement:
lemma cross_bracket (r j : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (β : ℝ) :
    3 * ((r : ℝ) + 4 * (j : ℝ)) * β - ((r : ℝ) + (j : ℝ)) * (5 * (r : ℝ) + 8 * (j : ℝ))
      = 3 * ((r : ℝ) + 4 * (j : ℝ)) * (β - bstar r j)
proof:
:= by
  have hr1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hjnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ j := Nat.cast_nonneg j
  have hden : (3 : ℝ) * ((r : ℝ) + 4 * (j : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  unfold bstar; field_simp

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.slope_neg_right
statement:
private lemma slope_neg_right {f : ℝ → ℝ} {f' x : ℝ} (hf : HasDerivAt f f' x) (hf' : f' < 0) :
    ∀ᶠ y in nhdsWithin x (Set.Ioi x), f y < f x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hf
  have hs : Filter.Tendsto (slope f x) (nhdsWithin x (Set.Ioi x)) (nhds f') :=
    h0.mono_left (nhdsWithin_mono x (fun y hy => hy.ne'))
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in nhdsWithin x (Set.Ioi x), slope f x y < 0 :=
