name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.neckSum_ge_baseline_unconditional
statement:
theorem neckSum_ge_baseline_unconditional {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ)
    (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    edgeDensity W μ ^ m - edgeDensity W μ * (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1) ≤
      neckSum W μ m
proof:
:=
  neckSum_ge_baseline_of_diagKernel_nonneg hW hm hm3 fun _ hr _ hell =>
    diagKernel_nonneg_uniform diagKernelPosEll_unconditional hm hr.1 hr.2
      (by linarith [edgeDensity_le_one hW]) (by linarith) hell

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.dense_region_commonality_bound
statement:
theorem dense_region_commonality_bound {m : ℕ} (hW : IsGraphon W μ)
    (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    cycleDensity μ W m + cycleDensity μ (compl W) m ≥
      edgeDensity W μ ^ m + (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ m +
        (pathDensity (compl W) μ (m - 1) - (1 - edgeDensity W μ) ^ (m - 1))
proof:
:=
  commonality_of_neckSum_ge hW hm hm3 (neckSum_ge_baseline_unconditional hW hp hm hm3)

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.shifted_gamma_positive_of_moment_bound
statement:
theorem shifted_gamma_positive_of_moment_bound (t r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hmoment : ∀ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j → ∀ z : ℝ, 0 ≤ z →
      3 * (j : ℝ) * gExp r (fun y => (z * y - 1) ^ (2 * j - 1))
        ≤ ((r : ℝ) + j) * gExp r (fun y => (z * y - 1) ^ (2 * j)))
    (q x : ℝ) (_hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq : q ≤ 1 / 3) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    0 ≤ gExp r (fun y => rho (2 * t + 1) (2 * t + 1 + 2 * r) (q + x * y))
proof:
:= by
  set δ : ℝ := 1 / 2 - q with hδdef
  have hδ16 : 1 / 6 ≤ δ := by rw [hδdef]; linarith
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by linarith
  set z : ℝ := x / δ with hzdef
  have hz : 0 ≤ z := by rw [hzdef]; positivity
  have hδz : δ * z = x := by rw [hzdef]; field_simp

  have hpt : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), (x * y - δ) ^ k = δ ^ k * (z * y - 1) ^ k := by
    intro k y
    rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, hδz]
  have hscale : ∀ k : ℕ, gExp r (fun y => (x * y - δ) ^ k)
      = δ ^ k * gExp r (fun y => (z * y - 1) ^ k) := fun k => by
    rw [show (fun y => (x * y - δ) ^ k) = (fun y => δ ^ k * (z * y - 1) ^ k) from
        funext (fun y => hpt k y), gExp_const_mul]

  have hint : ∀ k : ℕ,
      IntegrableOn (fun y => y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (x * y - δ) ^ k) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
    fun k => (gExp_affinePow_integrableOn r k x (-δ)).congr_fun
      (fun y _ => by rw [sub_eq_add_neg]) measurableSet_Ioi
  have hintc : ∀ (c : ℝ) (k : ℕ),
      IntegrableOn (fun y => y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (c * (x * y - δ) ^ k)) (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :=
    fun c k => IntegrableOn.congr_fun ((hint k).const_mul c)
      (fun y _ => by ring) measurableSet_Ioi

  have hG2j : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ gExp r (fun y => (z * y - 1) ^ (2 * j)) :=
    fun j => gExp_nonneg r _ (fun y _ => by rw [pow_mul]; positivity)

  have hFval : ∀ j : ℕ,
      gExp r (fun y => aCoef t j * (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j)
          - (j : ℝ) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j - 1)))
        = aCoef t j * (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * gExp r (fun y => (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j))
            - (j : ℝ) * gExp r (fun y => (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j - 1))) := by
    intro j
    rw [gExp_const_mul r (aCoef t j),
        gExp_sub r _ _ (hintc (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j)) (2 * j)) (hintc (j : ℝ) (2 * j - 1)),
        gExp_const_mul r (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j)), gExp_const_mul r (j : ℝ)]

  have hblock : ∀ j : ℕ,
      0 ≤ gExp r (fun y => aCoef t j * (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j)
          - (j : ℝ) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j - 1))) := by
    intro j
    rw [hFval j]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with hj0 | hj1
    · subst hj0
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, add_zero, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_zero, pow_zero]
      have h1 : gExp r (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) = (Nat.factorial (r - 1) : ℝ) := by
        simpa using gExp_monomial r 0
      have haC0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ aCoef t 0 := (aCoef_pos t 0 (Nat.zero_le t)).le
      rw [h1]; positivity
    · rw [hscale (2 * j), hscale (2 * j - 1)]
      set G2 : ℝ := gExp r (fun y => (z * y - 1) ^ (2 * j)) with hG2def
      set G1 : ℝ := gExp r (fun y => (z * y - 1) ^ (2 * j - 1)) with hG1def
      have hG2nn : 0 ≤ G2 := hG2j j
      have hmom : 3 * (j : ℝ) * G1 ≤ ((r : ℝ) + j) * G2 := hmoment j hj1 z hz
      have haC : 0 ≤ aCoef t j := by unfold aCoef; positivity
      have hpowsplit : δ ^ (2 * j) = δ ^ (2 * j - 1) * δ := by rw [← pow_succ]; congr 1; omega
      have hbracket : 0 ≤ 2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * δ * G2 - (j : ℝ) * G1 := by
        nlinarith [hmom, hG2nn,
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) + j)
            (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * δ - 1 / 3)) hG2nn]
      have hkey : 0 ≤ aCoef t j * (δ ^ (2 * j - 1) * (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * δ * G2 - (j : ℝ) * G1)) :=
        mul_nonneg haC (mul_nonneg (by positivity) hbracket)
      calc (0 : ℝ)
          ≤ aCoef t j * (δ ^ (2 * j - 1) * (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * δ * G2 - (j : ℝ) * G1)) := hkey
        _ = aCoef t j * (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * (δ ^ (2 * j) * G2)
              - (j : ℝ) * (δ ^ (2 * j - 1) * G1)) := by rw [hpowsplit]; ring

  have hpos2t1 : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (t : ℝ) + 1 := by positivity
  rw [← mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left hpos2t1,
      ← gExp_const_mul r (2 * (t : ℝ) + 1) (fun y => rho (2 * t + 1) (2 * t + 1 + 2 * r) (q + x * y))]
  have hcentered : (fun y => (2 * (t : ℝ) + 1) * rho (2 * t + 1) (2 * t + 1 + 2 * r) (q + x * y))
      = fun y => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (t + 1),
          aCoef t j * (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j)
            - (j : ℝ) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j - 1)) := by
    funext y
    rw [show q + x * y = 1 / 2 + (x * y - δ) from by rw [hδdef]; ring, rho_centered]
  rw [hcentered, gExp_finset_sum r _ _ ?_]
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => hblock j)
  · intro j _
    rw [show (fun y => y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y)
            * (aCoef t j * (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j)
                - (j : ℝ) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j - 1))))
          = fun y => aCoef t j
              * ((y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j)))
                - (y ^ (r - 1) * Real.exp (-y) * ((j : ℝ) * (x * y - δ) ^ (2 * j - 1))))
          from by funext y; ring]
    exact (((hintc (2 * ((r : ℝ) + j)) (2 * j)).sub (hintc (j : ℝ) (2 * j - 1))).const_mul (aCoef t j))

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.commonalityGap_eq_momentPhi
statement:
theorem commonalityGap_eq_momentPhi (hW : IsGraphon W μ) {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    commonalityGap W μ m = momentPhi m (1 - edgeDensity W μ) (specMoment (compl W) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := cycleDensity_eq_neckSum_add hW hm hm3
  have h2 := neckSum_eq_baseline_add_momentPhi hW hm hm3
  unfold commonalityGap
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentConv_zero_right
statement: lemma momentConv_zero_right (s : ℕ → ℝ) : ∀ r, momentConv s r 0 = s 0 ^ r
proof:
| 0 => rfl
  | r + 1 => by
      rw [momentConv_succ, Finset.sum_range_one, Nat.sub_self, momentConv_zero_right s r,
        pow_succ]
      ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentPhiTerm_top
statement:
lemma momentPhiTerm_top {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (q : ℝ) (s : ℕ → ℝ) :
    momentPhiTerm (2 * r + 1) r q s = (2 * r : ℝ) * s 0 ^ r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ : ∃ r', r = r' + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
  unfold momentPhiTerm momentShiftTerm momentPathTerm
  have h1 : 2 * (r + 1) + 1 - 2 * (r + 1) = 1 := by omega
  simp only [h1, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero, Nat.add_sub_cancel, zero_add,
    Nat.sub_zero, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, pow_one, momentConv_zero_right,
    Nat.choose_self, Nat.lt_irrefl, if_false, zero_lt_one, if_true]
  rw [show 1 + r = r + 1 by omega, Nat.choose_succ_self_right]
  push_cast
  field_simp
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentPhiTerm_congr_of_le
statement:
lemma momentPhiTerm_congr_of_le {m r : ℕ} (q : ℝ) {s t : ℕ → ℝ}
    (h : ∀ j ≤ m, s j = t j) : momentPhiTerm m r q s = momentPhiTerm m r q t
proof:
:= by
  unfold momentPhiTerm momentShiftTerm momentPathTerm
  congr 1 <;> refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  all_goals
    rw [momentConv_congr_of_le _ _ fun ell hell => h ell (by
      have hjlt : j < m - 2 * r + 1 := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
      omega)]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentPhiTerm_specMoment_nonneg
statement:
lemma momentPhiTerm_specMoment_nonneg (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ)
    {m r : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (h2r : 2 * r < m) :
    0 ≤ momentPhiTerm m r (1 - edgeDensity W μ) (specMoment (compl W) μ)
proof:
:= by
  have hU := isGraphon_compl hW
  rw [momentPhiTerm_congr_of_le (t := atomicMoment (graphonAtomWeight hU m)
      (graphonAtomEigenvalue hU m)) _ fun j hj => specMoment_eq_graphonAtomicMoment hU hj,
    momentPhiTerm_eq_momentKernelTerm]
  exact momentKernelTerm_nonneg_of_atomic (by omega) (by omega) _ _ _
    (graphonAtomWeight_nonneg hU m) (graphonAtomEigenvalue_mem_halfInterval hU m)
    fun ell hell => diagKernel_nonneg_uniform diagKernelPosEll_unconditional hm hr h2r
      (by linarith [edgeDensity_le_one hW]) (by linarith) hell

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.specMoment_compl_zero
statement:
lemma specMoment_compl_zero (hW : IsGraphon W μ) :
    specMoment (compl W) μ 0 = ∫ x, (degree W μ x - edgeDensity W μ) ^ 2 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  show ∫ x, degCentered (compl W) μ x * degCentered (compl W) μ x ∂μ = _
  rw [degCentered_compl hW]
  refine integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
  simp only [degCentered]
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentPhi_ge_top
statement:
lemma momentPhi_ge_top (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    (m - 1 : ℝ) * specMoment (compl W) μ 0 ^ ((m - 1) / 2) ≤
      momentPhi m (1 - edgeDensity W μ) (specMoment (compl W) μ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hm
  have ht : (2 * t + 1 - 1) / 2 = (t - 1) + 1 := by omega
  unfold momentPhi
  rw [ht, Finset.sum_range_succ, show t - 1 + 1 = t by omega,
    momentPhiTerm_top (by omega)]
  have hrest : 0 ≤ ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (t - 1),
      momentPhiTerm (2 * t + 1) (k + 1) (1 - edgeDensity W μ) (specMoment (compl W) μ) :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun k hk => by
      have := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
      exact momentPhiTerm_specMoment_nonneg hW hp ⟨t, rfl⟩ (by omega) (by omega)
  push_cast
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.commonality_gap_ge_degree_variance
statement:
theorem commonality_gap_ge_degree_variance (hW : IsGraphon W μ)
    (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ) {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    (m - 1 : ℝ) * (∫ x, (degree W μ x - edgeDensity W μ) ^ 2 ∂μ) ^ ((m - 1) / 2) ≤
      commonalityGap W μ m
proof:
:= by
  rw [commonalityGap_eq_momentPhi hW hm hm3, ← specMoment_compl_zero hW]
  exact momentPhi_ge_top hW hp hm hm3

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.specMoment_compl_eq_zero_of_regular
statement:
lemma specMoment_compl_eq_zero_of_regular (hW : IsGraphon W μ)
    (hreg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree W μ x = edgeDensity W μ) :
    specMoment (compl W) μ = fun _ => 0
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  show ∫ x, degCentered (compl W) μ x * compressIter (compl W) μ j x ∂μ = 0
  refine integral_eq_zero_of_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [hreg] with x hx
  rw [degCentered_compl hW]
  simp [degCentered, hx]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.momentPhi_zero_seq
statement: lemma momentPhi_zero_seq (m : ℕ) (q : ℝ) : momentPhi m q (fun _ => 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold momentPhi momentPhiTerm momentShiftTerm momentPathTerm
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k _ => ?_
  simp [momentConv_succ]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.commonalityGap_eq_zero_of_regular
statement:
theorem commonalityGap_eq_zero_of_regular (hW : IsGraphon W μ) {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m)
    (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) (hreg : ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree W μ x = edgeDensity W μ) :
    commonalityGap W μ m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [commonalityGap_eq_momentPhi hW hm hm3, specMoment_compl_eq_zero_of_regular hW hreg,
    momentPhi_zero_seq]

name: OddCycleBound.DenseRegion.commonality_eq_iff_regular
statement:
theorem commonality_eq_iff_regular (hW : IsGraphon W μ) (hp : 2 / 3 ≤ edgeDensity W μ)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : Odd m) (hm3 : 3 ≤ m) :
    commonalityGap W μ m = 0 ↔ ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, degree W μ x = edgeDensity W μ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h0 => ?_, commonalityGap_eq_zero_of_regular hW hm hm3⟩
  have hb := commonality_gap_ge_degree_variance hW hp hm hm3
  rw [h0] at hb
  set V := ∫ x, (degree W μ x - edgeDensity W μ) ^ 2 ∂μ with hVdef
  have hV0 : 0 ≤ V := integral_nonneg fun x => sq_nonneg _
  have hm1 : (0 : ℝ) < m - 1 := by
    have : (3 : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hm3
    linarith
  have hpow : V ^ ((m - 1) / 2) ≤ 0 := by
    by_contra hcon
    have := mul_pos hm1 (not_le.mp hcon)
    linarith
  have hVz : V = 0 := by
    have hpos : 0 ≤ V ^ ((m - 1) / 2) := pow_nonneg hV0 _
    exact pow_eq_zero_iff (n := (m - 1) / 2) (by omega) |>.mp (le_antisymm hpow hpos)
  have hint : Integrable (fun x => (degree W μ x - edgeDensity W μ) ^ 2) μ := by
    refine ((good_degCentered hW).mul (good_degCentered hW)).integrable.congr
      (ae_of_all _ fun x => ?_)
    simp only [degCentered]; ring
  rw [hVdef, integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun x => sq_nonneg _) hint] at hVz
  filter_upwards [hVz] with x hx
  have : (degree W μ x - edgeDensity W μ) ^ 2 = 0 := hx
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (degree W μ x - edgeDensity W μ)]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.L_lt_q
statement: theorem L_lt_q : P.L < P.q
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : P.p * P.q - P.alpha ^ 2 < P.q ^ 2 := by
    have halphaSq : P.q ^ 2 < P.alpha ^ 2 :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ P.alpha_gt_q P.q_nonneg (by norm_num)
    have hq3 : P.q < 3 * P.q ^ 2 := by
      have hthree : 0 < 3 * P.q - 1 := by linarith [P.q_gt_third]
      nlinarith [mul_pos P.q_pos hthree]
    dsimp [p]
    nlinarith
  have hsq : P.L ^ 2 < P.q ^ 2 := by
    rw [P.L_sq]
    exact hpq
  by_contra hnot
  have hqle : P.q <= P.L := le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hsquareLe : P.q ^ 2 <= P.L ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ P.q_nonneg hqle 2
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hsquareLe) hsq

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.leadingEigenvalueRadius_lt_half
proof:
:= by
  have hrad : 0 <= q ^ 2 + 4 * q := by positivity
  have hqone : 0 <= q + 1 := by linarith
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 + 4 * q) < q + 1 := by
    apply (Real.sqrt_lt hrad hqone).2
    nlinarith
  unfold leadingEigenvalueRadius
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.leadingEigenvalueRadius_nonneg
statement:
theorem leadingEigenvalueRadius_nonneg {q : Real} (hq : 0 <= q) :
    0 <= leadingEigenvalueRadius q
proof:
:= by
  have hrad : 0 <= q ^ 2 + 4 * q := by positivity
  have hqSq : q ^ 2 <= q ^ 2 + 4 * q := by nlinarith
  have hsqrt : q <= Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 + 4 * q) :=
    Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hqSq
  unfold leadingEigenvalueRadius
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.leadingEigenvalueRadius_quadratic_eq
statement:
theorem leadingEigenvalueRadius_quadratic_eq {q : Real} (hq : 0 <= q) :
    leadingEigenvalueRadius q ^ 2 + q * leadingEigenvalueRadius q - q = 0
proof:
:= by
  let s := Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 + 4 * q)
  have hrad : 0 <= q ^ 2 + 4 * q := by positivity
  have hsq : s ^ 2 = q ^ 2 + 4 * q := by
    dsimp [s]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt hrad
  unfold leadingEigenvalueRadius
  dsimp [s] at hsq ⊢
  nlinarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.quotientKernel_pos
statement:
theorem quotientKernel_pos
    {p lambda : Real} {m : Nat}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hlambda : 0 <= lambda) (hlt : lambda < p)
    (hm2 : 2 <= m) :
    0 < (p ^ (m - 1) - lambda ^ (m - 1)) / (p + lambda)
proof:
:= by
  have hexp : m - 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hpow : lambda ^ (m - 1) < p ^ (m - 1) :=
    pow_lt_pow_left₀ hlt hlambda hexp
  exact div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hpow) (by linarith)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.q_pos
statement: theorem q_pos : 0 < P.q
proof: := by linarith [P.q_gt_third]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.q_nonneg
statement: theorem q_nonneg : 0 <= P.q
proof: := le_of_lt P.q_pos

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.p_gt_half
statement: theorem p_gt_half : 1 / 2 < P.p
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [p]
  linarith [P.q_lt_half]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.p_pos
statement: theorem p_pos : 0 < P.p
proof: := lt_trans (by norm_num) P.p_gt_half

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.alpha_pos
statement: theorem alpha_pos : 0 < P.alpha
proof: := lt_trans P.q_pos P.alpha_gt_q

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.alpha_nonneg
statement: theorem alpha_nonneg : 0 <= P.alpha
proof: := le_of_lt P.alpha_pos

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.alpha_lt_half
statement: theorem alpha_lt_half : P.alpha < 1 / 2
proof:
:=
  P.alpha_le_radius.trans_lt
    (leadingEigenvalueRadius_lt_half P.q_nonneg P.q_lt_half)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.alpha_lt_p
statement: theorem alpha_lt_p : P.alpha < P.p
proof:
:=
  lt_trans P.alpha_lt_half P.p_gt_half

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.leading_eigenvalue_quadratic_nonpos
statement:
theorem leading_eigenvalue_quadratic_nonpos :
    P.alpha ^ 2 + P.q * P.alpha - P.q <= 0
proof:
:= by
  let r := leadingEigenvalueRadius P.q
  have hr0 : 0 <= r := leadingEigenvalueRadius_nonneg P.q_nonneg
  have hroot : r ^ 2 + P.q * r - P.q = 0 :=
    leadingEigenvalueRadius_quadratic_eq P.q_nonneg
  have hdiff : 0 <= (r - P.alpha) * (r + P.alpha + P.q) :=
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr P.alpha_le_radius)
      (add_nonneg (add_nonneg hr0 P.alpha_nonneg) P.q_nonneg)
  nlinarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.L_radicand_nonneg
statement:
theorem L_radicand_nonneg :
    0 <= P.p * P.q - P.alpha ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hquad := P.leading_eigenvalue_quadratic_nonpos
  dsimp [p] at *
  have hqa : P.q ^ 2 < P.q * P.alpha := by
    nlinarith [mul_pos P.q_pos (sub_pos.mpr P.alpha_gt_q)]
  nlinarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.L_sq
statement: theorem L_sq : P.L ^ 2 = P.p * P.q - P.alpha ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold L
  exact Real.sq_sqrt P.L_radicand_nonneg

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.L_nonneg
statement: theorem L_nonneg : 0 <= P.L
proof: := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.L_lt_alpha
statement: theorem L_lt_alpha : P.L < P.alpha
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : P.p * P.q < 2 * P.alpha ^ 2 := by
    have hp2q : P.p < 2 * P.q := by
      dsimp [p]
      linarith [P.q_gt_third]
    have hpq2q : P.p * P.q < (2 * P.q) * P.q :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hp2q P.q_pos
    have hqSq : P.q ^ 2 < P.alpha ^ 2 :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ P.alpha_gt_q P.q_nonneg (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  have hsq : P.L ^ 2 < P.alpha ^ 2 := by
    rw [P.L_sq]
    linarith
  by_contra hnot
  have hale : P.alpha <= P.L := le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hsquareLe : P.alpha ^ 2 <= P.L ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ P.alpha_nonneg hale 2
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hsquareLe) hsq

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.L_lt_p
statement: theorem L_lt_p : P.L < P.p
proof: := P.L_lt_alpha.trans P.alpha_lt_p

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.f_pos
statement: theorem f_pos : 0 < P.f
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [f]
  exact sub_pos.mpr P.L_lt_alpha

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.k_alpha_pos
statement: theorem k_alpha_pos : 0 < P.k P.alpha
proof:
:= by
  unfold k
  exact quotientKernel_pos P.p_pos P.alpha_nonneg P.alpha_lt_p
    (le_trans (by norm_num : 2 <= 9) P.m_ge_nine)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.k_L_pos
statement: theorem k_L_pos : 0 < P.k P.L
proof:
:= by
  unfold k
  exact quotientKernel_pos P.p_pos P.L_nonneg P.L_lt_p
    (le_trans (by norm_num : 2 <= 9) P.m_ge_nine)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.A_pos
statement: theorem A_pos : 0 < P.A
proof:
:= by
  unfold A
  have hmNat : 0 < P.m :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 9) P.m_ge_nine
  have hmpos : 0 < (P.m : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hmNat
  have hterm : 0 < (P.m : Real) * P.k P.alpha :=
    mul_pos hmpos P.k_alpha_pos
  have hlead : 0 <= 2 * P.L ^ (P.m - 2) :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg P.L_nonneg _)
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.A_nonneg
statement: theorem A_nonneg : 0 <= P.A
proof: := le_of_lt P.A_pos

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.B_pos
statement: theorem B_pos : 0 < P.B
proof:
:= by
  unfold B
  have hmNat : 0 < P.m :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 9) P.m_ge_nine
  have hmpos : 0 < (P.m : Real) := by exact_mod_cast hmNat
  have hterm : 0 < (P.m : Real) * P.k P.L :=
    mul_pos hmpos P.k_L_pos
  have hlead : 0 <= 2 * P.L ^ (P.m - 2) :=
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (pow_nonneg P.L_nonneg _)
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.C_pos
statement: theorem C_pos : 0 < P.C
proof:
:= by
  unfold C
  have he : 0 < P.e := by dsimp [e]; linarith [P.alpha_lt_half]
  apply div_pos
  · exact mul_pos
      (mul_pos (mul_pos P.B_pos P.f_pos)
        (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (mul_pos (by norm_num) P.alpha_pos)))
      (sq_pos_of_pos he)
  · exact mul_pos (by norm_num) (sq_pos_of_pos P.alpha_pos)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.xi_pos
statement: theorem xi_pos : 0 < P.xi
proof:
:= by
  unfold xi d e
  have he : 0 < 1 - 2 * P.alpha := by linarith [P.alpha_lt_half]
  exact div_pos
    (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (sq_pos_of_pos P.alpha_pos))
      (sub_pos.mpr P.alpha_gt_q))
    (sq_pos_of_pos he)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.rho_pos
statement: theorem rho_pos : 0 < P.rho
proof:
:= by
  unfold rho
  exact mul_pos (div_pos P.A_pos P.B_pos)
    (div_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 P.alpha_pos)
      (mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num))) P.f_pos))

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.shapeThreshold_lower
statement:
theorem shapeThreshold_lower
    {alpha q L z K : Real}
    (halpha : 0 < alpha)
    (hd : 0 <= alpha - q) (hf : 0 <= alpha - L)
    (hK : 0 <= K) (hz : 2 * alpha <= z) (hz1 : z <= 1) :
    (alpha - q) * Real.sqrt (2 * alpha) / 2 +
        (alpha - L) * K / 2 <=
      shapeThreshold alpha q L z K
proof:
:= by
  let d := alpha - q
  let f := alpha - L
  let r := Real.sqrt z
  let s := Real.sqrt (2 * alpha)
  have hzpos : 0 < z := by nlinarith
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 hzpos
  have hrsq : r ^ 2 = z := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hzpos)
  have hsle : s <= r := by
    dsimp [s, r]
    exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hz
  have hr0 : 0 <= r := le_of_lt hrpos
  have hr1 : r <= 1 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r - 1)]
  have hdpart : d * s / 2 <= d * r / 2 := by
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsle (by simpa [d] using hd)) (by norm_num)
  have hfK : 0 <= f * K :=
    mul_nonneg (by simpa [f] using hf) hK
  have hfpart : f * K / 2 <= f * K / (2 * r) := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * r)).2
    have hmul : f * K * r <= f * K := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hfK (sub_nonneg.mpr hr1)]
    nlinarith
  calc
    (alpha - q) * Real.sqrt (2 * alpha) / 2 +
          (alpha - L) * K / 2 = d * s / 2 + f * K / 2 := rfl
    _ <= d * r / 2 + f * K / (2 * r) := add_le_add hdpart hfpart
    _ = shapeThreshold alpha q L z K := by
      change d * r / 2 + f * K / (2 * r) =
        (d * z + f * K) / (2 * r)
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hrpos]
      nlinarith [hrsq]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.safe_envelope_value_of_nonpos_c
statement:
theorem safe_envelope_value_of_nonpos_c
    {alpha q L z b K c gsSq : Real}
    (halpha : 0 < alpha) (hd : 0 < alpha - q) (hf : 0 < alpha - L)
    (hb : 0 <= b) (hK : 0 <= K) (_hgs : 0 <= gsSq)
    (hz : 2 * alpha <= z) (hc : c <= 0)
    (hsafe : max (shapeThreshold alpha q L z K - b * c) 0 ^ 2 <=
      gsSq * K) :
    (alpha - q) * (alpha - L) <= gsSq
proof:
:= by
  let d := alpha - q
  let f := alpha - L
  let r := Real.sqrt z
  let H := shapeThreshold alpha q L z K
  have hzpos : 0 < z := by nlinarith
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 hzpos
  have hrsq : r ^ 2 = z := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hzpos)
  have hHmul : 2 * r * H = d * z + f * K := by
    dsimp [H, d, f, r, shapeThreshold]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hrpos]
  have hHpos : 0 < H := by
    have hdz : 0 < d * z := mul_pos (by simpa [d] using hd) hzpos
    have hfK : 0 <= f * K :=
      mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (by simpa [f] using hf)) hK
    nlinarith
  have hbc : b * c <= 0 := mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hb hc
  have hactive : max (H - b * c) 0 = H - b * c :=
    max_eq_left (by linarith)
  have hKpos : 0 < K := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hKzero : K = 0 := le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt hnot) hK
    rw [hactive, hKzero, mul_zero] at hsafe
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (H - b * c)]
  have hAMGM : d * f * K <= H ^ 2 := by
    have hsq : 0 <= (d * z - f * K) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    have hcore : 4 * d * f * z * K <= (d * z + f * K) ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    have hzH : (2 * r * H) ^ 2 = 4 * z * H ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [hrsq]
    have hnumEq : (d * z + f * K) ^ 2 = 4 * z * H ^ 2 := by
      rw [← hHmul, hzH]
    rw [hnumEq] at hcore
    have hzmul : z * (d * f * K) <= z * H ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hzmul hzpos
  have hHsafe : H ^ 2 <= gsSq * K := by
    rw [hactive] at hsafe
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (b * c), mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hHpos) (neg_nonneg.mpr hbc)]
  have hcancel : d * f <= gsSq := by
    have hmul : (d * f) * K <= gsSq * K := by
      nlinarith [hAMGM.trans hHsafe]
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul hKpos
  simpa [d, f] using hcancel

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.safe_envelope_value_of_pos_c
statement:
theorem safe_envelope_value_of_pos_c
    {alpha q L z b K c gsSq : Real}
    (halpha : 0 < alpha)
    (hd : 0 <= alpha - q) (hf : 0 <= alpha - L)
    (_hb : 0 <= b) (hK : 0 <= K) (hgs : 0 <= gsSq)
    (hz : 2 * alpha <= z) (hz1 : z <= 1) (_hc : 0 < c)
    (hsafe : max (shapeThreshold alpha q L z K - b * c) 0 ^ 2 <=
      gsSq * K) :
    2 * (alpha - L) *
        max ((alpha - q) * Real.sqrt (2 * alpha) / 2 - b * c) 0 <=
      gsSq
proof:
:= by
  let d := alpha - q
  let f := alpha - L
  let s := Real.sqrt (2 * alpha)
  let H := shapeThreshold alpha q L z K
  let w := max (d * s / 2 - b * c) 0
  have hspos : 0 < s := by
    dsimp [s]
    positivity
  have hHlower : d * s / 2 + f * K / 2 <= H := by
    simpa [d, f, s, H] using
      shapeThreshold_lower halpha hd hf hK hz hz1
  by_cases hKzero : K = 0
  · subst K
    have hmaxZero : max (H - b * c) 0 = 0 := by
      simp only [mul_zero] at hsafe
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (max (H - b * c) 0)]
    have hHbc : H - b * c <= 0 := by
      exact max_eq_right_iff.mp hmaxZero
    have hwZero : w = 0 := by
      apply max_eq_right
      linarith
    rw [show max ((alpha - q) * Real.sqrt (2 * alpha) / 2 - b * c) 0 = w by rfl,
      hwZero]
    simpa using hgs
  · have hKpos : 0 < K := lt_of_le_of_ne hK (Ne.symm hKzero)
    by_cases hbase : d * s / 2 - b * c <= 0
    · have hwZero : w = 0 := max_eq_right hbase
      rw [show max ((alpha - q) * Real.sqrt (2 * alpha) / 2 - b * c) 0 = w by rfl,
        hwZero]
      simpa using hgs
    · have hw : w = d * s / 2 - b * c :=
        max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge hbase)
      have hcomp : w + f * K / 2 <= H - b * c := by
        rw [hw]
        linarith
      have hrightPos : 0 <= w + f * K / 2 := by
        have hw0 : 0 <= w := le_max_right _ _
        exact add_nonneg hw0 (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hf hK) (by norm_num))
      have hmaxComp : w + f * K / 2 <= max (H - b * c) 0 :=
        hcomp.trans (le_max_left _ _)
      have hsquareComp : (w + f * K / 2) ^ 2 <=
          max (H - b * c) 0 ^ 2 := by
        exact (sq_le_sq₀ hrightPos (le_max_right _ _)).2 hmaxComp
      have hAMGM : 2 * f * K * w <= (w + f * K / 2) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (w - f * K / 2)]
      have hmul : 2 * f * K * w <= gsSq * K :=
        hAMGM.trans (hsquareComp.trans hsafe)
      have hcancel : 2 * f * w <= gsSq := by
        have hmul' : (2 * f * w) * K <= gsSq * K := by
          nlinarith [hmul]
        exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right hmul' hKpos
      simpa [d, f, s, w] using hcancel

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.exact_envelope_shape_elimination
statement:
theorem exact_envelope_shape_elimination
    {alpha q L A B c gsSq z b K : Real}
    (halpha : 0 < alpha) (halphaHalf : alpha < 1 / 2)
    (hqalpha : q < alpha) (hLalpha : L < alpha)
    (hA : 0 <= A) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hb : 0 <= b) (hK : 0 <= K) (hgs : 0 <= gsSq)
    (hz : 2 * alpha <= z) (hshape : z + b ^ 2 + K = 1)
    (hdirect : 2 * c * Real.sqrt z + 2 * alpha * b <= z - 2 * alpha)
    (hsafe : max (shapeThreshold alpha q L z K - b * c) 0 ^ 2 <=
      gsSq * K) :
    let e := 1 - 2 * alpha
    let d := alpha - q
    let f := alpha - L
    let C := B * f * Real.sqrt (2 * alpha) * e ^ 2 / (4 * alpha ^ 2)
    let xi := 4 * alpha ^ 2 * d / e ^ 2
    let rho := (A / B) *
      (Real.sqrt alpha / (2 * Real.sqrt 2 * f))
    C * psi xi rho <= A * c ^ 2 + B * gsSq
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let e := 1 - 2 * alpha
  let d := alpha - q
  let f := alpha - L
  let s := Real.sqrt (2 * alpha)
  let C := B * f * s * e ^ 2 / (4 * alpha ^ 2)
  let xi := 4 * alpha ^ 2 * d / e ^ 2
  let rho := (A / B) *
    (Real.sqrt alpha / (2 * Real.sqrt 2 * f))
  have he : 0 < e := by dsimp [e]; linarith
  have hd : 0 < d := by dsimp [d]; linarith
  have hf : 0 < f := by dsimp [f]; linarith
  have hspos : 0 < s := by dsimp [s]; positivity
  have hssq : s ^ 2 = 2 * alpha := by
    dsimp [s]
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hs1 : s <= 1 := by
    have hs0 : 0 <= s := le_of_lt hspos
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s - 1)]
  have hC : 0 < C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have hxi : 0 <= xi := by dsimp [xi]; positivity
  have hrho : 0 <= rho := by dsimp [rho]; positivity
  by_cases hc : c <= 0
  · have hsafePay := safe_envelope_value_of_nonpos_c
      halpha (by simpa [d] using hd) (by simpa [f] using hf)
      hb hK hgs hz hc hsafe
    have hpsi : psi xi rho <= xi := by
      have h0 := psi_le_envelopeObjective
        (xi := xi) (rho := rho) hrho (show (0 : Real) ∈ Icc 0 1 by norm_num)
      simpa [envelopeObjective, max_eq_left hxi] using h0
    have hCxi : C * xi = B * f * s * d := by
      dsimp [C, xi]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt he, ne_of_gt halpha]
    have hsCompare : B * f * s * d <= B * f * d := by
      have hBf : 0 <= B * f := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hB) (le_of_lt hf)
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hBf (sub_nonneg.mpr hs1), le_of_lt hd]
    have hsafeB : B * f * d <= B * gsSq := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsafePay (le_of_lt hB)
      simpa [d, f, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hmul
    have hAc : 0 <= A * c ^ 2 := mul_nonneg hA (sq_nonneg c)
    calc
      C * psi xi rho <= C * xi :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpsi (le_of_lt hC)
      _ = B * f * s * d := hCxi
      _ <= B * f * d := hsCompare
      _ <= B * gsSq := hsafeB
      _ <= A * c ^ 2 + B * gsSq := by linarith
  · have hcpos : 0 < c := lt_of_not_ge hc
    have hz1 : z <= 1 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
    let r := Real.sqrt z
    have hzpos : 0 < z := by nlinarith
    have hrpos : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 hzpos
    have hrsq : r ^ 2 = z := by
      dsimp [r]
      exact Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hzpos)
    have hsr : s <= r := by
      dsimp [s, r]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hz
    have hdirectS : 2 * c * s + 2 * alpha * b <= z - 2 * alpha := by
      have hcs : 2 * c * s <= 2 * c * r := by
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsr (by positivity)
      change 2 * c * s + 2 * alpha * b <= z - 2 * alpha
      have hdirect' : 2 * c * r + 2 * alpha * b <= z - 2 * alpha := by
        simpa [r] using hdirect
      linarith
    have hbound : b ^ 2 + 2 * alpha * b + 2 * c * s <= e := by
      dsimp [e]
      nlinarith
    have hcsE : 2 * c * s <= e := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg b, mul_nonneg (le_of_lt halpha) hb, hK]
    let v := 2 * c * s / e
    have hv0 : 0 <= v := by dsimp [v]; positivity
    have hv1 : v <= 1 := by
      dsimp [v]
      exact (div_le_one he).2 hcsE
    have hv : v ∈ Icc (0 : Real) 1 := ⟨hv0, hv1⟩
    have hbBound : b <= (e - 2 * c * s) / (2 * alpha) := by
      apply (le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * alpha)).2
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
    have hbcBound : b * c <= c * (e - 2 * c * s) / (2 * alpha) := by
      have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbBound (le_of_lt hcpos)
      simpa [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hmul
    let t := xi - v + v ^ 2
    let factor := s * e ^ 2 / (8 * alpha ^ 2)
    have hfactor : 0 < factor := by dsimp [factor]; positivity
    have hfactorEq : factor * t =
        d * s / 2 - c * (e - 2 * c * s) / (2 * alpha) := by
      dsimp [factor, t, xi, v]
      field_simp [ne_of_gt he, ne_of_gt halpha]
      linear_combination
        (-4 * e * c + 8 * s * c ^ 2) * hssq
    have hbaseNorm : factor * t <= d * s / 2 - b * c := by
      rw [hfactorEq]
      linarith
    have hmaxNorm : factor * max t 0 <=
        max (d * s / 2 - b * c) 0 := by
      by_cases ht : t <= 0
      · rw [max_eq_right ht]
        simp only [mul_zero]
        exact le_max_right _ _
      · rw [max_eq_left (le_of_not_ge ht)]
        exact hbaseNorm.trans (le_max_left _ _)
    have hsafePay := safe_envelope_value_of_pos_c
      halpha (le_of_lt (by simpa [d] using hd))
      (le_of_lt (by simpa [f] using hf)) hb hK hgs hz hz1 hcpos hsafe
    have hCfactor : C = 2 * B * f * factor := by
      dsimp [C, factor]
      ring
    have hmaxPay : C * max t 0 <= B * gsSq := by
      have hscale : 0 <= 2 * B * f := by positivity
      have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmaxNorm hscale
      have hsafeB := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsafePay (le_of_lt hB)
      rw [hCfactor]
      calc
        2 * B * f * factor * max t 0 =
            2 * B * f * (factor * max t 0) := by ring
        _ <= 2 * B * f * max (d * s / 2 - b * c) 0 := hscaled
        _ <= B * gsSq := by
          simpa [d, f, s, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hsafeB
    let ra := Real.sqrt alpha
    let rtwo := Real.sqrt 2
    have hraSq : ra ^ 2 = alpha := by
      dsimp [ra]
      exact Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt halpha)
    have hrtwoSq : rtwo ^ 2 = 2 := by
      dsimp [rtwo]
      exact Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
    have hrtwoPos : 0 < rtwo := by dsimp [rtwo]; positivity
    have hsEq : s = rtwo * ra := by
      dsimp [s, rtwo, ra]
      rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : Real) <= 2)]
    have hsRoot : s * Real.sqrt alpha = Real.sqrt 2 * alpha := by
      rw [hsEq]
      change rtwo * ra * ra = rtwo * alpha
      calc
        rtwo * ra * ra = rtwo * ra ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = rtwo * alpha := by rw [hraSq]
    have hratio : s * Real.sqrt alpha * s ^ 2 =
        2 * Real.sqrt 2 * alpha ^ 2 := by
      rw [hssq, hsRoot]
      ring
    have hcoeff : C * rho * v ^ 2 = A * c ^ 2 := by
      calc
        C * rho * v ^ 2 = A * c ^ 2 *
            (s * Real.sqrt alpha * s ^ 2 /
              (2 * Real.sqrt 2 * alpha ^ 2)) := by
          dsimp [C, rho, v]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hB, ne_of_gt hf, ne_of_gt he,
            ne_of_gt halpha, ne_of_gt hrtwoPos]
          ring
        _ = A * c ^ 2 := by
          rw [hratio]
          field_simp [ne_of_gt hrtwoPos, ne_of_gt halpha]
    have hpsi := psi_le_envelopeObjective
      (xi := xi) (rho := rho) hrho hv
    calc
      C * psi xi rho <= C * envelopeObjective xi rho v :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpsi (le_of_lt hC)
      _ = C * rho * v ^ 2 + C * max t 0 := by
        unfold envelopeObjective
        dsimp [t]
        ring
      _ = A * c ^ 2 + C * max t 0 := by rw [hcoeff]
      _ <= A * c ^ 2 + B * gsSq := add_le_add (le_refl _) hmaxPay

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.exact_envelope_shape_elimination_two_sided
statement:
theorem exact_envelope_shape_elimination_two_sided
    {alpha q L A B c gsSq z b K : Real}
    (halpha : 0 < alpha) (halphaHalf : alpha < 1 / 2)
    (hqalpha : q < alpha) (hLalpha : L < alpha)
    (hA : 0 <= A) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hK : 0 <= K) (hgs : 0 <= gsSq)
    (hz : 2 * alpha <= z) (hshape : z + b ^ 2 + K = 1)
    (hdirect : 2 * c * Real.sqrt z + 2 * alpha * b <= z - 2 * alpha)
    (hdirectNeg : -2 * c * Real.sqrt z - 2 * alpha * b <= z - 2 * alpha)
    (hsafe : max (shapeThreshold alpha q L z K - b * c) 0 ^ 2 <=
      gsSq * K) :
    let e := 1 - 2 * alpha
    let d := alpha - q
    let f := alpha - L
    let C := B * f * Real.sqrt (2 * alpha) * e ^ 2 / (4 * alpha ^ 2)
    let xi := 4 * alpha ^ 2 * d / e ^ 2
    let rho := (A / B) *
      (Real.sqrt alpha / (2 * Real.sqrt 2 * f))
    C * psi xi rho <= A * c ^ 2 + B * gsSq
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  by_cases hb : 0 <= b
  · exact exact_envelope_shape_elimination halpha halphaHalf hqalpha hLalpha
      hA hB hb hK hgs hz hshape hdirect hsafe
  · have hbneg : b < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hb
    have hshape' : z + (-b) ^ 2 + K = 1 := by
      simpa only [neg_sq] using hshape
    have hdirect' : 2 * (-c) * Real.sqrt z + 2 * alpha * (-b) <=
        z - 2 * alpha := by
      linarith
    have hsafe' :
        max (shapeThreshold alpha q L z K - (-b) * (-c)) 0 ^ 2 <=
          gsSq * K := by
      simpa only [neg_mul_neg] using hsafe
    have hpay := exact_envelope_shape_elimination
      (alpha := alpha) (q := q) (L := L) (A := A) (B := B)
      (c := -c) (gsSq := gsSq) (z := z) (b := -b) (K := K)
      halpha halphaHalf hqalpha hLalpha hA hB (by linarith) hK hgs hz
      hshape' hdirect' hsafe'
    simpa only [neg_sq] using hpay

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.continuous_envelopeObjective
statement:
theorem continuous_envelopeObjective (xi rho : Real) :
    Continuous (envelopeObjective xi rho)
proof:
:= by
  unfold envelopeObjective
  fun_prop

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.envelopeObjective_image_nonempty
statement:
theorem envelopeObjective_image_nonempty (xi rho : Real) :
    (envelopeObjective xi rho '' Icc (0 : Real) 1).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨envelopeObjective xi rho 0, ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num, rfl⟩⟩

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.envelopeObjective_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  unfold envelopeObjective
  exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hrho (sq_nonneg v)) (le_max_right _ _)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.envelopeObjective_image_bddBelow
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  rcases hy with ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  exact envelopeObjective_nonneg hrho

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.exists_envelope_minimizer
statement:
theorem exists_envelope_minimizer (xi rho : Real) :
    ∃ v ∈ Icc (0 : Real) 1,
      psi xi rho = envelopeObjective xi rho v
proof:
:= by
  have hcompact : IsCompact
      (envelopeObjective xi rho '' Icc (0 : Real) 1) :=
    isCompact_Icc.image (continuous_envelopeObjective xi rho)
  have hmem := hcompact.sInf_mem (envelopeObjective_image_nonempty xi rho)
  rcases hmem with ⟨v, hv, hvalue⟩
  refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
  unfold psi
  exact hvalue.symm

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.psi_le_envelopeObjective
proof:
:= by
  unfold psi
  exact csInf_le (envelopeObjective_image_bddBelow hrho) ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.psi_nonneg
statement:
theorem psi_nonneg {xi rho : Real} (hrho : 0 <= rho) :
    0 <= psi xi rho
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_envelope_minimizer xi rho with ⟨v, hv, hvalue⟩
  rw [hvalue]
  exact envelopeObjective_nonneg hrho

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.mul_le_max_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · rw [max_eq_left ht]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlambda.2 ht]
  · have ht' : t ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge ht
    rw [max_eq_right ht']
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hlambda.1 ht'

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.envelopeDual_le_envelopeObjective
statement:
theorem envelopeDual_le_envelopeObjective
    {xi rho lambda v : Real}
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (hlambda : lambda ∈ Icc (0 : Real) 1) :
    envelopeDual xi rho lambda ≤ envelopeObjective xi rho v
proof:
:= by
  have hmax := mul_le_max_zero
    (t := xi - v + v ^ 2) hlambda
  by_cases ha : rho + lambda = 0
  · have hrho0 : rho = 0 := by nlinarith [hlambda.1]
    have hlambda0 : lambda = 0 := by nlinarith
    rw [hrho0, hlambda0]
    simp [envelopeDual, envelopeObjective]
  · have ha0 : 0 < rho + lambda := by
      have : 0 ≤ rho + lambda := add_nonneg hrho hlambda.1
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne this (Ne.symm ha)
    have hquad :
        -(lambda ^ 2) / (4 * (rho + lambda)) ≤
          (rho + lambda) * v ^ 2 - lambda * v := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 4 * (rho + lambda))]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * (rho + lambda) * v - lambda)]
    unfold envelopeDual envelopeObjective
    calc
      lambda * xi - lambda ^ 2 / (4 * (rho + lambda)) ≤
          lambda * xi + ((rho + lambda) * v ^ 2 - lambda * v) := by
            calc
              lambda * xi - lambda ^ 2 / (4 * (rho + lambda)) =
                  lambda * xi + (-(lambda ^ 2) / (4 * (rho + lambda))) := by ring
              _ ≤ _ := by
                simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hquad (lambda * xi)
      _ = rho * v ^ 2 +
          lambda * (xi - v + v ^ 2) := by ring
      _ ≤ rho * v ^ 2 + max (xi - v + v ^ 2) 0 :=
        by simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_right hmax (rho * v ^ 2)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.envelopeDual_le_psi
statement:
theorem envelopeDual_le_psi
    {xi rho lambda : Real}
    (hrho : 0 ≤ rho)
    (hlambda : lambda ∈ Icc (0 : Real) 1) :
    envelopeDual xi rho lambda ≤ psi xi rho
proof:
:= by
  unfold psi
  apply le_csInf (envelopeObjective_image_nonempty xi rho)
  intro y hy
  rcases hy with ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  exact envelopeDual_le_envelopeObjective hrho hlambda

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.psi_ge_dual_one
statement:
theorem psi_ge_dual_one {xi rho : Real} (hrho : 0 ≤ rho) :
    xi - 1 / (4 * (rho + 1)) ≤ psi xi rho
proof:
:= by
  simpa [envelopeDual] using
    (envelopeDual_le_psi (xi := xi) (rho := rho) (lambda := 1) hrho
      (by constructor <;> norm_num))

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.psi_ge_dual_two_rho_xi
statement:
theorem psi_ge_dual_two_rho_xi
    {xi rho : Real}
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (hxi : 0 ≤ xi)
    (hlambda : 2 * rho * xi ≤ 1) :
    rho * xi ^ 2 * (1 + 4 * xi) / (1 + 2 * xi) ≤ psi xi rho
proof:
:= by
  have hlambdaMem : 2 * rho * xi ∈ Icc (0 : Real) 1 := by
    exact ⟨mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hrho.le) hxi, hlambda⟩
  have hcert := envelopeDual_le_psi
    (xi := xi) (rho := rho) (lambda := 2 * rho * xi) hrho.le hlambdaMem
  have hdenXi : 1 + 2 * xi ≠ 0 := by linarith
  have hdenRho : rho ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hrho
  have heq :
      envelopeDual xi rho (2 * rho * xi) =
        rho * xi ^ 2 * (1 + 4 * xi) / (1 + 2 * xi) := by
    unfold envelopeDual
    field_simp [hdenXi, hdenRho]
    ring
  rw [heq] at hcert
  exact hcert

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.quadratic_ceiling_of_variance_lower_bound
statement:
theorem quadratic_ceiling_of_variance_lower_bound
    {q alpha g2 : Real}
    (_hq : (1 : Real) / 3 < q)
    (halpha : q < alpha)
    (halpha_half : alpha < (1 : Real) / 2)
    (hforced : alpha * (alpha - q) ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - 2 * alpha)) ≤ g2)
    (hbound : alpha ^ 2 + 2 * g2 ≤ (1 - q) * q) :
    alpha ^ 2 + q * alpha - q ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < 2 * (1 - 2 * alpha) := by linarith
  have hforced' :
      alpha * (alpha - q) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 - 2 * alpha) * g2 :=
    by simpa [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      (div_le_iff₀ hden).mp hforced
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * alpha := by linarith
  have hbound' : 2 * g2 ≤ (1 - q) * q - alpha ^ 2 := by linarith
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbound' hnonneg
  have hmain :
      alpha * (alpha - q) ^ 2 ≤
        (1 - 2 * alpha) * ((1 - q) * q - alpha ^ 2) := by
    calc
      alpha * (alpha - q) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 - 2 * alpha) * g2 := hforced'
      _ = (1 - 2 * alpha) * (2 * g2) := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 - 2 * alpha) * ((1 - q) * q - alpha ^ 2) := hmul
  have hfactor :
      (1 - alpha - q) * (alpha ^ 2 + q * alpha - q) ≤ 0 := by
    have hid :
        alpha * (alpha - q) ^ 2 -
            (1 - 2 * alpha) * ((1 - q) * q - alpha ^ 2) =
          (1 - alpha - q) * (alpha ^ 2 + q * alpha - q) := by ring
    rw [← hid]
    linarith
  have hpositive : 0 < 1 - alpha - q := by
    have hqhalf : q < (1 : Real) / 2 := by linarith
    linarith
  exact nonpos_of_mul_nonpos_right hfactor hpositive

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.alpha_le_leadingEigenvalueRadius_of_quadratic
statement:
theorem alpha_le_leadingEigenvalueRadius_of_quadratic
    {q alpha : Real}
    (_hq : 0 ≤ q) (_halpha : 0 ≤ alpha)
    (hquad : alpha ^ 2 + q * alpha - q ≤ 0) :
    alpha ≤ leadingEigenvalueRadius q
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (2 * alpha + q) ^ 2 ≤ q ^ 2 + 4 * q := by
    nlinarith
  have hsqrt : 2 * alpha + q ≤ Real.sqrt (q ^ 2 + 4 * q) :=
    Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hsq
  unfold leadingEigenvalueRadius
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.leadingEigenvalueRadius_of_variance_lower_bound
statement:
theorem leadingEigenvalueRadius_of_variance_lower_bound
    {q alpha g2 : Real}
    (hq : (1 : Real) / 3 < q)
    (halpha : q < alpha)
    (halpha_half : alpha < (1 : Real) / 2)
    (hforced : alpha * (alpha - q) ^ 2 / (2 * (1 - 2 * alpha)) ≤ g2)
    (hbound : alpha ^ 2 + 2 * g2 ≤ (1 - q) * q) :
    alpha ≤ leadingEigenvalueRadius q
proof:
:= by
  have hquad := quadratic_ceiling_of_variance_lower_bound hq halpha halpha_half
    hforced hbound
  exact alpha_le_leadingEigenvalueRadius_of_quadratic (by linarith) (by linarith) hquad

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.k_eq_directedKernel
statement:
theorem k_eq_directedKernel (lambda : Real) (hlambda : -P.p <= lambda)
    (hden : P.p + lambda ≠ 0) :
    P.k lambda = IntermediateRegion.directedKernel P.p P.m lambda
proof:
:= by
  unfold k
  symm
  exact IntermediateRegion.directedKernel_eq_div P.m_odd
    (le_trans (by norm_num) P.m_ge_nine) hlambda hden

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.C_mul_xi
statement:
theorem C_mul_xi :
    P.C * P.xi = Real.sqrt (2 * P.alpha) * P.B * P.f * P.d
proof:
:= by
  unfold C xi
  have he : P.e ≠ 0 := P.e_pos.ne'
  have ha : P.alpha ≠ 0 := P.alpha_pos.ne'
  field_simp [he, ha]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.e_pos
statement: theorem e_pos : 0 < P.e
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [e]
  linarith [P.alpha_lt_half]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.d_pos
statement: theorem d_pos : 0 < P.d
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [d]
  exact sub_pos.mpr P.alpha_gt_q

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.alpha_mul_tau
statement: theorem alpha_mul_tau : P.alpha * P.tau = P.q
proof:
:= by
  unfold tau
  field_simp [P.alpha_pos.ne']

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.alpha_mul_ell
statement: theorem alpha_mul_ell : P.alpha * P.ell = P.L
proof:
:= by
  unfold ell
  field_simp [P.alpha_pos.ne']

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.tau_pos
statement: theorem tau_pos : 0 < P.tau
proof: := div_pos P.q_pos P.alpha_pos

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.tau_lt_one
statement: theorem tau_lt_one : P.tau < 1
proof: := (div_lt_one P.alpha_pos).2 P.alpha_gt_q

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartU_pos
statement: theorem chartU_pos : 0 < P.chartU
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartU; linarith [P.tau_lt_one]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.L_pos
statement: theorem L_pos : 0 < P.L
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < P.p * P.q - P.alpha ^ 2 := by
    have hquad := P.leading_eigenvalue_quadratic_nonpos
    have hp : P.p = 1 - P.q := rfl
    nlinarith [P.q_pos, P.alpha_gt_q, mul_pos P.q_pos (sub_pos.mpr P.alpha_gt_q)]
  unfold L
  rwa [Real.sqrt_pos]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.ell_pos
statement: theorem ell_pos : 0 < P.ell
proof: := div_pos P.L_pos P.alpha_pos

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartD_pos
statement: theorem chartD_pos : 0 < P.chartD
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartD; positivity

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartSigma_pos
statement: theorem chartSigma_pos : 0 < P.chartSigma
proof: := div_pos P.p_pos P.alpha_pos

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartSigma_gt_one
statement: theorem chartSigma_gt_one : 1 < P.chartSigma
proof:
:=
  (one_lt_div P.alpha_pos).2 P.alpha_lt_p

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartV_pos
statement: theorem chartV_pos : 0 < P.chartV
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartV; linarith [P.chartSigma_gt_one]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartZeta_pos
statement: theorem chartZeta_pos : 0 < P.chartZeta
proof:
:=
  div_pos (pow_pos P.ell_pos 2) P.chartU_pos

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartD_mul_alpha_sq
statement: theorem chartD_mul_alpha_sq : P.alpha ^ 2 * P.chartD = P.q
proof:
:= by
  have ht2 : P.alpha ^ 2 * P.tau ^ 2 = P.q ^ 2 := by
    rw [← P.alpha_mul_tau]; ring
  have hl2 : P.alpha ^ 2 * P.ell ^ 2 = P.L ^ 2 := by
    rw [← P.alpha_mul_ell]; ring
  have hL : P.L ^ 2 = P.p * P.q - P.alpha ^ 2 := P.L_sq
  have hp : P.p = 1 - P.q := rfl
  unfold chartD
  linear_combination ht2 + hl2 + hL + P.q * hp

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.alpha_mul_chartD
statement: theorem alpha_mul_chartD : P.alpha * P.chartD = P.tau
proof:
:= by
  have hmaster := P.chartD_mul_alpha_sq
  have h1 : P.alpha * P.chartD * P.alpha = P.tau * P.alpha := by
    have e : P.alpha * P.chartD * P.alpha = P.alpha ^ 2 * P.chartD := by ring
    rw [e, hmaster, ← P.alpha_mul_tau]; ring
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ P.alpha_pos.ne' h1

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartD_mul_q
statement: theorem chartD_mul_q : P.q * P.chartD = P.tau ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hmaster := P.chartD_mul_alpha_sq
  have htau2 : P.tau ^ 2 * P.alpha ^ 2 = P.q ^ 2 := by
    rw [← P.alpha_mul_tau]; ring
  have h1 : P.q * P.chartD * P.alpha ^ 2 = P.tau ^ 2 * P.alpha ^ 2 := by
    have e : P.q * P.chartD * P.alpha ^ 2 = P.q * (P.alpha ^ 2 * P.chartD) := by ring
    rw [e, hmaster, htau2]; ring
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 P.alpha_pos.ne') h1

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartSigma_mul_tau
statement: theorem chartSigma_mul_tau : P.chartSigma * P.tau = 1 + P.ell ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hl2 : P.alpha ^ 2 * P.ell ^ 2 = P.L ^ 2 := by
    rw [← P.alpha_mul_ell]; ring
  have hL : P.L ^ 2 = P.p * P.q - P.alpha ^ 2 := P.L_sq
  have hst : P.chartSigma * P.alpha = P.p := by
    unfold chartSigma; field_simp [P.alpha_pos.ne']
  have hta : P.tau * P.alpha = P.q := by
    rw [mul_comm]; exact P.alpha_mul_tau
  have h1 : P.chartSigma * P.tau * P.alpha ^ 2 = (1 + P.ell ^ 2) * P.alpha ^ 2 := by
    have e : P.chartSigma * P.tau * P.alpha ^ 2
        = (P.chartSigma * P.alpha) * (P.tau * P.alpha) := by ring
    rw [e, hst, hta]
    linear_combination -hl2 - hL
  exact mul_right_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 P.alpha_pos.ne') h1

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.ell_lt_tau
statement: theorem ell_lt_tau : P.ell < P.tau
proof:
:= by
  unfold ell tau
  exact (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right P.alpha_pos).2 P.L_lt_q

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartD_lt_three_tau_sq
statement: theorem chartD_lt_three_tau_sq : P.chartD < 3 * P.tau ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hqD : P.q * P.chartD = P.tau ^ 2 := P.chartD_mul_q
  have hDpos := P.chartD_pos
  nlinarith [P.q_gt_third, hDpos, hqD,
    mul_pos hDpos (show (0:ℝ) < 3 * P.q - 1 by linarith [P.q_gt_third])]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.tau_mul_chartU_le_ell_sq
statement: theorem tau_mul_chartU_le_ell_sq : P.tau * P.chartU ≤ P.ell ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hquad := P.leading_eigenvalue_quadratic_nonpos
  have hl2 : P.alpha ^ 2 * P.ell ^ 2 = P.L ^ 2 := by rw [← P.alpha_mul_ell]; ring
  have hL : P.L ^ 2 = P.p * P.q - P.alpha ^ 2 := P.L_sq
  have hp : P.p = 1 - P.q := rfl
  have hau : P.alpha ^ 2 * (P.tau * P.chartU) = P.q * (P.alpha - P.q) := by
    unfold chartU
    have h1 : P.alpha ^ 2 * P.tau = P.alpha * P.q := by rw [← P.alpha_mul_tau]; ring
    have h2 : P.alpha ^ 2 * P.tau ^ 2 = P.q ^ 2 := by rw [← P.alpha_mul_tau]; ring
    linear_combination h1 - h2
  have hkey : P.alpha ^ 2 * (P.tau * P.chartU) ≤ P.alpha ^ 2 * P.ell ^ 2 := by
    rw [hau, hl2, hL, hp]; nlinarith [hquad]
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hkey (pow_pos P.alpha_pos 2)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.tau_gt_three_quarters
statement: theorem tau_gt_three_quarters : 3 / 4 < P.tau
proof:
:= by
  have hDge : 1 + P.tau ≤ P.chartD := by
    have hu : P.chartU = 1 - P.tau := rfl
    have h := P.tau_mul_chartU_le_ell_sq
    rw [hu] at h
    unfold chartD
    nlinarith [h]
  have h3 : 1 + P.tau < 3 * P.tau ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt hDge P.chartD_lt_three_tau_sq
  have ha23 : (2:ℝ) / 3 < P.tau := by
    show (2:ℝ) / 3 < P.q / P.alpha
    rw [lt_div_iff₀ P.alpha_pos]
    nlinarith [P.q_gt_third, P.alpha_lt_half]
  nlinarith [h3, ha23, P.tau_pos]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartSigma_lt_two
statement: theorem chartSigma_lt_two : P.chartSigma < 2
proof:
:= by
  show P.p / P.alpha < 2
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ P.alpha_pos]
  have hp : P.p < 2 / 3 := by have := P.q_gt_third; unfold p; linarith
  have hα : 1 / 3 < P.alpha := P.q_gt_third.trans P.alpha_gt_q
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartV_lt_one
statement: theorem chartV_lt_one : P.chartV < 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartV; linarith [P.chartSigma_lt_two]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartZeta_mul_chartU
statement: theorem chartZeta_mul_chartU : P.chartZeta * P.chartU = P.ell ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartZeta
  field_simp [P.chartU_pos.ne']

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.tau_mul_chartH
statement: theorem tau_mul_chartH : P.tau * P.chartH = 1 + P.chartZeta
proof:
:= by
  have hA : P.tau * P.chartV + P.tau = 1 + P.ell ^ 2 := by
    have h := P.chartSigma_mul_tau
    have hv : P.chartSigma = P.chartV + 1 := by unfold chartV; ring
    rw [hv] at h
    linear_combination h
  have hB : P.chartZeta - P.chartZeta * P.tau = P.ell ^ 2 := by
    have h := P.chartZeta_mul_chartU
    have hu : P.chartU = 1 - P.tau := rfl
    rw [hu] at h
    linear_combination h
  unfold chartH
  linear_combination hA - hB

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartU_mul_chartH
statement: theorem chartU_mul_chartH : P.chartU * P.chartH = P.chartV
proof:
:= by
  have ha := P.tau_mul_chartH
  have hu : P.chartU = 1 - P.tau := rfl
  unfold chartH at ha ⊢
  rw [hu]
  linear_combination -ha

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartH_pos
statement: theorem chartH_pos : 0 < P.chartH
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartH; linarith [P.chartZeta_pos, P.chartV_pos]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.zeta_domain
statement: theorem zeta_domain : 1 ≤ P.chartZeta * (P.chartZeta + P.chartV)
proof:
:= by
  have hceil := P.tau_mul_chartU_le_ell_sq
  have hell := P.chartZeta_mul_chartU
  have haH := P.tau_mul_chartH
  have huH := P.chartU_mul_chartH
  have hvpos := P.chartV_pos
  have step1 : (1 + P.chartZeta) * P.chartV
      ≤ P.chartZeta * P.chartV * P.chartH := by
    have hmul : (P.tau * P.chartU) * P.chartH ^ 2 ≤ P.ell ^ 2 * P.chartH ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hceil (sq_nonneg _)
    have eL : (P.tau * P.chartU) * P.chartH ^ 2
        = (P.tau * P.chartH) * (P.chartU * P.chartH) := by ring
    have eR : P.ell ^ 2 * P.chartH ^ 2
        = P.chartZeta * (P.chartU * P.chartH) * P.chartH := by
      rw [← hell]; ring
    rw [eL, eR, haH, huH] at hmul
    exact hmul
  have step2 : 1 + P.chartZeta ≤ P.chartZeta * P.chartH := by
    have h : (1 + P.chartZeta) * P.chartV ≤ (P.chartZeta * P.chartH) * P.chartV := by
      have e : P.chartZeta * P.chartV * P.chartH = (P.chartZeta * P.chartH) * P.chartV := by ring
      rw [← e]; exact step1
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_right h hvpos
  unfold chartH at step2
  nlinarith [step2]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.R_eq_alpha_pow_mul_chartFN
statement: theorem R_eq_alpha_pow_mul_chartFN : P.R = P.alpha ^ P.m * P.chartFN
proof:
:= by
  have hm9 : 9 ≤ P.m := P.m_ge_nine
  have hN2 : P.chartN + 2 = P.m := by unfold chartN; omega
  have hatN : P.alpha ^ P.chartN * P.tau ^ P.chartN = P.q ^ P.chartN := by
    rw [← mul_pow, P.alpha_mul_tau]
  have haeN : P.alpha ^ P.chartN * P.ell ^ P.chartN = P.L ^ P.chartN := by
    rw [← mul_pow, P.alpha_mul_ell]
  have hae2 : P.alpha ^ 2 * P.ell ^ 2 = P.L ^ 2 := by
    rw [← mul_pow, P.alpha_mul_ell]
  have hmsplit : P.alpha ^ P.m = P.alpha ^ P.chartN * P.alpha ^ 2 := by
    rw [← pow_add, hN2]
  have hLmsplit : P.L ^ P.m = P.L ^ P.chartN * P.L ^ 2 := by
    rw [← pow_add, hN2]
  have hqsplit : P.q ^ (P.m - 1) = P.q ^ P.chartN * P.q := by
    rw [← pow_succ, show P.chartN + 1 = P.m - 1 by unfold chartN; omega]
  have hL : P.L ^ 2 = P.p * P.q - P.alpha ^ 2 := P.L_sq
  unfold chartFN R
  rw [hmsplit, hLmsplit, hqsplit]
  linear_combination (P.alpha ^ 2 + P.alpha ^ 2 * P.ell ^ 2) * hatN
    - (P.alpha ^ 2 * P.ell ^ 2) * haeN
    + (P.q ^ P.chartN - P.L ^ P.chartN) * hae2
    + P.q ^ P.chartN * hL

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartFN_le_chartU_mul_chartTN
statement: theorem chartFN_le_chartU_mul_chartTN : P.chartFN ≤ P.chartU * P.chartTN
proof:
:= by
  have hζu : P.chartZeta * P.chartU = P.ell ^ 2 := P.chartZeta_mul_chartU
  have hbern : 1 - (P.chartN : Real) * P.chartU ≤ P.tau ^ P.chartN := by
    have h := one_add_mul_le_pow
      (show (-2:ℝ) ≤ -P.chartU by unfold chartU; linarith [P.tau_pos]) P.chartN
    have heq : (1 + -P.chartU) ^ P.chartN = P.tau ^ P.chartN := by
      congr 1; unfold chartU; ring
    rw [heq] at h
    linarith [h]
  have hrhs : P.chartU * P.chartTN
      = (P.chartN : Real) * P.chartU
        - P.ell ^ 2 * (P.tau ^ P.chartN - P.ell ^ P.chartN) := by
    unfold chartTN
    have huζ : P.chartU * P.chartZeta = P.ell ^ 2 := by rw [mul_comm]; exact hζu
    linear_combination -(P.tau ^ P.chartN - P.ell ^ P.chartN) * huζ
  rw [hrhs]
  unfold chartFN
  linarith [hbern]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.scalar_target_of_chartTN_nonpos
statement:
theorem scalar_target_of_chartTN_nonpos (h : P.chartTN ≤ 0) :
    P.R ≤ P.C * psi P.xi P.rho
proof:
:= by
  have hR : P.R ≤ 0 := by
    rw [P.R_eq_alpha_pow_mul_chartFN]
    have hFN : P.chartFN ≤ 0 :=
      le_trans P.chartFN_le_chartU_mul_chartTN
        (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos P.chartU_pos.le h)
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (pow_nonneg P.alpha_pos.le _) hFN
  have hpsi : 0 ≤ P.C * psi P.xi P.rho :=
    mul_nonneg P.C_pos.le (psi_nonneg P.rho_pos.le)
  linarith

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartN_pos_real
statement: theorem chartN_pos_real : (0:ℝ) < (P.chartN : Real)
proof:
:= by
  have : 0 < P.chartN := by have := P.m_ge_nine; unfold chartN; omega
  exact_mod_cast this

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.tau_pow_sub_ell_pow_ge
statement:
theorem tau_pow_sub_ell_pow_ge :
    (P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * (P.tau - P.ell)
      ≤ P.tau ^ P.chartN - P.ell ^ P.chartN
proof:
:= by
  have hℓ := P.ell_pos
  have hℓa := P.ell_lt_tau
  have hN1 : P.chartN - 1 + 1 = P.chartN := by have := P.m_ge_nine; unfold chartN; omega
  have hbern := one_add_mul_le_pow
    (show (-2:ℝ) ≤ P.tau / P.ell - 1 by
      have : (1:ℝ) ≤ P.tau / P.ell := (one_le_div hℓ).2 hℓa.le
      linarith) P.chartN
  have e1 : (1 + (P.tau / P.ell - 1)) ^ P.chartN = P.tau ^ P.chartN / P.ell ^ P.chartN := by
    rw [show (1:ℝ) + (P.tau / P.ell - 1) = P.tau / P.ell by ring, div_pow]
  rw [e1] at hbern
  have hℓN : (0:ℝ) < P.ell ^ P.chartN := pow_pos hℓ _
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hℓN] at hbern
  have hℓsplit : P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * P.ell = P.ell ^ P.chartN := by
    rw [← pow_succ, hN1]
  have e2 : (1 + (P.chartN : Real) * (P.tau / P.ell - 1)) * P.ell ^ P.chartN
      = P.ell ^ P.chartN
        + (P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * (P.tau - P.ell) := by
    rw [← hℓsplit]
    field_simp
  rw [e2] at hbern
  linarith [hbern]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.tau_sub_ell_gt_chartU
statement: theorem tau_sub_ell_gt_chartU : P.chartU < P.tau - P.ell
proof:
:= by
  have hDlt := P.chartD_lt_three_tau_sq
  have hDeq : P.chartD = 1 + P.tau ^ 2 + P.ell ^ 2 := rfl
  have hell2 : P.ell ^ 2 < 2 * P.tau ^ 2 - 1 := by rw [hDeq] at hDlt; linarith
  have hlt : P.ell ^ 2 < (2 * P.tau - 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (P.tau - 1)]
  have h2a1 : 0 < 2 * P.tau - 1 := by linarith [P.tau_gt_three_quarters]
  have hell_lt : P.ell < 2 * P.tau - 1 := by
    by_contra hcon
    have hge : 2 * P.tau - 1 ≤ P.ell := not_lt.mp hcon
    nlinarith [hlt, hge, h2a1, P.ell_pos]
  unfold chartU
  linarith [hell_lt]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartTN_lt
statement: theorem chartTN_lt : P.chartTN < (P.chartN : Real) * (1 - P.ell ^ (P.chartN + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hconv := P.tau_pow_sub_ell_pow_ge
  have hstep1 := P.tau_sub_ell_gt_chartU
  have hζpos := P.chartZeta_pos
  have hζu : P.chartZeta * P.chartU = P.ell ^ 2 := P.chartZeta_mul_chartU
  have hℓpos := P.ell_pos
  have hNpos := P.chartN_pos_real
  have hNℓpos : (0:ℝ) < (P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) :=
    mul_pos hNpos (pow_pos hℓpos _)
  have hℓexp : P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * P.ell ^ 2 = P.ell ^ (P.chartN + 1) := by
    rw [← pow_add]; congr 1; have := P.m_ge_nine; unfold chartN; omega
  have h1 : P.chartZeta * ((P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * (P.tau - P.ell))
      ≤ P.chartZeta * (P.tau ^ P.chartN - P.ell ^ P.chartN) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hconv hζpos.le
  have h2 : P.chartZeta * ((P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * P.chartU)
      < P.chartZeta * ((P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * (P.tau - P.ell)) :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hstep1 hNℓpos) hζpos
  have h3 : P.chartZeta * ((P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * P.chartU)
      = (P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN + 1) := by
    calc P.chartZeta * ((P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * P.chartU)
        = (P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * (P.chartZeta * P.chartU) := by ring
      _ = (P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN - 1) * P.ell ^ 2 := by rw [hζu]
      _ = (P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN + 1) := by rw [mul_assoc, hℓexp]
  have hkey : (P.chartN : Real) * P.ell ^ (P.chartN + 1)
      < P.chartZeta * (P.tau ^ P.chartN - P.ell ^ P.chartN) := by
    rw [← h3]; exact lt_of_lt_of_le h2 h1
  unfold chartTN
  nlinarith [hkey]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.ell_sq_lt_chartV
statement: theorem ell_sq_lt_chartV : P.ell ^ 2 < P.chartV
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : P.ell ^ 2 = P.chartZeta * P.chartU := (P.chartZeta_mul_chartU).symm
  have h2 : P.chartV = P.chartU * P.chartH := (P.chartU_mul_chartH).symm
  rw [h1, h2]; unfold chartH
  nlinarith [mul_pos P.chartU_pos (show (0:ℝ) < 1 + P.chartV by linarith [P.chartV_pos])]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartTN_le_one
statement:
theorem chartTN_le_one :
    P.chartTN ≤ (P.chartN : Real) * (1 + P.chartV)
      - P.chartZeta * (1 - (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN)
proof:
:= by
  have hζpos := P.chartZeta_pos
  have hNpos := P.chartN_pos_real
  have hℓ2v := P.ell_sq_lt_chartV
  have hℓsqrt : P.ell < Real.sqrt P.chartV := by
    have h := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt (sq_nonneg P.ell) hℓ2v
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq P.ell_pos.le] at h
  have hℓN : P.ell ^ P.chartN < (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN :=
    pow_lt_pow_left₀ hℓsqrt P.ell_pos.le
      (by have := P.m_ge_nine; unfold chartN; omega)
  have hbern : 1 - (P.chartN : Real) * P.chartU ≤ P.tau ^ P.chartN := by
    have h := one_add_mul_le_pow
      (show (-2:ℝ) ≤ -P.chartU by unfold chartU; linarith [P.tau_pos]) P.chartN
    have heq : (1 + -P.chartU) ^ P.chartN = P.tau ^ P.chartN := by
      congr 1; unfold chartU; ring
    rw [heq] at h; linarith [h]
  have hζuv : P.chartZeta * P.chartU < P.chartV := by
    rw [P.chartZeta_mul_chartU]; exact hℓ2v
  unfold chartTN
  nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbern hζpos.le,
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hℓN hζpos,
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hζuv hNpos]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.one_sub_pow_mul_one_add_le_one
statement:
theorem one_sub_pow_mul_one_add_le_one {b : ℝ} (_hb0 : 0 ≤ b) (hb1 : b ≤ 1) (r : ℕ) :
    (1 - b) ^ r * (1 + r * b) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  induction r with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    have h1b : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - b := by linarith
    have hpow : (0:ℝ) ≤ (1 - b) ^ n := pow_nonneg h1b n
    have key : (1 - b) ^ (n + 1) * (1 + (↑(n + 1)) * b) ≤ (1 - b) ^ n * (1 + ↑n * b) := by
      have e : (1 - b) ^ (n + 1) * (1 + (↑(n + 1)) * b)
          = (1 - b) ^ n * ((1 - b) * (1 + (↑(n + 1)) * b)) := by rw [pow_succ]; ring
      rw [e]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hpow
      push_cast
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ) + 1 by positivity) (sq_nonneg b)]
    exact le_trans key ih

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.two_mul_chartR
statement: theorem two_mul_chartR : 2 * P.chartR = P.chartN + 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := P.m_odd
  have := P.m_ge_nine
  unfold chartR chartN
  omega

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartVsqrtN_lt_one
statement: theorem chartVsqrtN_lt_one : (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt1 : Real.sqrt P.chartV < 1 := by
    have h := Real.sqrt_lt_sqrt P.chartV_pos.le P.chartV_lt_one
    rwa [Real.sqrt_one] at h
  exact pow_lt_one₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hsqrt1
    (by have := P.m_ge_nine; unfold chartN; omega)

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.zeta_mul_chartV
statement: theorem zeta_mul_chartV : P.chartZeta * P.chartV = P.ell ^ 2 * P.chartH
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : P.chartV = P.chartU * P.chartH := (P.chartU_mul_chartH).symm
  rw [h1]
  linear_combination P.chartH * P.chartZeta_mul_chartU

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.zeta_mul_one_sub_lt
statement:
theorem zeta_mul_one_sub_lt (hT : 0 < P.chartTN) :
    P.chartZeta * (1 - (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN) < (P.chartN : Real) * (1 + P.chartV)
proof:
:= by
  linarith [P.chartTN_le_one, hT]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.gderiv_sign
statement:
theorem gderiv_sign {t v : ℝ} (ht : 0 < t) (hv0 : 0 ≤ v) (hv1 : v ≤ 1) (r : ℕ) :
    (t * v / (t + 1 + v)) ^ r * (1 + (r : ℝ) * ((1 + v) / (t + 1 + v))) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < t + 1 + v := by linarith
  set θ := (1 + v) / (t + 1 + v) with hθ
  have hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ := by rw [hθ]; positivity
  have hθ1 : θ ≤ 1 := by rw [hθ, div_le_one hden]; linarith
  have hh : t * v / (t + 1 + v) = v * (1 - θ) := by
    rw [hθ]; field_simp; ring
  rw [hh, mul_pow]
  have hamgm := one_sub_pow_mul_one_add_le_one hθ0 hθ1 r
  have hvr : v ^ r ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hv0 hv1
  calc v ^ r * (1 - θ) ^ r * (1 + (r : ℝ) * θ)
      = v ^ r * ((1 - θ) ^ r * (1 + (r : ℝ) * θ)) := by ring
    _ ≤ v ^ r * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hamgm (pow_nonneg hv0 r)
    _ = v ^ r := mul_one _
    _ ≤ 1 := hvr

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.g_monotoneOn
statement:
theorem g_monotoneOn {v : ℝ} (hv0 : 0 < v) (hv1 : v < 1) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    MonotoneOn (fun t => t * (1 - (t * v / (t + 1 + v)) ^ r)) (Set.Ici (0:ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hHD : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ x →
      HasDerivAt (fun t => t * (1 - (t * v / (t + 1 + v)) ^ r))
        (1 - (x * v / (x + 1 + v)) ^ r
          * (1 + (r : ℝ) * ((1 + v) / (x + 1 + v)))) x := by
    intro x hx
    have hden : x + 1 + v ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hWnum : HasDerivAt (fun t => t * v) v x := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).mul_const v
    have hWden : HasDerivAt (fun t => t + 1 + v) 1 x := by
      simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id x).add_const 1).add_const v
    have hW : HasDerivAt (fun t => t * v / (t + 1 + v))
        ((v * (x + 1 + v) - x * v * 1) / (x + 1 + v) ^ 2) x := hWnum.div hWden hden
    have hg : HasDerivAt (fun t => t * (1 - (t * v / (t + 1 + v)) ^ r))
        (1 * (1 - (x * v / (x + 1 + v)) ^ r) + x *
          (0 - (↑r * (x * v / (x + 1 + v)) ^ (r - 1) *
            ((v * (x + 1 + v) - x * v * 1) / (x + 1 + v) ^ 2)))) x :=
      (hasDerivAt_id x).mul ((hasDerivAt_const x (1 : ℝ)).sub (hW.pow r))
    have hval : 1 * (1 - (x * v / (x + 1 + v)) ^ r) + x *
          (0 - (↑r * (x * v / (x + 1 + v)) ^ (r - 1) *
            ((v * (x + 1 + v) - x * v * 1) / (x + 1 + v) ^ 2)))
        = 1 - (x * v / (x + 1 + v)) ^ r * (1 + (r : ℝ) * ((1 + v) / (x + 1 + v))) := by
      obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ : ∃ s, r = s + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      rw [div_pow, div_pow]
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [hval] at hg
    exact hg
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (fun t => t * (1 - (t * v / (t + 1 + v)) ^ r)) (Set.Ici 0) :=
    fun x hx => (hHD x hx).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  apply monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Ici 0) hcont
  · intro x hx
    rw [interior_Ici, Set.mem_Ioi] at hx
    exact (hHD x hx.le).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
  · intro x hx
    rw [interior_Ici, Set.mem_Ioi] at hx
    rw [(hHD x hx.le).deriv]
    linarith [gderiv_sign hx hv0.le hv1.le r]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartR_pos
statement: theorem chartR_pos : 1 ≤ P.chartR
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := P.two_mul_chartR
  have h2 : 7 ≤ P.chartN := by have := P.m_ge_nine; unfold chartN; omega
  omega

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartZ_pos
statement: theorem chartZ_pos : 0 < P.chartZ
proof:
:= by
  unfold chartZ
  apply div_pos (mul_pos P.chartN_pos_real (by linarith [P.chartV_pos]))
  linarith [P.chartVsqrtN_lt_one]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.zeta_lt_chartZ
statement: theorem zeta_lt_chartZ (hT : 0 < P.chartTN) : P.chartZeta < P.chartZ
proof:
:= by
  have h1η : 0 < 1 - (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN := by linarith [P.chartVsqrtN_lt_one]
  unfold chartZ
  rw [lt_div_iff₀ h1η]
  exact P.zeta_mul_one_sub_lt hT

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.zeta_v_div_eq_ell_sq
statement:
theorem zeta_v_div_eq_ell_sq :
    P.chartZeta * P.chartV / (P.chartZeta + 1 + P.chartV) = P.ell ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hH : P.chartZeta + 1 + P.chartV = P.chartH := rfl
  rw [hH, div_eq_iff P.chartH_pos.ne']
  exact P.zeta_mul_chartV

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.g_at_zeta
statement:
theorem g_at_zeta :
    P.chartZeta * (1 - (P.chartZeta * P.chartV / (P.chartZeta + 1 + P.chartV)) ^ P.chartR)
      = P.chartZeta * (1 - P.ell ^ (P.chartN + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hpow : (P.chartZeta * P.chartV / (P.chartZeta + 1 + P.chartV)) ^ P.chartR
      = P.ell ^ (P.chartN + 1) := by
    rw [P.zeta_v_div_eq_ell_sq, ← pow_mul, P.two_mul_chartR]
  rw [hpow]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.zeta_mul_TN_lt
statement:
theorem zeta_mul_TN_lt :
    P.chartZeta * P.chartTN < (P.chartN : Real) * (P.chartZeta * (1 - P.ell ^ (P.chartN + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  nlinarith [mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left P.chartTN_lt P.chartZeta_pos]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.g_zeta_le_g_Z
statement:
theorem g_zeta_le_g_Z (hT : 0 < P.chartTN) :
    P.chartZeta * (1 - P.ell ^ (P.chartN + 1))
      ≤ P.chartZ * (1 - (P.chartZ * P.chartV / (P.chartZ + 1 + P.chartV)) ^ P.chartR)
proof:
:= by
  have hmono := g_monotoneOn P.chartV_pos P.chartV_lt_one P.chartR P.chartR_pos
  have hle := hmono P.chartZeta_pos.le P.chartZ_pos.le (P.zeta_lt_chartZ hT).le
  simp only at hle
  rw [P.g_at_zeta] at hle
  exact hle

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartZ_v_div_eq_omega
statement:
theorem chartZ_v_div_eq_omega :
    P.chartZ * P.chartV / (P.chartZ + 1 + P.chartV) = P.chartOmega
proof:
:= by
  have h1η : (0:ℝ) < 1 - (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN := by linarith [P.chartVsqrtN_lt_one]
  have hNη : (0:ℝ) < (P.chartN : Real) + 1 - (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN := by
    have := P.chartVsqrtN_lt_one; have := P.chartN_pos_real; linarith
  have hZ1v : (0:ℝ) < P.chartZ + 1 + P.chartV := by
    have := P.chartZ_pos; linarith [P.chartV_pos]
  unfold chartOmega
  rw [div_eq_div_iff hZ1v.ne' hNη.ne']
  unfold chartZ
  field_simp [h1η.ne']
  ring

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.psi_ge
proof:
:= by
  have hNr : (N : ℝ) + 1 = 2 * (r : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hNr
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN2
    linarith
  have hN2r : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN2
  have hrs : ((N : ℝ) + 1) / (N : ℝ) ≤ (r : ℝ) := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hNpos]
    nlinarith [hNr, mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg r) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) - 2 by linarith)]
  set φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
    3 * ((N : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (N : ℝ)) * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ^ (r + 1)
      - (N : ℝ) ^ r * (((N : ℝ) + 1) / (N : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) + (r : ℝ) * t) with hφdef
  have hderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt φ
      (3 * ((N : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (N : ℝ))
          * ((↑(r + 1) : ℝ) * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ^ (r + 1 - 1) * (0 - 1))
        - (N : ℝ) ^ r * (((N : ℝ) + 1) / (N : ℝ) * (0 - 1) + (r : ℝ) * 1)) t := by
    intro t
    apply HasDerivAt.sub
    · exact (((hasDerivAt_const t ((N : ℝ) + 1)).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)).pow (r + 1)).const_mul _
    · exact ((((hasDerivAt_const t ((N : ℝ) + 1)).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)).const_mul
        (((N : ℝ) + 1) / (N : ℝ))).add ((hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul (r : ℝ))).const_mul ((N : ℝ) ^ r)
  have hanti : AntitoneOn φ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc 0 1)
    · exact fun t _ => (hderiv t).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun t _ => (hderiv t).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [interior_Icc, Set.mem_Ioo] at ht
      rw [(hderiv t).deriv]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      have hDnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ^ r :=
        pow_nonneg (by linarith [ht.2, hNpos]) r
      have hcnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * ((N : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (N : ℝ)) := by positivity
      have hNrnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ r := pow_nonneg hNpos.le r
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hcnn (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (↑(r + 1) : ℝ))) hDnn,
        mul_nonneg hNrnn (sub_nonneg.mpr hrs)]
  have hφ1 : φ 1 = 0 := by
    simp only [hφdef]
    have hN0 : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hNpos.ne'
    rw [show (N : ℝ) + 1 - 1 = (N : ℝ) from by ring, pow_succ]
    field_simp
    linear_combination ((N : ℝ) ^ r) * hNr
  have key := hanti (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hx0, hx1⟩) (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by norm_num, le_refl 1⟩) hx1
  rw [hφ1] at key
  simp only [hφdef] at key
  linarith [key]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.f_tangent
proof:
:= by
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN2
    linarith
  set s : ℝ := ((N : ℝ) + 1) / (N : ℝ) with hsdef
  set c : ℝ := 3 * ((N : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (N : ℝ)) with hcdef
  set f : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (N : ℝ) ^ r * t ^ s / ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ^ r with hfdef
  have hs1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ s := by rw [hsdef, le_div_iff₀ hNpos]; linarith
  have hs0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ s - 1 := by linarith
  have hfderiv : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < (N : ℝ) + 1 →
      HasDerivAt f
        ((N : ℝ) ^ r * (s * t ^ (s - 1) * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) + (r : ℝ) * t ^ s)
          / ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ^ (r + 1)) t := by
    intro t ht0 htN
    have hDne : (N : ℝ) + 1 - t ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hDpow : ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ^ r ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero r hDne
    have hcomb :=
      (((Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (p := s) (Or.inl ht0.ne')).const_mul ((N : ℝ) ^ r)).div
        (((hasDerivAt_const t ((N : ℝ) + 1)).sub (hasDerivAt_id t)).pow r) hDpow)
    convert hcomb using 1
    all_goals try rfl
    obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ : ∃ r', r = r' + 1 := ⟨r - 1, by omega⟩
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.pow_apply, id_eq]
    field_simp
    ring
  have hfle : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ 1 →
      (N : ℝ) ^ r * (s * t ^ (s - 1) * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) + (r : ℝ) * t ^ s)
        / ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ^ (r + 1) ≤ c := by
    intro t ht0 ht1
    have hD1 : (0 : ℝ) < (N : ℝ) + 1 - t := by linarith
    have hDp : (0 : ℝ) < ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ^ (r + 1) := pow_pos hD1 _
    have hts1 : t ^ (s - 1) ≤ 1 := Real.rpow_le_one ht0.le ht1 hs0
    have htss : t ^ s ≤ t := by
      calc t ^ s ≤ t ^ (1 : ℝ) := Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_ge ht0 ht1 hs1
        _ = t := Real.rpow_one t
    have hspos : (0 : ℝ) ≤ s := by linarith
    have hnum : s * t ^ (s - 1) * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) + (r : ℝ) * t ^ s
        ≤ s * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) + (r : ℝ) * t := by
      have hA : s * t ^ (s - 1) * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ≤ s * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg hspos hD1.le, hts1,
          mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hspos hD1.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr hts1)]
      have hB : (r : ℝ) * t ^ s ≤ (r : ℝ) * t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htss (Nat.cast_nonneg r)
      linarith
    have hNr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) ^ r := pow_nonneg hNpos.le r
    have hpsi := psi_ge hNr hN2 ht0.le ht1
    rw [← hsdef, ← hcdef] at hpsi
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hDp]
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnum hNr0, hpsi]
  have hderivh : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t < (N : ℝ) + 1 →
      HasDerivAt (fun u => f u - c * u)
        ((N : ℝ) ^ r * (s * t ^ (s - 1) * ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) + (r : ℝ) * t ^ s)
          / ((N : ℝ) + 1 - t) ^ (r + 1) - c) t := by
    intro t ht0 htN
    have hc : HasDerivAt (fun u => c * u) c t := by simpa using (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul c
    exact (hfderiv t ht0 htN).sub hc
  have hanti : AntitoneOn (fun u => f u - c * u) (Set.Icc x 1) := by
    apply antitoneOn_of_deriv_nonpos (convex_Icc x 1)
    · exact fun t ht => (hderivh t (by have := (Set.mem_Icc.mp ht).1; linarith)
        (by have := (Set.mem_Icc.mp ht).2; linarith)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [interior_Icc, Set.mem_Ioo] at ht
      exact (hderivh t (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2])).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    · intro t ht
      rw [interior_Icc, Set.mem_Ioo] at ht
      rw [(hderivh t (by linarith [ht.1]) (by linarith [ht.2])).deriv]
      have := hfle t (by linarith [ht.1]) (le_of_lt ht.2)
      linarith
  have hf1 : f 1 = 1 := by
    simp only [hfdef]
    rw [Real.one_rpow, show (N : ℝ) + 1 - 1 = (N : ℝ) from by ring]
    field_simp
  have hres := hanti (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_refl x, hx1⟩) (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hx1, le_refl 1⟩) hx1
  simp only at hres
  rw [hf1] at hres
  simp only [hfdef] at hres ⊢
  linarith [hres]

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.g_at_Z_le
statement:
theorem g_at_Z_le :
    P.chartZ * (1 - P.chartOmega ^ P.chartR) ≤ 3 * ((P.chartN : ℝ) + 1) / 2 * (1 + P.chartV)
proof:
:= by
  have hηlt : (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN < 1 := P.chartVsqrtN_lt_one
  have h1η : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN := by linarith
  have hηpos : 0 < (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN := pow_pos (Real.sqrt_pos.2 P.chartV_pos) _
  have hNr : P.chartN + 1 = 2 * P.chartR := P.two_mul_chartR.symm
  have hN2 : 2 ≤ P.chartN := by have := P.m_ge_nine; unfold chartN; omega
  have hNpos : (0 : ℝ) < (P.chartN : ℝ) := by
    have : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (P.chartN : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hN2
    linarith
  have hN0 : (P.chartN : ℝ) ≠ 0 := hNpos.ne'
  have hsv : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt P.chartV := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hηs : ((Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN) ^ (((P.chartN : ℝ) + 1) / (P.chartN : ℝ))
      = P.chartV ^ P.chartR := by
    have hNs : (P.chartN : ℝ) * (((P.chartN : ℝ) + 1) / (P.chartN : ℝ)) = (P.chartN : ℝ) + 1 := by
      field_simp
    rw [← Real.rpow_natCast (Real.sqrt P.chartV) P.chartN, ← Real.rpow_mul hsv, hNs,
      show (P.chartN : ℝ) + 1 = ((P.chartN + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) from by push_cast; ring, Real.rpow_natCast,
      ← P.two_mul_chartR, pow_mul, Real.sq_sqrt P.chartV_pos.le]
  have hfeq : (P.chartN : ℝ) ^ P.chartR
        * ((Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN) ^ (((P.chartN : ℝ) + 1) / (P.chartN : ℝ))
        / ((P.chartN : ℝ) + 1 - (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN) ^ P.chartR
      = P.chartOmega ^ P.chartR := by
    rw [hηs]; unfold chartOmega; rw [div_pow, mul_pow]
  have hft := f_tangent hNr hN2 hηpos hηlt.le
  rw [hfeq] at hft
  have h1 : 1 - P.chartOmega ^ P.chartR
      ≤ 3 * ((P.chartN : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (P.chartN : ℝ)) * (1 - (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN) := by
    nlinarith [hft]
  calc P.chartZ * (1 - P.chartOmega ^ P.chartR)
      ≤ P.chartZ * (3 * ((P.chartN : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (P.chartN : ℝ))
          * (1 - (Real.sqrt P.chartV) ^ P.chartN)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 P.chartZ_pos.le
    _ = 3 * ((P.chartN : ℝ) + 1) / 2 * (1 + P.chartV) := by
        unfold chartZ
        field_simp

name: OddCycleBound.IntermediateRegion.Scalar.AdmissibleParams.chartZeta_mul_chartTN_lt
statement:
theorem chartZeta_mul_chartTN_lt (hT : 0 < P.chartTN) :
    P.chartZeta * P.chartTN < 3 * (P.chartN : ℝ) * ((P.chartN : ℝ) + 1) / 2 * (1 + P.chartV)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := P.g_zeta_le_g_Z hT
  rw [P.chartZ_v_div_eq_omega] at h2
  have hchain := le_trans h2 P.g_at_Z_le
  nlinarith [P.zeta_mul_TN_lt, mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hchain P.chartN_pos_real.le]
